chapters.title: Chapter 1651: The Sin of Sloth
paragraphs: Watching Adina’s pale expression, Kent knew something was amiss.
"What is wrong, Adina?" he asked, holding her trembling hands.
"One of my sisters is in danger."
Kent raised an eyebrow and was about to enter the tower to check, since, in his mind, her sisters were Elina and the others. However, Adina stopped him and pointed into the distance.
"I can sense her life fading away."
This time, Kent became genuinely confused. "Do you have other sisters I don’t know of?"

Adina managed to smile, though her pale expression showed she wasn’t in a happy mood. "I am the Sin of Lust, Kent. That means all the other Seven Sins are my sisters. Right now, I can sense Sloth is in danger."
"Oh, you should have said that from the beginning." Kent smirked, grabbed her by the hand, and sped in the direction Adina pointed.
As someone who knew how dangerous the seven sins are, he knew that if sloth is pushed to a corner, she could send everyone to eternal sleep.
So saving her would be of outmost importants now.
Princess Euren was locked in battle against the three demon generals, her body battered and bruised, yet she still held her ground, one arrow after another speeding toward her opponents.
Those who managed to get close to her were met by the sharp edge of her short sword. The more they clashed, the more she felt her energy draining.

If it were merely a battle between herself and the three Demigod demon generals, she would have managed to kill all three of them. However, she had to keep the portal open as more of her nightmare creatures flooded the battlefield.

Of course, they had underestimated the sin of sloth, just as she, too, had underestimated the Supreme who wanted her life. Even so, as more of her nightmare creatures were being killed, the impact on her soul and energy started to show.
Seeing this, the Lone General laughed. "Give up and surrender, or else you will die and the rest of your people will be slaughtered or enslaved."
"Over my dead body." Princess Euren unleashed an arrow, letting it fly toward one of the Demigods.
Just when the arrow came within striking range, Princess Euren swapped places with the arrow, and her short sword stabbed forward, embedding itself in his chest.
"AaaagggHHH"
The demon general let out a painful scream and pushed back, causing the space around them to crack. From within the void, a thin spear stabbed forward.
Princess Euren sensed danger, so she pulled back her sword and swapped places with the arrow again. However, the Lone General was there to greet her.

His hand shot forward, and before Princess Euren could twist her body to defend herself, a black, inky hand burst out from the ground and grabbed her leg, pulling her down and slamming her into the ground.
Just when she landed, dozens of hands burst out and tried to pull her into the ground.
However, a white-haired young man appeared, and his sword sliced through the hands, freeing the princess.
But before the two of them could move, a large net made from one of the most durable ropes fell on them, trapping them. They tried to tear through the net, but it became clear they couldn’t.
It was a Supreme Item given to them by the Supreme who sent them. The moment someone was trapped inside, freeing themselves became next to impossible.
"Hahahahahaha! Looks like our job has been made simple for us," the Lone General laughed.
Princess Euren tried to free herself from the net, but she soon found herself becoming weak. Her brother, Prince Letharion, one of the finest swordsmen, also began to feel his energy draining.

"It is of no use. The moment you get trapped in the Energy Suppressing Net, there is no way you can free yourself unless we free you," one of the demon generals laughed and turned toward Queen Llythia, who was flying toward them with a furious expression.
"Looks like Mama is here to save you, Princess."
"Bastard, leave my mother alone!" Princess Euren shouted, but she felt more of her energy drain away. This made her grit her teeth and turn to her brother.
"I am sorry, Big Brother. I should have left this place long ago."
"Don’t be stupid, Euren. This is your home. Where else would you have gone? Or do you think just because you are a Sin, we would abandon you?"

Prince Letharion pointed around them. "Just look around. Do these people look like people who would abandon their princess? They all want to protect you, so stop saying nonsense and use that big brain of yours to think of how we can break free."
Princess Euren allowed herself to smile a little. She didn’t spend much time awake; however, whenever she did, she made sure to spend time with her family, especially her brothers.
They loved her despite knowing she was lazy and liked to sleep a lot. Now, even after learning she was the sin of Sloth, they still chose to stand by her and fight for her freedom.
"Technically, if I pour the rest of my energy into your sword, you will temporarily become a Sword God. Would that be enough to cut through this net?"

Prince Letharion didn’t answer immediately. He first ran several scenarios through his head before responding. "I am not sure it would work, Euren. The net is a Supreme Treasure; cutting through it would require a lot."
"I figured as much." Princess Euren thought for a moment, and another idea came to mind.
"I could activate my bloodline, and with our energy, I will go to sleep. However, it would allow me to tap into the Realm of Dreams and send us both to the Desert of Dreams.
"But it would be akin to abandoning our people since we wouldn’t be able to return until one of us became a god. It is a terrible plan, but at least we would live.

"However, I don’t plan on doing it, so how about I send you away instead? I will figure something out," she said faintly. "I can seal this entire planet within the Realm of Dreams, preventing anyone from entering or leaving. That would save our people, but they would become Dream Elves for the rest of their lives."
"Yeah, all your plans are terrible." Prince Letharion laughed, tapped into his core, and winked at Princess Euren. "But if I ignite my core, this net will be blasted into bits, and you will be free."
"No, Big Brother," Princess Euren panicked, and so did the three demon generals. Clearly, a Demigod detonating his core was bad news.

"Bastard," The Lone General exploded with anger and lunged forward, or at least tried to. Just before he could move, Kent and Adina appeared before them, and Kent grabbed his head with his clawed hand.
His knee moved, and like bones breaking, he landed a powerful kick on the Lone General’s face, cracking his skull.
"AAAAGGHHHHH!"
His painful scream brought the battle to a halt, and everyone turned in the direction the scream came from. When they saw the Lone General being held by the head, many paled.
Kent ignored everyone and landed another kick, knocking the bastard out. His skull cracked, and brain matter splattered out, a clear sign that he would never wake up again.
Kent let go of him and allowed his body to drop to the ground.
Turning around, his voice spread across the battlefield. "You all have five seconds to leave this planet, or don’t say I didn’t warn you."
The second demon general pointed furiously at Kent. "Bastard, who the hell do you think you are? You dare get in the way of a Supreme mission."
Kent smiled and flicked his hair. "Oh, I am nobody special, but you can call me Kent Madson."
Everyone became pale.
[A/N: I am a little under the weather, so I will do only 2 Chapters today.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1652: Kent Madson Unleashed
paragraphs: Kent had no plans to hide his identity anymore.

He had tried to remain in the shadows back when he was in the High World, fearing he would incur the wrath of powerful figures. However, with the power under his command now, he had absolutely nothing to fear.
His journey as the primordial chaos dragon could not be threaded with fear.
He had to show everyone who he was and what kind of power he held, so announcing his name for all to hear was a plan he had already discussed with his wives before ascending.
As expected, the reveal of his name left everyone stunned, unsure of what to even do.
The person they had hunted for years was now standing before them, and all they could do was stare at him. Even more chilling, with just two kicks, he had killed a Demigod.
Be it the people of Lumenore or the attackers, they were all equally stunned.

However, the third Demigod snapped out of his daze and pointed his spear at Kent. "So what if you are Kent Madson? We have seen many fakes and killed many of them. In fact, I wouldn’t be surprised if you are also a fake.
"But even if you are real, do you think Lady Hilda sent only the three of us?" Just as he said that, the void exploded, and over thirty Demigods walked out, each oozing an even more dreadful aura.

"We are here for the Sin of Sloth and to reduce this planet to rubble. It would be in your best interest to surrender and let yourself be enslaved. I am sure bringing in the Sin of Sloth and the wannabe Kent Madson won’t be bad."
"Oh, you really shouldn’t have said that," Adina said, stepping back, already sensing a terrifying aura moving through Kent’s body.
For someone who had recently had an altercation with slave traders, Kent’s fuse was easily triggered whenever the word enslavement was mentioned around him.
After moving back far enough, Adina contacted her sisters and informed them to be ready to come over. She knew what was about to happen, and frankly, she wanted to see how strong Kent had become.
Kent smiled and turned to Princess Euren and Prince Letharion. "Excuse the mess."
Just then, Kent moved, and blood filled the air.
The Demigod who threatened to enslave him was the first to die. He saw Kent move, but he couldn’t move his body fast enough to evade or block his claw.
Kent dug into his chest and ripped his heart out, crushing it before his dying eyes. Then he continued, his body turning into a blur as he moved from one Demigod to the next.

In under a minute, three Demigods died, one losing his head while another was cut in half by Kent’s claw. Kent had no idea how strong he had become at the moment, but he knew average Demigods—or at least, in his eyes, Demigods who couldn’t fight gods—were nothing but bugs.
So as he killed, he had no fear of death or being overwhelmed. He knew none of the demigods around could challenge him.
Five minutes into the battle, after twelve Demigods died, the rest of the Immortals and Demigods started to panic. A few seconds later, one of the Demigods called for a retreat.
"Retreat..." his voice spread across the entire planet.
"You think you can come and go without my permission?" Kent spoke in a chilling tone, leaving many frozen in their tracks. The next second, despair descended upon them.
"KAIZO!" Kent called out, and the person responded.
"Here I come!" Kaizo dropped from the clouds, his body bathed in golden lightning. The moment he arrived, he called over the legions, and five portals opened in the air.
The Dragon Legion came from one, the Night Riders from another, Eternal Wrath from the third, the Undead Legion from the fourth, and finally, the Beast Legion from the fifth.

Kent had yet to understand what truly happened, but for some reason, while he was away, Kaizo became his first-in-command. With that authority bestowed upon him, he gained the power to summon the legions.

As they poured out of the portals, the attackers finally understood what despair felt like. Kaizo, already hungry for battle, moved, and his Golem, Titan, followed, their rampage shaking the entire planet.

Kent ignored everyone, and for an hour, he continued to unleash his fury on the poor souls who, up until today, had rampaged across many battlefields undisputed. They had killed millions of warriors and enriched themselves through the pain of others.
Today, they met a legion led by a very dangerous dragon.
By the time Kent stopped, only ten out of the 300,000 warriors sent over by the supreme who called herself Hilda remained standing—well, sprawled on the ground.
He walked toward them and, in a voice that made it clear he was serious, issued his warning.
"I am letting you ten go because I want my warning to be carried as far as you can carry it. Tell the one who sent you here that the Sin of Sloth is off-limits.

"Tell them if they want her, they should come in person and meet their death. Of course, you can also tell them I have no plans of stopping for now, so sending more Demigods and gods would be very helpful.
"And while you are at it, tell the rest of the galaxy that I am finally here in the Immortal World and have no plans of running from them, so those who want to die should come.
"Lastly, let the entire universe know I will come for revenge for daring to hurt my wives on Planet Brymrr. That would be all. You can run along now."
"You heard the man, shoo." Kaizo’s voice was like a dragon’s roar, sending the ten survivors fleeing off the planet. They bolted and soon vanished from the sight of most people.
"Ixeron, did you do it?" Kent turned to Ixeron, the Mind Flayer, his second-strongest Beast companion.
"Yes, Young Lord. I have planted ten false minds within their consciousness, so even if they don’t want to relay your message, I will force them to."
"Good. You guys can go around and help the injured."
They nodded and left, with Kaizo and Kaelith being the only ones remaining by Kent’s side.
"Master, when are we getting revenge for Kaelith?" Kaizo asked, his gaze oozing battle intent. Kaelith, who woke up while Kent was asleep, smiled and tapped Kaizo on the shoulder.
"No need for that, Kaizo. We have more important things to do."
"Kaizo is right. We must get revenge for you, buddy. But first, allow me to summon the others after I handle the issue brewing behind me."
Kent sighed and turned with a smile on his face toward the sight of over thirty-five beauties glaring at him.
"How did you find out?" Vexthra asked, having heard what Kent said to the ten people he spared.
"Uncle Drew told you, right?" Unity asked, her gaze narrowing toward the poor Night Rider captain, who was busy helping the wounded Elves receive aid.
"Uncle Drew didn’t say anything. I overheard everything while I was asleep."
Hearing his reply, the ladies sighed.
"You don’t have to worry about it, Kent. We already have plans to get revenge ourselves," Inaya said, since she herself had already prepared a kill list.
"Inaya is right. We will get revenge ourselves. You should focus on growing your strength," Vexthra also said, reaching for Kent’s hand.
"You already have plans to get revenge for the Eternal Wrath Legion, so focus on that. We will handle the rest."
In the end, Kent had no reason to stop them. But he would keep a close eye on them and ensure everything went according to plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1653: Old Friends Meet
paragraphs: [Two Weeks Later]
Two weeks passed in the blink of an eye.

After saving the Sin of Sloth and, by extension, the entire planet, Kent left everything to his wives and legions and returned to the tower to examine the changes that had occurred and finally plan his journey across the Immortal Realm.
With several months spent inside the tower, Kent managed to get a lot done.
First, he reviewed the Dungeon Tower that, for some reason, had been locked since it awakened. When he unlocked it, he discovered that inside the Dungeon Tower, there were over a hundred dungeons.
Each dungeon was unique, and from his previous experience, each held one of the members of the Eternal Wrath Legion.
Some of the dungeons had blue gates, while others had green and red. But there was one Black Dungeon that, even without knowing what was inside, Kent knew was bad news.

According to the tower, the blue dungeons had a Demigod as the last-floor boss and twenty-four floors. The green dungeons featured gods ranging from Early God to Universal God as the last-floor boss, with 30 floors.
As for the red dungeons, the tower said they had Supremes and Celestials as the last-floor boss. Depending on the number of floors, the last-floor boss could either be a Supreme or a Celestial.
Floors thirty-four to thirty-eight had Supremes as the last-floor boss, while floors thirty-nine to forty-five had Celestials.
As for the Black Dungeon, Tower warned him not to touch it yet, as it held something truly terrible. Also, the Black Dungeon had sixty-six floors and an unknown-ranked last-floor boss.
Before he could learn the contents of the Black Dungeon, the requirements were as follows.
1. Become a god
2. Clear all 240 dungeons
3. Awaken three more Ancient Evils
4. Awaken two of the First Undead Generals

Kent knew better than to argue, so he accepted the conditions. His legions and his wives would have their hands full. As for him, he wanted to become a Sword Immortal as soon as possible, so he would leave to clear the requirements needed to become a Sword Legend.
To do that, he must join a sect and qualify to participate in the Genesis Sword Dao Competition. Luckily for him, the Whispering Wind Sword Sect is in the Eastern Galaxy, so he would rejoin them.
It was where Lord Genesis ended up when he ascended to the Immortal Realm back then, and also where he met Inaya.
But before all that, he planned to head to the Underworld. Nyx had waited long enough.

Inside were millions of inheritances from legendary figures who once held great power in the universe.
In fact, even the inheritance of legendary enemies like the Grand Matriarch of the Bone Palace, a deadly enchantress who led a legion of Chaos Beasts during the Chaos Era, could be found there.
Kent knew his wives were secured. However, the people living inside the Tower Cities and some members of his legions could benefit from it.
He left Vexthra and the three cosmic Lolis in charge of that and continued his exploration. In the end, he discovered just how powerful the tower truly was.
With the Legacy Tower and Dungeon Tower now opened, his legions could clear them first, and then the warriors of the various races living inside the Tower Cities could use them to train.

Very soon, the Tower City would become a continent, then expand into a kingdom, then a planet, and, if in the future more people kept migrating, it would become a planetary system and, hopefully, a galaxy one day.
He couldn’t bring the entire universe into the tower, but he could bring those he wanted inside to live a more peaceful life.
Later, Kent returned to Planet Lumenore, where only a few Elves remained, some working to record their history and legacy before returning to the tower.
Nature City had been expanded to accommodate them. Gaia was also working hard to expand it even further for future Elves.
When Kent arrived there, Kaelith was already waiting for him.
"Big Brother, I have already informed the others. They will be here soon."
With Kent now in the Immortal Realm, his connection to the Beasts he had befriended when he went to the Pill World had been re-established.
However, to surprise them, he told Kaelith to call them over instead.
"I will hide for now." Kent activated a shadow-type technique, and his body turned into shadowy mist before vanishing into the shadow of a tree.
A few seconds later, they start to arrive.

The first to appear was Orvath, the Minotaur Monarch. From inside the shadows, Kent saw that he was now an Immortal Lord. The aura around him clearly showed he had experienced his fair share of battles and killing over the past 300,000-plus years.
Balrion, the Titan, also arrived a few seconds after Orvath.

Then Vey, the Phoenix Queen, arrived as well, excited to see her friends again, especially Kaelith, with whom she had once been partners in crime, even plotting to kill Kent. In the end, he had tamed them.
The fourth to appear was Ignarok, the dragon, and the strongest among them. He had established himself in the Beast Kingdom and was also an Immortal Lord just like the rest of them.
With Zeraphine now in the Underworld with Nyx, the last to appear was Sylvara, the Flame Serpent that Kent had first clashed with when he went to the Flame Sea.
"Kaelith, you bastard, we have been worried sick about you," Sylvara said, her expression showing how happy she was to see Kaelith alive and well.
"The last we heard, you had been imprisoned by your family. How did you get out?"
Kaelith smiled and answered, "I was rescued."
"Rescued?" Ignarok frowned. "Rescued by who?"
"Who else?" a voice came from behind them, causing all five new arrivals to turn and look.
"KENT!" Sylvara screamed, tears rolling down her face as she jumped into Kent’s arms.
Vey followed right after, turning it into a group hug. Kent, knowing he had been apart from his first-ever Beast Companions for so long, allowed them to soak his shirt with tears.
He felt both guilty and happy to see them again.

"Big Brother rescued me after one of his subordinates found out I was imprisoned. I don’t know how they knew, but if it wasn’t because of him, I would still be starving inside a small dungeon bound in chains," Kaelith explained, staring at Kent with respect and gratitude as he hugged Sylvara and Vey.
Ignarok sighed. "I am sorry, Kaelith. We knew you had been captured, but we were too weak to come to your rescue."

Kaelith patted the red-haired dragon man on the shoulder. "Good thing you guys didn’t come. My arrest was to get the movement technique my mother had given me and to find out how I managed to awaken all those innate talents.
"They knew I returned to the Immortal Realm with you guys, so if you had come, they would have captured you too."

"Bastards. I will smash their heads in one of these days," Balrion said, clenching his fist as veins popped on his arms. He was a mountain of a man, so naturally, his brute strength was something else entirely.
"Then it is a good thing you guys are here. Big Brother said we will be going for revenge soon."
"Good. I can’t wait to breathe some flames on them." Ignarok also clenched his fist.
Orvath punched the air and muttered coldly, "I will smash their faces in."
Just then, the ladies had had enough of Kent and pulled back.
"You were very cruel to us, Kent. You said we would meet you soon, but it has been 300,003 years," Sylvara said with a pout.
"Yeah, do you know how long we have been waiting? I was so bored I nearly burned my entire family to cinders," Vey also made Kent aware of her frustration.
He just smiled and hugged them again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1654: Catching Up
paragraphs: Calming down two deadly beauties was something Kent had mastered after spending time with some of the most dangerous vixens in the universe. So Sylvara and Vey were easy nuts to crack.
Even so, it took him ten minutes to calm them down.
Back at the Flame Sea, he and Queen Sylvara had become a couple after spending some quality time together in her cave dwelling.
However, Vey and Zeraphine only began to develop feelings for him when he was about to return to the future. He spent some time with them, but the closest they got was kissing.
So one could only wonder how they survived the last 300,000 years without him, especially Sylvara, who only got to be with him through her true clone.
She had tasted true love, and so for the past 300,000 years, she had been craving him.
So seeing him again took their breath away. Thankfully, Kent had a fix.
"Relax, ladies. Let’s catch up first, then we can spend some quality time together."
Hearing what he said, they blushed and nodded.
Kent smiled and finally turned his focus to the others. "Good to see you guys again."
Orvath, Balrion, and Ignarok nodded.
"It is nice to see you again, Young Master," Ignarok replied, his happiness overflowing.
Despite being the son of a very powerful Dragon Monarch, Ignarok saw Kent as his one true master, considering he was once the Primordial Chaos Dragon, an existence all dragons looked up to.
Over the years, even when he heard nothing from Kent, he never once doubted whether Kent was still alive.
He knew the Chaos Dragon was no ordinary dragon, so he held onto the hope that one day he would meet him again.
"I am sorry for being late. I had some business to handle in the High World before ascending."

"The Master has nothing to apologize for. 300,000 years wasn’t that long anyway," Balrion said with a laugh. He had missed Kent, but he wasn’t about to admit that, especially not in front of his friends.

Kent laughed. "Anyway, why don’t we take a walk while you update me on what you have been up to for the past 300,000 years? Aside from Kaelith, who managed to get himself caught, what have you guys been up to?"
They all laughed, and Ignarok spoke first.
"After we left the High World, we all arrived in the Eastern Galaxy. However, we separated since humans aren’t welcome in the Beast Kingdom.

"So after we separated from them, we seven first established ourselves in the Beast Kingdom. Afterward, we started pursuing our own goals. I joined the Beast Kingdom Guard Watch and worked my way up to becoming a Guard Captain.

"This was so I could learn more about the hierarchy within the Beast Kingdom. What I found, however, was very interesting. Apparently, the ruler of the Beast Kingdom was once a member of the Divine Beast Tamer’s Divine Wonders Legion.
"They said he is an Overlord Beast and one of the most powerful existences in the entire universe."
Kent nodded and smiled. When he created the Beast Kingdom, he made it so it could be accessed from the Immortal Realm all the way to the Celestial Realm.

It was akin to a unique world, but to protect the balance of power, he divided it into four sections. So hearing that there was an Overlord whom even Immortal-level beasts were aware of made him happy.
He planned to bring all 13 Divine Wonders back, so learning where one is made made him happy.
"What about you, Balrion?"

Balrion smiled. "I wandered around, most of it spent watching over this troublemaker." He looked at Vey, who pouted and turned away. "I wanted to temper my combat power, so I spent most of my time traveling around."

"I also traveled around honing my combat power. Most of my time was spent exploring ruins and dungeons. Of course, I tried to go back to my tribe, but I discovered my family had migrated to the Western Galaxy, so I put that on hold for now," Orvath also revealed his whereabouts after arriving in the Immortal Realm.
Kent nodded and turned to Vey. "How about you, Vey?"
She smiled and sighed. "After I left the Beast Kingdom, I returned home to learn more about my mom’s disappearance since I intended to find her one day.

"Of course, at first, I had no problems with my sisters. However, when they discovered I had awakened my Innate Body and Bloodline, they all started jealously watching me. They thought I had returned to claim the throne.

"Later, they started sending assassins after me. Ever since then, it has been one battle after another. I managed to survive the onslaught, but I failed to find out more about my mother’s disappearance."
Kent pulled her closer and hugged her. "Relax, Vey. I will help find your mother."
She nodded and hugged Kent more tightly, causing Sylvara to smirk.
From Faceless Memories, Kent already knew where Vey’s mother had vanished. It was a place called the Sea of Darkness. According to Faceless, the gate to the Lost Realm was located there.
While it was filled with harrowing dangers, he speculated that Vey’s mother might have stumbled upon the gate and been drawn into the Lost Realm.
Kent knew he would have to go there one of these days since one of his Eternal Sword Intents, Bob, happened to be there, locked in the prison of the First Divine Angel Race.
So promising to find Vey’s mother wasn’t a bluff.
"How about you, Sylvara?"
The Serpent Queen smiled and started to reveal what happened after she left the Beast Kingdom.
"I returned home and merged with my main body. Afterward, my mother entered seclusion to try to become a god.

"After she came out, she put me in charge and left for the God Realm to cement her breakthrough. So for the past hundreds of thousands of years, I have been ruling as the Queen of the Divine Serpent Clan.
"She returned two years ago, so I am now free to pursue my own goals."
"Looks like you guys didn’t mess around since we last met." Kent nodded, pleased with how every one of his friends had turned out.
"What about you?" Sylvara asked, and Kent smirked.
"If I start, I won’t finish."
"Just tell us a little."

"Okay." Kent thought for a moment and began. "Let’s see. I managed to put my name on three Dao Tablets, ventured into the Star Realm, and tamed over forty-eight Demigod beasts. I also managed to convert over 100 million Star Beasts into evil beings, met an Ancient Evil, met some legendary figures from another universe, formed two flame cores, two blood cores, awakened many innate talents—"
"That is enough," Vey smirked and turned to her friends. "I guess he has become even more monstrous than before."
"Indeed," Orvath nodded. "Good timing, then. After all, the Chaos Rift is set to open ninety-seven years from now, and with his strength, I am sure he would dominate there."
Kent laughed. "Of course, I will be entering. But first, you guys must become Demigods. I have bad feelings about this Chaos Rift, and so we must prepare."

Kent snapped his fingers, and Alina appeared. She was now even more beautiful, her butt softer, rounder, and bigger. Her overall stature had changed, cementing her position as the one with the best butt in the Dragon Harem.
She had also reached the True Immortal Stage, but when Vey and the others, who were immortal lords, met her gaze, they felt as though she could easily defeat them.
In truth, she could kill them with her formations before they ever reached her. Kent knew all his wives had become monster, but he had yet to know just how monstrous they had become.

The next second, Kaizo also appeared, oozing the power of an Immortal Monarch. Kaizo now had golden hair, and his muscles were far more refined. In his Divine Titan form, he possessed four pairs of metallic golden wings.
"Everyone, meet Alina and Kaizo..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1655: Time with Vey and Sylvara (1)
paragraphs: Kent’s wives and his legions—well, some of them—were already aware of the existence of Ignarok and the other beasts he befriended when he traveled to the past.
In fact, they knew the seven monarchs he met in the flame sea 300,000 plus years ago were his first beast companions.

They had already met Kaelith, so they knew it was only a matter of time before the rest showed up. As for some of his wives, they knew that when he traveled to the past, he found himself surrounded by beauties, just as they had expected.

Aside from Sylvara and Vey, there was Zeraphine, who was now in the Underworld with Nyx. There were also Brianna and Autumn, who had once been a guard and a princess but were actually best friends back then.
There was also Flura, whose pursuit of alchemy had now reached the rank of a Pill Immortal. She had also made a name for herself in the Eastern Galaxy.
There was also Pill Immortal Nefeli, who had ventured to an unknown place to inform her master that a new name had appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet and that she knew who it was.

There were also Lady Veth and Lady Wu, who had become magnets in the world of pill sales and auctions. While they hadn’t shown any interest in him, it wouldn’t have been too shocking if they did, after he left. Especially considering they had enjoyed his generosity for years.
Lastly, there were Lady Kami and Azela, who had also become powerhouses in the Eastern Galaxy after showing everyone that, when it came to the Fate Dao, the mother and daughter excelled.
Basically, he had a lot of reunions ahead of him, so he first wanted to help Vey and those now with him settle in.
Seeing Alina and Kaizo appear, each oozing power, Ignarok and the others knew it was only a matter of time before they also became this powerful.
Alina took Vey and Sylvara by the arms and hugged them. "Welcome, sisters. We have been waiting for your arrival."

Kent knew Vey and Sylvara would be taken away from him, so he allowed Alina to lead them to the Harem Tower. The rest of their sisters were waiting to pollute their minds before they have the first time with him.
"Kaizo, meet Ignarok, Balrion, and Orvath. They were part of Kaelith’s cohort."
"Oh, nice. Welcome, guys. I am Kaizo, first-in-command to Master Kent, so whatever you need, you can ask me, and I will provide."
Ignarok and the others nodded.
"Kaizo is right. Whatever you need, let him know, and you will get it."
"For now, follow him back home and get settled in. I will come back later so we can plan our revenge against Kaelith’s family."𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
They nodded, and Kaizo returned with them to the tower. After they were gone, Kent summoned Axim, his no-good Void Beast, who liked plotting the downfall of armies.

Had it not been for the incident during her ascension ceremony, she would have already left for that place, since finding Safira and bringing her back would bring Kent one step closer to being free of his heart demon.
"I will be leaving for the Underworld tomorrow."
"Then I will also head out tomorrow."
Kent nodded and turned to Indie.
"I hope you are prepared for the journey. You are, after all, going to inherit your throne as the true ruler of the Underworld."
Indie smiled, her ears twitching like the cat she was.
"I am ready. Only by becoming a queen can I regain my divinity and become a goddess again."
"Very well. Then we leave tomorrow, so prepare yourself."

While Kent planned to visit Nyx, the Queen of the Ninth Level of the Underworld, he also wanted to accomplish a second mission: making Indie, his catkin wife and one of the legendary assassins who fought by his side during the Great War, the Underworld Empress once again.
She had been the true ruler of the Underworld back then, but after her death, the Underworld’s authority was divided among the thirteen Underworld Kings and Queens.
Now that she had returned, she had to reclaim her throne and bring order to the underworld once again.
Plus, Kent needed her help to enter the Underworld without passing through the Underworld Soul River as he had initially intended.

"Can I also come?" Miryssa asked, her gaze meeting Kent’s. "I have awakened the Eternal Nether Yin Body and have already reached the Absolute Stage of Nether Ice. Recently, I can tell that if I can cultivate in a place that reeks of death, I will ascend to the Extreme Ice Stage. So can I come?"

"Of course," Indie replied. "There is a place in the Underworld called the Death Garden. It was where I cultivated my killing intent. Since it has been left untouched for billions of years, I am sure it has already become potent enough to aid you."
Miryssa nodded and smiled.
Kent had no objections. He was merely going there to see Nyx, so whoever Indie brought along was none of his concern.
The remaining time was spent talking, with some of his wives occasionally sucking on his dick. In the end, they spent the entire day and night in the Love Garden.
The next day, Kent, Indie, and Miryssa were ready to head to the Underworld.
Inaya was also ready to head to Amon’s Guillotine Cave.
The rest of Kent’s wives came to bid them goodbye on Planet Lumenore, which was now deserted since the elves had migrated to the tower.
"Be careful in there, Inaya. Once you find Safira, leave immediately and return to the tower. Just tell her Chaos sent you. But if she doesn’t believe you, just knock her out and bring her over.
"If the tower can open there, then make sure to use it well since it might save your life."
Inaya nodded and hugged Indie and Miryssa.
"Take care of him while in the Underworld."
Afterward, she hugged Kent and kissed him. She then hugged the rest of her sisters before opening a void portal to leave.
However, just before she stepped into the void, a bald kid appeared.
"I am coming with you, Big Sister."
"Baldy, what are you doing here?" Kent asked, having already been informed that Baldy and his big brother Han had entered seclusion.
"Big Brother Han sent me to accompany Big Sister. He said Big Sister cannot go alone, so I should come with her."
Kent said nothing and turned toward Inaya, who smiled and nodded.
"Come on, Baldy. I could use the company."
"Okay."
He moved toward Inaya, and before long, they vanished into the void.
Kent said nothing and simply turned toward Indie.
"It’s our turn to leave."
Indie nodded and opened a dark portal, reeking of death. The portal released waves of chilling coldness, the kind that could only be achieved through endless killing.
Kent, who was cultivating the Dao of Evil, felt his core resonate with the energy emanating from the portal. The feeling made him excited. He looked forward to what the Underworld had to offer.
"See you, ladies, later."
A few seconds later, he, alongside Indie and Miryssa, vanished into the portal, and it closed behind them.
"Let’s go back and start clearing the dungeons while we wait for their return."
The rest soon returned to the Tower.
[Shore of the River of Styx]

The River of Styx spanned billions of kilometers wide, surrounding the entire Underworld and reaching all thirteen levels. Its vastness, coupled with the resentment dwelling within it, made it one of the most dangerous regions in the Underworld.

When a soul died, it would appear on the shore of the River of Styx, where, depending on its nature and affinity, Grim Reapers would transport it to the level best suited to mold it into an Underworld fiend.
Whenever a person appeared there, it meant they had just died.

However, today, a portal opened and three living beings stepped out, landing softly on the shore. Kent, who was the last to emerge, scanned the vast sea stretching before his eyes, and a strange wave of familiarity washed over him.
’I feel like I have stood here before.’
No memories surfaced, but he instinctively knew he had once stood upon this very shore.
Regardless, he let the thought slide and turned to Indie.
"What next?"
Indie smiled and clapped her hands twice.
"Rise, Yama. Time to get back to work."
Kent felt the sand beneath his feet tremble, and then a wave of decay and death filled the surrounding space.
[Your understanding of Evil Qi has improved slightly.]
Kent ignored the message and narrowed his eyes, watching as ripples began spreading across the surface of the water.
"What is happening?" Miryssa asked, her gaze fixed on the same spot Kent was staring at.
Indie smiled and replied, "You will see in a few seconds."
As the ripples grew increasingly chaotic, the death energy in the atmosphere thickened, causing Kent’s eyes to widen slightly. His evil core rapidly absorbed the energy even as he stood still.
More importantly, his understanding of evil began to broaden. It was as though merely standing there was affecting him.

Suddenly, the topmast of a bone-like pirate ship emerged from the dark waters of the River of Styx. A tan-skinned man clad in tattered trousers and an armless vest stood halfway at the bow, a red scarf tied around his neck and a pirate hat resting lazily atop his head.
As the ship emerged, Kent felt a terrible sense of dread wash over him. Instinctively, he sensed danger from both the ship and the man, but he did not panic.
After all, it was Indie who had summoned him.
Once the ship fully emerged, the man jumped onto the shore and immediately dropped to one knee.
"Greetings, Great Empress. I have awaited your return."
Indie smiled.
"Rise, Yama. I have finally returned, and so, like always, your sleep is over. We have work to do."
Yama nodded and stood up. His dark eyes immediately turn toward Kent. For a brief moment, Kent felt as though the man had read every last thing about him.
A few seconds later, Yama narrowed his eyes.
"It is you."
Kent frowned slightly.
"Have we met before?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1661: Fugitive
paragraphs: Kent became puzzled when Yama recognized him, even though Kent had absolutely no idea who this man was.
Normally, if one of his past incarnations was one of the few in line to be remembered, the moment he encountered someone or something connected to that life, the memories would return to him.

However, not only did he feel a strange familiarity with the Underworld, but Yama had even recognized him. That alone should have been enough to trigger his memories. Yet, as he stood there, not even a whisper of memory surfaced.
Yama furrowed his brow and removed his pirate hat.

"You don’t remember, huh?" A small smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. "Perhaps that is for the best. After all, the Empress has only just returned. We wouldn’t want you causing havoc here again."
"Cause havoc again?" Kent frowned. "Why would I do that?"
Yama chuckled and turned to Indie.
"My lady, let us get on the ship first. I have already informed the Reaper. They will soon arrive to escort you back to the palace."
"Excuse me, Mr. Yama, you still haven’t answered my question," Kent called out, waving at Yama.
The leader of all Grim Reapers in the Underworld laughed. He snapped his fingers, and instantly, they found themselves standing on the bow of the ship.
Yama turned and looked at Kent.

"I cannot say anything since that would interfere with your karma. However, you should know this: you are not welcome here in the Underworld, the Resentful Domain, the Spirit Realm, or even the Undead Realm.

"In fact, you may be pardoned here, but if the Monarch of Resentment, the Undead Emperor, or the Spirit Empress learns that you are back, they would storm this place, and none of us wants that to happen right now, do we?"
"Obviously not," Kent replied, though he could not help wondering just what he had done in the past to become a fugitive in not one realm, but four.
’What exactly did I do to these people to warrant such hostility?’ Kent thought for a few seconds before turning back to Yama, who had already started steering the ship.
"At least tell me this. Since you can tell I reincarnated, can the others also identify me?"

"Your identities rather. No, they cannot," Yama replied. "However, now that you are here, they will all sense that their enemy has returned. Considering they already tracked you down twice before, it won’t take long for them to discover who you are.

"Also, while they cannot identify you now, the moment you recover your memories, they will know instantly. Honestly, it would be best if you wrapped up whatever you came here to do and leave as quickly as possible.
Trust me, the last time, you nearly brought an end to this place and the three other unique realms. They hate you with every passion."

"Looks like you are quite popular here, my love," Indie teased, hugging Kent’s left arm. "Don’t worry. Now that I am back, they wouldn’t dare cause trouble in my domain unless they wish to court death."
Kent nodded and brushed Indie’s hair gently.
"I guess I will have to rely on you to keep me safe, dear."
"I will."
Yama smiled and shook his head inwardly.
’I don’t know where you found this troublemaker from, my lady, but he is bad news for everyone across the Four Planes. I wouldn’t even be surprised if he had also offended the Hell Monarch.’
Knowing it was none of his business, Yama focused on steering the ship.

Kent watched his back and sighed softly. While the Underworld had previously been capped at the Demigod Stage, that was only because the Underworld Queen had been absent. Now that she had returned, things would gradually return to normal.

However, as Kent gazed at Yama, he could tell that even a True Celestial would tremble before him. That alone told him Yama had likely already reached the peak of the Celestial Stage before the Great War during the Primordial Era.
’Indie, dear, what is the deal with Yama? I don’t recognize him from the Great War,’ Kent asked through the connection they shared.
’He was once a pirate who was captured by some of your traitor friends, the universe Guardians, and imprisoned here as you did me.
’When I arrived, he was already among the top ten strongest beings in the Underworld. One thing led to another, and he eventually supported my campaign to reunite the thirteen levels.

’After I became the Empress, I made him the leader of the Grim Reapers and also one of the thirteen Guardians of the Underworld. When I left for the Great War, I left all thirteen of them here to protect my domain. That was why he didn’t participate in the Great War.’
’I see. Then just how strong is he exactly? I feel like he could crush me with just his pinky.’
Indie chuckled.

’Yama was already at the Celestial Supreme Stage when I arrived here as a Demigod. Now that billions of years have passed, who knows? He may have already stepped into the next realm or is halfway there.’
Kent furrowed his brow upon hearing Indie’s answer.
’So you also know about the next realm.’
’I do. Well, I once met someone wielding such power during the Primordial Era.’
’Really?’
’Yes. It was only a brief encounter, but that meeting changed my life.’
’Where did this meeting happen? I would like to seek out this person.’
Indie smiled and shook her head.

’You already asked Big Sister Pandora, but she refused to say anything. That alone should tell you that the next stage is not something they can casually talk about. You even heard what Big Sister said: the more she uses her power, the more damage she causes to this universe.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
’That was why she told you not to pry too deeply into this matter. If you are meant to know, then I am sure you will discover it when the time is right. For now, focus on what you can control.’
Kent smirked, but he nodded.
’You are right. Sorry for bothering you.’
Indie rested her head on his shoulder and transmitted softly.
’You could never bother me, my love.’
Miryssa knew Kent and Indie were conversing mentally, but she neither interrupted nor attempted to join in.
Indie turned slightly and looked at Kent, who was focused on something invisible before him.
’It is good you do not know just yet, my love. If you learned that the one I met was a Forsaken, who knows what you would do?’
It was a well-known fact that the Primordial Chaos Dragon hated all Forsaken beings. As a result, he would do anything, even risk his own life, to eradicate them.
Because of that, Indie and her sisters had decided not to say anything for now. If what they had discovered was true, Kent might go mad with guilt.
For now, they were all waiting for Inaya and Baldy to bring Safira back. Once she arrived, everything would finally be revealed.

They believed that while they could never extinguish Kent’s hatred for the Forsaken race, now that Elina had returned, they would at least be able to make him think logically before making his next move.

A few minutes into their journey, Kent saw countless green lanterns slowly drifting toward them. Moments later, silhouettes of hooded figures standing at the bows of their boats became visible, scythes resting upon their shoulders.
The moment they came within 200 meters, the hooded figures, numbering over a thousand, all went to one knee.
"We welcome the Underworld Empress back to the Land of the Dead!"
Indie moved away from Kent and stopped beside Yama.
"Rise, everyone. I know it has been hard on all of you during the years I was away. But I am back now, and as promised, we shall soon throw the grandest party ever."
"YEEEEEEEYYYYYY!"
And just like that, Kent completely lost faith in the Grim Reapers and their Empress.

However, you should know this: you are not welcome here in the Underworld, the Resentful Domain, the Spirit Realm, or even the Undead Realm.

"In fact, you may be pardoned here, but if the Monarch of Resentment, the Undead Emperor, or the Spirit Empress learns that you are back, they would storm this place, and none of us wants that to happen right now, do we?"
"Obviously not," Kent replied, though he could not help wondering just what he had done in the past to become a fugitive in not one realm, but four.
’What exactly did I do to these people to warrant such hostility?’ Kent thought for a few seconds before turning back to Yama, who had already started steering the ship.
"At least tell me this.
Since you can tell I reincarnated, can the others also identify me?"
"Your identities rather.
No, they cannot," Yama replied.
"However, now that you are here, they will all sense that their enemy has returned.
Considering they already tracked you down twice before, it won’t take long for them to discover who you are.
"Also, while they cannot identify you now, the moment you recover your memories, they will know instantly.
Honestly, it would be best if you wrapped up whatever you came here to do and leave as quickly as possible.
Trust me, the last time, you nearly brought an end to this place and the three other unique realms.
They hate you with every passion."
"Looks like you are quite popular here, my love," Indie teased, hugging Kent’s left arm.
"Don’t worry.
Now that I am back, they wouldn’t dare cause trouble in my domain unless they wish to court death."
Kent nodded and brushed Indie’s hair gently.
"I guess I will have to rely on you to keep me safe, dear."
"I will."
Yama smiled and shook his head inwardly.
’I don’t know where you found this troublemaker from, my lady, but he is bad news for everyone across the Four Planes.
I wouldn’t even be surprised if he had also offended the Hell Monarch.’
Knowing it was none of his business, Yama focused on steering the ship.
Kent watched his back and sighed softly.
While the Underworld had previously been capped at the Demigod Stage, that was only because the Underworld Queen had been absent.
Now that she had returned, things would gradually return to normal.
However, as Kent gazed at Yama, he could tell that even a True Celestial would tremble before him.
That alone told him Yama had likely already reached the peak of the Celestial Stage before the Great War during the Primordial Era.
’Indie, dear, what is the deal with Yama?
I don’t recognize him from the Great War,’ Kent asked through the connection they shared.
’He was once a pirate who was captured by some of your traitor friends, the universe Guardians, and imprisoned here as you did me.
’When I arrived, he was already among the top ten strongest beings in the Underworld.
One thing led to another, and he eventually supported my campaign to reunite the thirteen levels.
’After I became the Empress, I made him the leader of the Grim Reapers and also one of the thirteen Guardians of the Underworld.
When I left for the Great War, I left all thirteen of them here to protect my domain.
That was why he didn’t participate in the Great War.’
’I see.
Then just how strong is he exactly?
I feel like he could crush me with just his pinky.’
Indie chuckled.
’Yama was already at the Celestial Supreme Stage when I arrived here as a Demigod.
Now that billions of years have passed, who knows?
He may have already stepped into the next realm or is halfway there.’
Kent furrowed his brow upon hearing Indie’s answer.
’So you also know about the next realm.’
’I do.
Well, I once met someone wielding such power during the Primordial Era.’
’Really?’
’Yes.
It was only a brief encounter, but that meeting changed my life.’
’Where did this meeting happen?
I would like to seek out this person.’
Indie smiled and shook her head.
’You already asked Big Sister Pandora, but she refused to say anything.
That alone should tell you that the next stage is not something they can casually talk about.
You even heard what Big Sister said: the more she uses her power, the more damage she causes to this universe.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
’That was why she told you not to pry too deeply into this matter.
If you are meant to know, then I am sure you will discover it when the time is right.
For now, focus on what you can control.’
Kent smirked, but he nodded.
’You are right.
Sorry for bothering you.’
Indie rested her head on his shoulder and transmitted softly.
’You could never bother me, my love.’
Miryssa knew Kent and Indie were conversing mentally, but she neither interrupted nor attempted to join in.
Indie turned slightly and looked at Kent, who was focused on something invisible before him.
’It is good you do not know just yet, my love.
If you learned that the one I met was a Forsaken, who knows what you would do?’
It was a well-known fact that the Primordial Chaos Dragon hated all Forsaken beings.
As a result, he would do anything, even risk his own life, to eradicate them.
Because of that, Indie and her sisters had decided not to say anything for now.
If what they had discovered was true, Kent might go mad with guilt.
For now, they were all waiting for Inaya and Baldy to bring Safira back.
Once she arrived, everything would finally be revealed.

They believed that while they could never extinguish Kent’s hatred for the Forsaken race, now that Elina had returned, they would at least be able to make him think logically before making his next move.
A few minutes into their journey, Kent saw countless green lanterns slowly drifting toward them.
Moments later, silhouettes of hooded figures standing at the bows of their boats became visible, scythes resting upon their shoulders.
The moment they came within 200 meters, the hooded figures, numbering over a thousand, all went to one knee.
"We welcome the Underworld Empress back to the Land of the Dead!"
Indie moved away from Kent and stopped beside Yama.
"Rise, everyone.
I know it has been hard on all of you during the years I was away.
But I am back now, and as promised, we shall soon throw the grandest party ever."
"YEEEEEEEYYYYYY!"
And just like that, Kent completely lost faith in the Grim Reapers and their Empress.

chapters.title: Chapter 1662: Arriving in the Underworld
paragraphs: Kent obviously wasn’t expecting to hear Indie casually announce that they would be throwing a party in the Underworld. The very first thought that crossed his mind was:
"Isn’t the Underworld supposed to be a place of torture and pain?"

But he had already been to Hell and had seen firsthand that not everything people said about such places when he was on Earth turned out to be true. Still, hearing about a party in the Underworld was definitely a first for him.
However, for some reason, he wasn’t too surprised by it either. A part of him already seemed to know something of this sort would happen or had happened many times before.
So, as he watched the Grim Reapers cheering excitedly, he could only smile.
’Indie is too cheerful for an Empress. I’d better leave some Shadow Fiends to protect her before leaving.’
Kent paused, then his gaze turned to Yama, who was smiling back at him.
A cold sweat broke out across his back.
’Damn, this bastard gives me the creeps.’

He turned his gaze away from him and decided to scan the vast, dark sea stretching as far as the eye could see. Out of curiosity, Kent activated the [Soul Map] and scanned a 200,000-kilometer radius, but aside from the Grim Reapers, he saw nothing else.
After counting the number of Grim Reapers, he deactivated the Soul Map and sat beside Miryssa, who was seated on a barrel filled with Hell Wine and Underworld Mead.
The boats soon surrounded Yama’s massive bone ship, their green lanterns casting eerie lights across the dark waters of the River of Styx.
Countless Grim Reapers stared toward Indie with excitement and reverence burning in their hollow eyes.
Some trembled emotionally.
Others openly cried.
To them, Indie was more than just an Empress.
Before she was imprisoned in the Underworld by the Chaos Dragon, all of them had been fugitives locked in the Abyss, a place where the worst beings of the Underworld were kept.
Indie freed them when she became Empress and turned them into Grim Reapers, since many had died during the war to unite the thirteen levels of the Underworld.
So they were eternally grateful to her.

She was the ruler who united the thirteen levels of the Underworld during one of its bloodiest eras. Before her reign, the Underworld had been nothing more than a lawless land where the strong endlessly devoured the weak.
It was Indie who had changed that and became a true authority and symbol of hope for them.
Kent could already tell just how deeply she was loved here.
"My lady!"
One of the Grim Reapers suddenly shouted emotionally, his voice spreading across the vast River of Styx.
"When are we slaughtering those idiots from the Abyss Kingdom? I heard they’ve started growing a pair in recent years. The barrier still holds, but it won’t be for long."
The surrounding Grim Reapers instantly erupted into cheers.
"Yes! Slaughter,"
"Rip their souls apart,"
"Burn their bones,"
Kent’s smile froze slightly.
"Never mind," he muttered. "This feels more like the Underworld now."
Miryssa covered her mouth and laughed softly.
Meanwhile, Indie raised her hand calmly, instantly silencing the thousands of Grim Reapers.
"We are not starting a war yet," she said firmly.
A wave of disappointed sighs spread across the river.
"Yet?" Kent immediately caught the important word.
Indie ignored him and continued speaking.
"For now, I have returned for two reasons. First, to reclaim the throne that belongs to me. Second..."
Her deep blue eyes slowly narrowed.

"To remind certain people why they feared me in the first place. I heard some idiots calling themselves the Underworld King and Queen and saying they don’t want to bow to me. We will see soon who will be bowing and who won’t."
The moment those words fell, the atmosphere changed instantly.
The death energy in the surroundings became heavier. Kent felt his Evil Core activate as more energy was channeled into it, strengthening his understanding of Evil.
As the environment grew more chaotic, even the waters of the River of Styx began trembling violently.
Kent raised an eyebrow.
For the first time since arriving in the Underworld, he finally saw traces of the terrifying ruler Indie had once been during the Primordial Era.
The playful catgirl who loved cuddling him and sleeping on his chest vanished completely.

Standing before the Grim Reapers now was a genuine Empress, the one who, during the Primordial Era, made him grow uneasy even after he imprisoned her in the underworld. So he had to descend to have a nice chat with her.
Even Yama lowered his head slightly in respect.
"We welcome the return of the Empress of Death."
The Grim Reapers all slammed their scythes against their boats simultaneously.
BOOOOM!
The sound echoed across the endless sea like thunder, reaching all thirteen levels of the Underworld. Everyone felt it; the Empress is back, and she had returned with a bang.
Kent glanced toward Indie and smiled faintly.
’You really were amazing back then, huh?’ he smirked.
Then, shamelessly, he added, ’I guess I was right to imprison you in the Underworld back then. This can all be attributed to my incredible foresight.’
If Indie were to hear what he had just said, she might throw him overboard to be eaten by the resentful souls within the River of Styx.
"Lead the way, guys. We have a job to do."
"Right away, Underworld Empress."
Soon, they started moving, now surrounded by thousands of boats, each carrying a green lantern and a Grim Reaper standing at the bow.
Indie returned to Kent’s side.
"How did I do?"
"Terrifying, just like how an Underworld Empress is supposed to be," Kent replied, brushing his hand through her hair.
Indie smiled and hugged him, choosing to remain in Kent’s arms for the rest of the journey.
Meanwhile, somewhere in the Supreme Realm, Inaya and Baldy stepped out of a void portal and quickly made their way toward a mountain range.
After a few hours of travel, they arrived in a valley where thousands of Supremes and Gods could be seen populating the area.
Looking closely, they noticed that nearly fifty percent of the people present were clad in uniforms bearing the same badge.
The others wore a different badge.
Inaya also sensed the presence of Celestials, so she refrained from using her Supreme senses to investigate what was happening around the gateway to Amon’s Guillotine Cave.
Seeing the various badges, it was obvious that they belonged to different sects.
Inaya and Baldy landed two kilometers away and started walking toward the gathered crowd. After a few minutes, they approached a True God clad in a green cloak.
"Excuse me, can you tell me what is going on?"
If Inaya had been a God, he might have ignored her. However, seeing that she was a Supreme, the True God replied,
"Three months ago, a core disciple from the Heavenly Dragon Sword Sect returned from Amon’s Guillotine Cave and reported that he had discovered the presence of a Primordial Beast.

"He believes it has undergone a rebirth and may already be in a weakened state. He came to inform us, but somehow, the Purple Void Sword Sect got wind of it and is now demanding that half of their team be allowed entry."
"Allowed entry? Isn’t Amon’s Guillotine Cave free to enter?" Inaya frowned.
"That was before. Twenty thousand years ago, the Celestial Supreme placed a seal on it, allowing only one hundred entries every ten years."
"How troublesome," Inaya muttered and immediately reached out to Vexthra and the rest of her sisters.
’That is indeed troublesome. Those people won’t just stand aside and let you two enter.’
’Indeed,’ Inaya responded, looking toward the gateway.
’If I reveal my identity now, they may allow entry, but word would spread, and my return would become a bit more chaotic.’
Suddenly, Inaya sensed a pair of eyes land on her from the left.
Turning sharply, her eyes met those of a pink-haired incubus seated on a stone platform, casually sucking on a lollipop.
The man raised his hand and waved at her.
Before she could respond, Baldy vanished and appeared in the pink-haired man’s arms, hugging him.
’Huh?’

chapters.title: Chapter 1663: Mak
paragraphs: ’Inaya, what is wrong?’ Vexthra’s voice rang out in Inaya’s head in response to her sudden, stunned reaction.
’Hold on, sisters. Let me check something out first.’

Inaya moved toward the pink-haired man whose arms Baldy had jumped into. She didn’t seem alarmed since she knew Baldy was stronger than she was. What took her aback was the fact that Baldy had no guard up at all.
’Is he one of his big brothers?’ she wondered.
After all, Kent had told her that he had created seven powerful beings from the Eternal Sword Intent he had formed.
If that were the case, then fine.
However, she kept her guard up as she approached him.
Just as she arrived, Baldy pulled back with a smile on his face and turned to face her.
"Big Sister, meet Big Brother Mak. He is my favorite Big Brother after Big Brother Kent."
Inaya could tell that Baldy was very happy to have reunited with his big brother.
"Hi, my name is Mak, Baldy’s big brother," Mak introduced himself, flashing a handsome smile. If Inaya were an ordinary person, she would have been charmed by that smile.
"I am Inaya—"
"The Ten Emotions Sword Supreme," Mak said, revealing that he was already aware of Inaya’s identity.
He knew who she was, and that alone showed that he knew more than Inaya did.
"Have we met before?" Inaya asked, but Mak shook his head.
"No. However, I watched over you for two eras, so I know quite a lot about you."
Mak smiled and stood up, lifting Baldy’s tiny body onto his shoulder.
"Let’s walk and talk. I can get us inside the Calamity Zone." Mak said, showing he planned to accompany them.
He started walking toward the gateway with Baldy on his shoulder.
Inaya sighed and followed.
Inwardly, she reached out to her sisters again.
’False alarm, sisters. Baldy just reunited with one of his big brothers.’
’Another one?’ Val asked.
’Yes, and he looks even stronger than Han. He also said he can get me into the Calamity Zone.’𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
’Good luck, then.’
What Inaya didn’t know was that Han, just like Pandora, also had to restrict his power, or else he risked weakening the fabric of the universe, letting the enemy in ahead of schedule.
Inaya caught up with Mak and Baldy.
"When you said you watched over me for two eras, what did you mean?"
"I meant exactly what I said. I was tasked by Big Brother Jest to watch over you while he was gone.
"So I did. I disguised myself and followed you wherever you went, protecting you from the shadows until all the dangers surrounding you had died down.
"Afterward, I started traveling from one star system to another, living my best life."
Inaya sighed.
She had hated Jest for abandoning her during the Divine Era.
However, after learning what had happened and seeing firsthand the trouble he went through just to make it up to her, she hated herself for ever hating him.
Now, it seemed that the only reason she had not been in too much danger after Jest died was that he had left behind a guardian angel—more like a guardian incubus—to watch over her.
’That dumb bastard.’
A tear fell from her eyes, but she quickly wiped it away before Baldy and Mak could see it.
"Big Brother, where have you been all this time? You stopped visiting me. I was very bored and lonely," Baldy complained, pulling on Mak’s perfectly combed pink hair.

"I am sorry, Baldy. After the Blood Era, I was trapped in a Primordial Ruin and lost track of time. By the time I returned, many eras had passed, so I figured you had long since left to explore the universe like the rest of us."
"I didn’t go anywhere, Big Brother. I remained on Planet Brymrr and continued to wait for Big Brother’s return."
"I am sorry, Baldy. If I had known, I would have come for you," Mak said apologetically.
He doted on Baldy the most because he found him adorable.
Initially, they had all thought Baldy would grow up. However, after a few centuries had passed and he remained the same, they realized that he would remain that way forever.

They wanted to stay with him, but with the missions they had been given, they knew that staying in one place wouldn’t help any of them. So they left, and thus, he was left alone in the safest place they knew.
Inaya sighed inwardly, knowing exactly how Baldy might have felt. After all, she had also waited just like him, waiting for someone who never showed up.
’At least we are all happy now, and that is what matters.’
After walking for a few minutes, they started drawing attention. However, just as many were about to complain, Mak released a trace of his Sword Intent, instantly shutting them all up.
After ten minutes, they arrived before the gateway, where ten Sword Celestials stood, and from the look of things, they were engaged in a heated argument.
The moment they arrived, the ten Sword Celestials turned and stared at them, their arrogant expressions evident.
"Who the fuck are you three, and can’t you see we are in the middle of something important?"
Mak raised an eyebrow and turned to Baldy.
"Do you want to reply to them, or should I?"
"I will."
Baldy jumped down from Mak’s shoulder and smirked.
"We have eyes that can see perfectly, but we just don’t give a fuck. Now, if you ten losers are done wasting our time, kindly get the fuck out of the way. We are in a hurry here."
The faces of the ten Sword Celestials and the disciples around them turned ashen.
"IMPUDENCE!"
One of the ten Sword Celestials shouted, his hand moving toward his sword.
However, he couldn’t reach it before Mak pointed his right index finger forward, and a beam of Sword Intent shot out, landing on the man’s forehead.
He froze in place, a pale look appearing on his face.
Seeing this, the nine remaining Sword Celestials, along with the disciples and those around them, panicked and took a step back.
"All talk, no bite," Baldy muttered.
Then he scoffed and turned to Inaya.
"Big Sister, let’s go."
Inaya nodded and started following Baldy and Mak.
When they got close to the frozen Sword Celestial, Mak tapped him on the forehead, and he regained control of his body.
"Be sure to remember this face. The next time you dare raise your weapon against me, I will cut your body into several pieces. By the time I am done, all that will remain of you will be blood."
The Sword Celestial trembled and staggered backward, losing his footing and landing on his butt.
"What a chicken," Baldy smirked and walked past him.
A few seconds later, they entered the gateway and disappeared.
Only after they were gone did everyone breathe a sigh of relief.
"Who were they?" a Sword Celestial asked, his body still tense even after Baldy, Mak, and Inaya had left.
"How would I know? This is my first time seeing any of them."
The other Celestials also shook their heads.
"I know two of them."
Suddenly, a Sword Supreme disciple shouted.
"I recognized the bald kid and the purple-haired lady from an incident that happened on a Unique World a couple of months ago."
"You don’t mean—"
"Yes. The kid was there, and the lady is the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme who recently underwent her Supreme Ascension."
"Damn."
Inaya tried to keep a low profile, but in the end, Baldy exposed her identity.
"Inform the elders. We have to get ahead of this now."
Disciples from both sects immediately left to inform their elders.
For someone who had reached the 30th layer to appear here, many wanted the chance to speak with her and seek guidance, while others still hoped to get their hands on her.
