I can get us inside the Calamity Zone." Mak said, showing he planned to accompany them.
He started walking toward the gateway with Baldy on his shoulder.
Inaya sighed and followed.
Inwardly, she reached out to her sisters again.
’False alarm, sisters.
Baldy just reunited with one of his big brothers.’
’Another one?’ Val asked.
’Yes, and he looks even stronger than Han.
He also said he can get me into the Calamity Zone.’𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
’Good luck, then.’
What Inaya didn’t know was that Han, just like Pandora, also had to restrict his power, or else he risked weakening the fabric of the universe, letting the enemy in ahead of schedule.
Inaya caught up with Mak and Baldy.
"When you said you watched over me for two eras, what did you mean?"
"I meant exactly what I said.
I was tasked by Big Brother Jest to watch over you while he was gone.
"So I did.
I disguised myself and followed you wherever you went, protecting you from the shadows until all the dangers surrounding you had died down.
"Afterward, I started traveling from one star system to another, living my best life."
Inaya sighed.
She had hated Jest for abandoning her during the Divine Era.
However, after learning what had happened and seeing firsthand the trouble he went through just to make it up to her, she hated herself for ever hating him.
Now, it seemed that the only reason she had not been in too much danger after Jest died was that he had left behind a guardian angel—more like a guardian incubus—to watch over her.
’That dumb bastard.’
A tear fell from her eyes, but she quickly wiped it away before Baldy and Mak could see it.
"Big Brother, where have you been all this time?
You stopped visiting me.
I was very bored and lonely," Baldy complained, pulling on Mak’s perfectly combed pink hair.
"I am sorry, Baldy.
After the Blood Era, I was trapped in a Primordial Ruin and lost track of time.
By the time I returned, many eras had passed, so I figured you had long since left to explore the universe like the rest of us."
"I didn’t go anywhere, Big Brother.
I remained on Planet Brymrr and continued to wait for Big Brother’s return."
"I am sorry, Baldy.
If I had known, I would have come for you," Mak said apologetically.
He doted on Baldy the most because he found him adorable.
Initially, they had all thought Baldy would grow up.
However, after a few centuries had passed and he remained the same, they realized that he would remain that way forever.
They wanted to stay with him, but with the missions they had been given, they knew that staying in one place wouldn’t help any of them.
So they left, and thus, he was left alone in the safest place they knew.
Inaya sighed inwardly, knowing exactly how Baldy might have felt.
After all, she had also waited just like him, waiting for someone who never showed up.
’At least we are all happy now, and that is what matters.’
After walking for a few minutes, they started drawing attention.
However, just as many were about to complain, Mak released a trace of his Sword Intent, instantly shutting them all up.
After ten minutes, they arrived before the gateway, where ten Sword Celestials stood, and from the look of things, they were engaged in a heated argument.
The moment they arrived, the ten Sword Celestials turned and stared at them, their arrogant expressions evident.
"Who the fuck are you three, and can’t you see we are in the middle of something important?"
Mak raised an eyebrow and turned to Baldy.
"Do you want to reply to them, or should I?"
"I will."
Baldy jumped down from Mak’s shoulder and smirked.
"We have eyes that can see perfectly, but we just don’t give a fuck.
Now, if you ten losers are done wasting our time, kindly get the fuck out of the way.
We are in a hurry here."
The faces of the ten Sword Celestials and the disciples around them turned ashen.
"IMPUDENCE!"
One of the ten Sword Celestials shouted, his hand moving toward his sword.
However, he couldn’t reach it before Mak pointed his right index finger forward, and a beam of Sword Intent shot out, landing on the man’s forehead.
He froze in place, a pale look appearing on his face.
Seeing this, the nine remaining Sword Celestials, along with the disciples and those around them, panicked and took a step back.
"All talk, no bite," Baldy muttered.
Then he scoffed and turned to Inaya.
"Big Sister, let’s go."
Inaya nodded and started following Baldy and Mak.
When they got close to the frozen Sword Celestial, Mak tapped him on the forehead, and he regained control of his body.
"Be sure to remember this face.
The next time you dare raise your weapon against me, I will cut your body into several pieces.
By the time I am done, all that will remain of you will be blood."
The Sword Celestial trembled and staggered backward, losing his footing and landing on his butt.
"What a chicken," Baldy smirked and walked past him.
A few seconds later, they entered the gateway and disappeared.
Only after they were gone did everyone breathe a sigh of relief.
"Who were they?" a Sword Celestial asked, his body still tense even after Baldy, Mak, and Inaya had left.
"How would I know?
This is my first time seeing any of them."
The other Celestials also shook their heads.
"I know two of them."
Suddenly, a Sword Supreme disciple shouted.
"I recognized the bald kid and the purple-haired lady from an incident that happened on a Unique World a couple of months ago."
"You don’t mean—"
"Yes.
The kid was there, and the lady is the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme who recently underwent her Supreme Ascension."
"Damn."
Inaya tried to keep a low profile, but in the end, Baldy exposed her identity.
"Inform the elders.
We have to get ahead of this now."
Disciples from both sects immediately left to inform their elders.
For someone who had reached the 30th layer to appear here, many wanted the chance to speak with her and seek guidance, while others still hoped to get their hands on her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1664: Underworld Palace
paragraphs: After sailing for three days, a large mansion painted gold and jade white appeared on the horizon, standing within the clouds.
It was vast and majestic, something that gave Kent an idea of how to build his own mansion when all was said and done and he returned to the tower to create his own family of mini dragons.

As they drew closer, Kent saw seven masked women standing at the main gate. He recognized them as the Seven Silent Claws, Indie’s immediate warriors and seven of the most dangerous guards she had ever had.
Long before they were imprisoned by Chaos, they had been her team during her delinquent days, when she robbed and killed those who dared to step out of line.
Most of her kills were justified; however, her team had grown more chaotic, so they had to be punished.
They were imprisoned in the Underworld with her, and they remained by her side through all the ups and downs until she became who she was meant to be, the Underworld Empress.
Now that Kent’s sight had improved greatly, he was able to see deeper into the seven ladies and knew that, just like Yama, they were also Celestials suppressed to the Universal God stage.
He said nothing, but inwardly, he knew leaving Indie there would be okay. She had powerful guards surrounding her. Unless the threat was external, none of them would raise their weapons against her.
After thirty minutes, they arrived at a dock made entirely of bones and skulls.
Yama docked the ship and created a bone bridge for Indie to get down. Kent and Miryssa followed, feeling the gazes of thousands of Grim Reapers locked onto them.
"We welcome the Underworld Empress back to the Underworld," the Seven Silent Claws said, kneeling on one knee.
"Rise, ladies."
They nodded, heeding Indie’s command, and stood up before moving toward her.
"Welcome back, Empress. We have already made arrangements for your return."
"I knew you ladies wouldn’t disappoint me," Indie laughed, turning to Kent and Miryssa. "You have already met Kent, my husband."
They nodded and greeted him. "Welcome to the Underworld, Lord Chaos."
"Glad to be here. I hope you’re all well," Kent responded and followed up with his own question as a way of easing the mood.
"Yes, we are, Lord Chaos. Thank you for taking care of the Empress for us."
Kent nodded. "No need to thank me. It is my responsibility as her husband, after all."

Indie smiled and turned to Miryssa. "This is one of my sisters. She also wielded the Pure Yin Body, but has fully awakened it and is here to cultivate her ice element. Ladies, meet Miryssa, a member of the 13 Chronicles of the Storm."
Kent saw shock appear in the eyes of the seven ladies, especially Elwen, who also possessed the Pure Yin Body.
"How did you awaken it?"
She asked. Then, looking at the smiles on Indie’s and Miryssa’s faces, she smiled and turned toward Kent.
"Maybe we should go inside first," Soryan, the succubus in the group, suggested, and they started moving inside.
Yama and the Grim Reapers followed.

They wanted to witness the awakening that would occur the moment Indie sat on her throne, so they followed her inside and, after a few minutes’ walk, arrived at the main gate leading to a large hall where a red-and-white throne sat.
A large red carpet stretched from the gate to the throne.
Indie, surrounded by her seven guards, was the first to enter. As they moved forward, the lights in the hall flickered, illuminating the beautiful chamber filled with jade-like miniature thrones.
While the main throne sat upon an elevated platform, seven thrones lined the left side and six lined the right, showing that this was the space reserved for the 13 Underworld Kings and Queens.
Beyond that were thousands of chairs reserved for meetings. Each chair bore a name, something that instantly caught Kent’s attention.
He recognized none of the names, but he knew they were meant for the people she intended to invite once she inherited her throne.
"Tell me, ladies, who still resists my return?" Indie asked as she walked toward her throne.

Morrigan answered, spinning her scepter. "The one who calls himself the Underworld God has managed to rally nine of the thirteen layers to support his delusion that he is the one true ruler of the Underworld."

"However, four remain loyal. The Queen of the Eleventh Layer, Nyx, alongside the King of the Tenth Layer, Fenrik, the King of the Ninth Layer, Ronan, and the Queen of the Third Layer, Lonia, rejected his offer."

"They are currently under attack because he plans to use force to win them over. As you instructed, we have been providing aid from the shadows. However, now that you are here, I suppose that will change."
"That is only right," Indie muttered. Then she asked, "Did you manage to uncover the identity of the one claiming to be the Underworld God?"
"Yes, Empress. He is one of the strays who remained after the war with the Abyss."
"So he is an Abysskin, huh? I had my suspicions, but to think he was indeed from such a place." Indie smirked and turned to Yama. "You already know what to do."
Yama nodded and vanished into thin air.

Soon, Indie arrived before her throne, and with a gentle brush of her hand along the armrest, she sat down. The moment she did, her clothes transformed into a beautiful golden gown adorned with numerous ornaments.

It covered her body up to her neck but left enough space to reveal her beautiful bust. She was heavy in both the chest and hips, something that had always made Kent wonder how she could remain so agile when she carried such a body.
Kent and Miryssa sat in two chairs bearing their names.
At that moment, Elwen appeared from the side carrying a golden crown.

Indie gestured for her to wait. "Let’s call all thirteen Underworld Kings and Queens here to witness my ascension. I also want to use this moment to show them who is in charge and determine who among them will be stripped of their authority."
Elwen nodded and turned to Xersa, the most elusive among them.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂
Xersa nodded and tapped into her authority as an Empress Guard. Her voice spread across all thirteen layers of the Underworld.
"You have been summoned to the Underworld Palace to bear witness to the ascension of the one true Underworld Empress."
"You and seven of your most loyal aides will be transported here in five minutes."
The moment she finished speaking, the thousands of Grim Reapers transformed into bats and entered the walls, becoming paintings.
This caused Kent to raise a brow, clearly not looking forward to such a disguise.
He turned and looked at Indie, who was smiling back at him.
’Don’t you want to disguise yourself? Nyx is coming here in a few minutes.’
Indie’s voice entered Kent’s mind.
’I guess you’re right.’
Tapping into his Evil Core, he changed his clothing from blue into a black pair of trousers and a long-sleeved leather outfit. His hair also changed, turning black and braided on the left side.
Black tendrils that appeared both metallic and leathery flowed behind him like a cape, while a half-mask covered his face from his eyes down to his nose.
"How do I look?" he asked.
"Like a death agent."
Kent smirked.
Five minutes later, the first underworld king appeared wearing a grin.

chapters.title: Chapter 1665: Ascension of the Underworld Empress (1)
paragraphs: The first to appear was, of course, the King of the First Layer of the Underworld, Rellius, the King of Ashes. He was a towering man clad in black armor forged from volcanic stone.
His hair was dark and short, and a crown with spikes was carefully placed on his head. His eyes burned like molten lava, and ash constantly fell from his body.
Looking down, however, the falling ash did not seem to dirty the ground. This led Kent to conclude that the ash was merely his aura made tangible yet illusory.

Accompanying him were seven demigod warriors who, from Kent’s perspective, would all become Supremes when the seal on their cultivation was finally lifted, with perhaps a few reaching the Celestial Realm. As for King Rellius, he would undoubtedly enter the realm of a peak Celestial.
His gaze burned with arrogance and disgust, something the Seven Silent Claws did not take kindly to. However, Indie stopped them before they could take any action.
Instead, she smiled and gestured toward the chair reserved for him.
"Welcome to my palace. You may sit and wait for the others to arrive."
"Tch."
King Rellius smirked before walking over and taking his seat. His guards stood behind him, their auras filling the throne room.
Kent found their behavior somewhat amusing. In his opinion, demigods should not display such arrogance in front of the seven Universal Gods.
However, they looked arrogant and defiant, a clear sign that they did not take Indie seriously.
’How laughable. I wonder where their arrogance is coming from.’
He smirked and turned toward the next person to arrive.
Queen Masah of the Second Level of the Underworld appeared alongside her seven warriors. Just like King Rellius, she wore a defiant expression.

She was both a beauty and a mystery. As far as ranking the Underworld’s most enigmatic figures was concerned, she stood near the top. Her power came from water and illusion, abilities she had relied upon to maintain her position as Queen until this day.
The moment she sat down, Queen Lonia also appeared. Unlike the others, however, she bowed deeply, and so did the seven warriors behind her.
"I pay my respects to the Empress."
Indie smiled and gestured for her to raise her head.
"Kindly take your seat and wait for the others. And do not forget, your loyalty will be rewarded."
Queen Lonia nodded before taking the chair reserved for her.
A few seconds later, King Orpham appeared, ancient chains dangling from his body. He was a giant standing over four meters tall, his massive frame covered in countless ancient chains.
Physically, he would rival some of Kent’s undead demigods.
’Damn, that is one large bastard,’ Kent thought inwardly.
Then a frown appeared on his face, and the intent to kill flashed across his face when King Orpham spoke.
"So you are the bitch calling yourself the Empress of the Underworld."
Indie frowned at the provocation, and so did her seven guards. However, before any of them could make a move, a terrifying pressure crashed down upon the brute, sending him to his knees.
Miryssa stood up and began walking toward him.
Every step she took sent ice spikes erupting from the ground and stabbing into King Orpham’s body. The pressure bearing down on him also increased with every step she took.
"The only reason you were called here is that the Empress wished to give you a second chance to repent and the opportunity to become a useful aide within her empire."
"However, it seems some of you do not appreciate her benevolence. So why keep you alive when there are more capable people who can fill your role?"
Miryssa’s voice was deathly cold, so cold that even the Seven Silent Claws felt the pressure.
Since Miryssa had awakened the Eternal Nether Yin Body and unlocked Nether Ice, the Underworld felt like the perfect place for her to display her power.
By the time she was only one meter away from King Orpham, the brute had already lost consciousness.
She turned and looked at King Rellius and Queen Masah.
"Make no mistake. Your Empress has enough sisters and friends who would gladly accept your thrones and rule in your stead."
"The only reason you are still alive is simple. It is not my place to pass judgment."
The arrogant and defiant expressions in their eyes vanished, replaced by fear. King Rellius and Queen Masah felt their bodies tremble, expressions turning pale.
Miryssa ignored them and turned toward Indie with a smile.
"Sorry about that. I just hate it when kindness is mistaken for weakness."
"You have nothing to apologize for, Miryssa. I was actually about to order his execution."
Miryssa nodded and teleported back to her chair, leaving the unconscious and heavily injured King of the Fourth Level of the Underworld and his seven warriors kneeling there in silence.
The moment she sat down, King Gffankan and his guards appeared. He was a massive monster with four mouths and countless eyes. The sight made Kent furrow his brow.
’An Abyssal Ogre, huh... Interesting.’
King Gffankan immediately stiffened when his gaze landed on the unconscious King Orpham. Seeing this, he refrained from showing any arrogance and quietly took his assigned seat.
King Avernus also arrived and, like King Gffankan, became obedient and sat down quietly despite being one of the strongest Underworld Kings.

Shortly afterward, King Fredman arrived and also took his seat without incident. While he had rallied behind the Underworld God, he had only done so because he did not want to become a target of the rest who followed him.
He merely went with the bandwagon.
Ronan, King of the Eighth Layer, arrived with his scythe resting on his shoulder. He was someone who respected the Grim Reapers so much that his entire demeanor resembled theirs.
He had always wanted to become a Grim Reaper, but with the Underworld Empress gone, nobody had been able to bestow that power upon him.
Even so, he was friends with more than two hundred Grim Reapers. To him, even if the other twelve layers united to pressure him, he would never yield.
So, having waited his entire life to stand in the Empress’s presence, he bowed deeply, paid his respects, and swore his allegiance to her.
Kent instantly found himself liking the man and planned to speak with him later.
Just after he took his seat, the person Kent had been waiting for finally arrived.

Nyx appeared alongside seven demigods. Two were female, and five were male. Kent instantly sensed a cold aura emanating from her, a sign that she had already reached Absolute Ice and was halfway to mastering Extreme Ice.
Indie’s eyes sparkled when she saw Nyx arrive and bow before her.
"My name is Nyx, second daughter of the Abyss King Narton."
"Oh, so you are an Abysskin," Indie said, a small smile appearing on her face.
Nyx stiffened, but she still answered.
"Yes. However, I left my world a long time ago to become my own person. I hold no animosity toward you or anyone else."
"I believe you," Indie said without hesitation.
"Huh?"
Nyx, who had prepared herself to face the wrath of the Empress, was left stunned.
"I have my reasons. For now, take a seat, and let’s welcome the rest."
Nyx nodded and sat down.
Just then, her gaze shifted toward Kent, who was relaxed in his chair and quietly observing the arrivals.
’Who is this person?’ Nyx wondered.
However, she did not stare for too long, lest she offend someone she should not. The underworld, after all, is a dangerous place, and this person seems to be with the Underworld Empress.
King Fenrik, a werewolf, appeared next. He offered a respectful bow before taking his seat.
Queen Dabria followed shortly afterward, and then came King Nosoi, the Pestilence King.
Finally, King Natos arrived.
Once all of them were seated, Miryssa waved her hand, and King Orpham was abruptly awakened.
He instantly turned pale, his body weakened beyond measure.
"Sit down, and don’t make me repeat myself."𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
Indie’s cold voice slammed into his mind like a hammer.
Knowing he was already walking on thin ice, King Orpham practically ran to his seat.
The moment he sat down, Indie began to speak.

Indie frowned at the provocation, and so did her seven guards.
However, before any of them could make a move, a terrifying pressure crashed down upon the brute, sending him to his knees.
Miryssa stood up and began walking toward him.
Every step she took sent ice spikes erupting from the ground and stabbing into King Orpham’s body.
The pressure bearing down on him also increased with every step she took.
"The only reason you were called here is that the Empress wished to give you a second chance to repent and the opportunity to become a useful aide within her empire."
"However, it seems some of you do not appreciate her benevolence.
So why keep you alive when there are more capable people who can fill your role?"
Miryssa’s voice was deathly cold, so cold that even the Seven Silent Claws felt the pressure.
Since Miryssa had awakened the Eternal Nether Yin Body and unlocked Nether Ice, the Underworld felt like the perfect place for her to display her power.
By the time she was only one meter away from King Orpham, the brute had already lost consciousness.
She turned and looked at King Rellius and Queen Masah.
"Make no mistake.
Your Empress has enough sisters and friends who would gladly accept your thrones and rule in your stead."
"The only reason you are still alive is simple.
It is not my place to pass judgment."
The arrogant and defiant expressions in their eyes vanished, replaced by fear.
King Rellius and Queen Masah felt their bodies tremble, expressions turning pale.
Miryssa ignored them and turned toward Indie with a smile.
"Sorry about that.
I just hate it when kindness is mistaken for weakness."
"You have nothing to apologize for, Miryssa.
I was actually about to order his execution."
Miryssa nodded and teleported back to her chair, leaving the unconscious and heavily injured King of the Fourth Level of the Underworld and his seven warriors kneeling there in silence.
The moment she sat down, King Gffankan and his guards appeared.
He was a massive monster with four mouths and countless eyes.
The sight made Kent furrow his brow.
’An Abyssal Ogre, huh...
Interesting.’
King Gffankan immediately stiffened when his gaze landed on the unconscious King Orpham.
Seeing this, he refrained from showing any arrogance and quietly took his assigned seat.
King Avernus also arrived and, like King Gffankan, became obedient and sat down quietly despite being one of the strongest Underworld Kings.
Shortly afterward, King Fredman arrived and also took his seat without incident.
While he had rallied behind the Underworld God, he had only done so because he did not want to become a target of the rest who followed him.
He merely went with the bandwagon.
Ronan, King of the Eighth Layer, arrived with his scythe resting on his shoulder.
He was someone who respected the Grim Reapers so much that his entire demeanor resembled theirs.
He had always wanted to become a Grim Reaper, but with the Underworld Empress gone, nobody had been able to bestow that power upon him.
Even so, he was friends with more than two hundred Grim Reapers.
To him, even if the other twelve layers united to pressure him, he would never yield.
So, having waited his entire life to stand in the Empress’s presence, he bowed deeply, paid his respects, and swore his allegiance to her.
Kent instantly found himself liking the man and planned to speak with him later.
Just after he took his seat, the person Kent had been waiting for finally arrived.
Nyx appeared alongside seven demigods.
Two were female, and five were male.
Kent instantly sensed a cold aura emanating from her, a sign that she had already reached Absolute Ice and was halfway to mastering Extreme Ice.
Indie’s eyes sparkled when she saw Nyx arrive and bow before her.
"My name is Nyx, second daughter of the Abyss King Narton."
"Oh, so you are an Abysskin," Indie said, a small smile appearing on her face.
Nyx stiffened, but she still answered.
"Yes.
However, I left my world a long time ago to become my own person.
I hold no animosity toward you or anyone else."
"I believe you," Indie said without hesitation.
"Huh?"
Nyx, who had prepared herself to face the wrath of the Empress, was left stunned.
"I have my reasons.
For now, take a seat, and let’s welcome the rest."
Nyx nodded and sat down.
Just then, her gaze shifted toward Kent, who was relaxed in his chair and quietly observing the arrivals.
’Who is this person?’ Nyx wondered.
However, she did not stare for too long, lest she offend someone she should not.
The underworld, after all, is a dangerous place, and this person seems to be with the Underworld Empress.
King Fenrik, a werewolf, appeared next.
He offered a respectful bow before taking his seat.
Queen Dabria followed shortly afterward, and then came King Nosoi, the Pestilence King.
Finally, King Natos arrived.
Once all of them were seated, Miryssa waved her hand, and King Orpham was abruptly awakened.
He instantly turned pale, his body weakened beyond measure.
"Sit down, and don’t make me repeat myself."𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
Indie’s cold voice slammed into his mind like a hammer.
Knowing he was already walking on thin ice, King Orpham practically ran to his seat.
The moment he sat down, Indie began to speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 1666: Ascension of the Underworld Empress (2)
paragraphs: "Welcome, everyone," Indie said before clearing her throat.
"During the Primordial Era, I arrived in this place as a fugitive, unaware that a great destiny awaited me. Just like most of you, I fought my way upward, trying to survive each passing second.

"Of course, compared to the current state of the Underworld, it was far more chaotic and infinitely more dangerous back then. Even so, I endured and, alongside my trusted friends and allies, fought my way into prominence.
"When I reached a stage where I could be compared to the rulers of the thirteen layers, I saw a much greater purpose. You could call it a higher calling.

"I realized that simply becoming a Layer Queen was not enough to unite the entire Underworld and put an end to the war with the Abyssal Realm, so I did what many before me had attempted and failed to accomplish: I chose to become the first true Empress of the Underworld.
"It took millions of years, but I succeeded, and on the day I was crowned, the Underworld we all live in today was recognized as a true Realm of Existence, complete with its own laws and authority.
"Years later, when the universe was threatened, I, alongside my guards and warriors from all thirteen layers, answered the call of the Chaos Dragon and went to war.

"Because of our sacrifice and dedication, we emerged victorious, allowing all of us to stand here today. Unfortunately, I fell during that battle. However, I have returned, and I will once again take the helm as the one true Empress of the Underworld.
"I know most of you do not wish to follow me or bow before my authority. Honestly, I do not blame you. After all, you are the highest authorities within your respective layers.
"However, you are forgetting one thing."
Her voice suddenly grew colder.
"Here, I am the authority. I am the true power."
The atmosphere in the hall instantly became heavy.

"So I have called all of you here today to bend the knee, swear your allegience and witness my ascension. Those who refuse will be relieved of their duties as Kings and Queens and replaced by individuals who understand the meaning of authority."
Indie paused and sighed.
She understood the nature of the Underworld. She had no intention of luring them in with sweet promises and empty words. In the world out there, she would have done that.
However, in the Underworld, only absolute power was respected.
She had learned that lesson the hard way.
So she was making her intentions perfectly clear.
Of course, as time passed and with Kent’s help, she could eventually bring all of them to her side using sweet promises.

For today, however, she only needed the Thirteen Thrones to swear their allegiance to her. They already have the people’s respect, so while changing them would be simple, keeping them in place will maintain the peace.
That alone would significantly increase the authority and power she would receive during her crowning ceremony.
"If I am being honest with all of you, the original Thirteen Thrones I appointed were far stronger and far more promising than most of you."
A hint of nostalgia appeared in her eyes.
"I often wonder what became of them after I left."
She sighed once more, recalling the thirteen Celestials she had personally placed in charge before departing for war.

Aside from her thirteen personal guards, such as Yama and the others she would soon summon, she had also appointed thirteen rulers to govern the layers of the Underworld before she left for the Great War.
Suddenly, Indie asked,
"By the way, do any of you know what happened to the original Underworld Kings and Queens?"
Ronan immediately stood up.

"I once read an ancient record stating that a humanoid calling himself the Bone Lich Undead Emperor arrived here long ago, demanding the skeleton of an Abyssal Prince stored within the Underworld Vault."𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
"The Thirteen Kings and Queens attempted to stop him, but he left with the skeleton and their corpses."
Indie’s eyes narrowed.
A moment later, she subtly glanced toward Kent.
Kent had already suspected where this conversation was heading and immediately turned his head away before their eyes could meet.
Unfortunately for him, Indie was one of his wives.
’My love, does any of this sound familiar?’ her voice echoed in his mind.
’Nope,’ Kent replied without hesitation.
Deep down, however, he already knew he was responsible.
After all, Yama had already informed him that he was a wanted fugitive in the Underworld and three other realms.
’If you happen to be the one who killed my subordinates, I expect compensation, my love.’
’Only natural.’
’Tch.’
Indie turned back toward Ronan. Her expression remained calm, but the amusement in her eyes was impossible to hide.
"Thank you, Ronan," she said, deliberately mentioning his name so he would know she had not forgotten it.
As expected, Ronan smiled.
"You are the current rulers of the thirteen layers, so it would be best not to disrupt the hierarchy. That is why I am offering you an opportunity to rally under my rule."
"You do not have to trust me. You do not even have to like me. Simply remain symbols under my authority, and we will have no problems."
"Of course, those whose loyalty to me is below fifty-one percent will not be invited to the parties I intend to host."
A playful smile appeared on her face.

"And let me tell you, it has been years since I last opened my wine cellar. So imagine the potency of the Hell Wine and Underworld Mead I have stored away, waiting to be enjoyed during those gatherings."
Surprisingly, the expressions in many of their eyes changed.
Kent found the reaction amusing.
Yet again, he was left stunned by the type of ruler Indie was and the ruler she would soon become.
She knew exactly how to appeal to the people of the Underworld.
"Finally, to ensure that none of you has anyone else to call your leader besides me, let’s welcome the so-called Underworld God."
Yama appeared in the hall holding a handsome man with silver-black hair and a sharp jawline.
The man was bound in thick crimson chains.
Both his hands and legs were restrained, and his face was pale.
The moment the Underworld Kings and Queens saw him, gasps echoed throughout the hall.
Kent immediately noticed the shift.
Almost half of those who had supported him instantly switched their allegiance to Indie.
His [Omniscient Jade Eye] could perceive far more than he had initially expected.
Four of the nine supporters immediately moved to Indie’s side, while the remaining five looked deeply disappointed.
Nergal, the underworld god, had been their pillar of support.
He was supposed to be their strongest backer in the fight against the underworld empress. Yet now he was chained up, unable to free himself.
In fact, he looked utterly defeated.
"I see," Indie suddenly said. "You are the son of the Fourth Abyss King."
The chained man lifted his head and stared at her, while the underworld kings and queens gasped again.
"I always suspected that bastard had a son I was unaware of."
She leaned back against her throne.
"Well, I killed six of his sons, so I was a little arrogant back then and didn’t dig deep to kill the seventh. Seriously, how many sons does that bastard have?"
A smirk appeared on her face.
"Never mind, I will kill more later. But to think he actually planted you here so that one day you could break the seal and summon his army."
Her smile widened.
"I underestimated that bastard."
"Bitch, let me go!"
Nergal struggled violently against the chains.
"If you dare lay a finger on me, my father will reduce this weak realm to rubble!"
However, Indie merely smiled.
"Kill you? Why would I do that?"
The smile on her face became downright chilling.
"I plan to send you to the Abyss Prison, where your soul will be tortured for all eternity."
"Even if your father manages to destroy this place, unless he values your life more than his own ambitions, rescuing you will be impossible."
Nergal’s entire body trembled.
"Yama, take him to the dungeons."
Yama nodded.
The next moment, both he and the chained Abyss Prince vanished from the hall.
Indie then looked at the assembled rulers.
"Now, the person who wanted you to rebel has been captured."
She slowly swept her gaze across the room.
"So I believe all of you will make the correct choice."
Most of them nodded.
"Excluding Lonia, Ronan, Nyx, and Fenrik, who have already sworn their allegiance, the rest of you have five minutes to do the same."
Her eyes became cold.
"Otherwise, you will leave this place no longer Kings and Queens of the Underworld."
Her words carried the weight of law itself.
Kent could clearly see the effect they had on the rulers. Indie knew that none of the Kings and Queens wanted to lose their authority. So she used that fact to drive her narrative.
It was simple.
It was effective.
And it was exactly how the Underworld operated.
Now, as he watched them come forward one after another, bending the knee before the throne, a smile appeared on Kent’s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1667: Underworld Rising
paragraphs: It took just three minutes for all who initially opposed Indie’s rule to bend the knee and swear their allegiance to her. While they still didn’t like her, they had seen her authority and knew she had what it took to rule them or replace them.

None of them wants to lose their power because they didn’t want to submit to a superior authority. Thinking that they chose to rally behind the Underworld god, they saw that this wasn’t any different.
By the time everything was handled, Kent saw that they all wanted to see the rise of the Underworld.
His eyes could see their resolve, and as someone who knew who to trust and who not to, he knew that if what Indie said was true, then soon, all thirteen thrones would be loyal to her.
He said nothing and simply remained on the side. With his eyes, if any of them were faking, he would visit them later and dispose of them before they bring chaos to his wife’s empire.
This was Indie’s domain, and so he allowed her to handle her people.
"Before we start, there is one thing you must know: the Underworld is not limited to only the Demigod Stage. When I came here, there were Supremes and Celestials.
However, after the authority was handed over to me, I made sure that, if I were to leave for a very long time, no one stronger than a demigod could appear to oppose my rule or harm the underworld.

Years passed, and that rule held. However, for a god to appear, it means my authority has started to decay. However, I am here now and, as such, know that in the coming weeks I will slowly lift the ban on your cultivation.
This means your millions of years of cultivation will soon show. The moment that happens, the other realms will sense our grand rise and will try to invade us.
Rest assured, I have no plans to let them succeed. Once the ban is lifted, enter seclusion and push through to your limits. We will meet again after all of you return from seclusion."
They all nodded, most of them happy to finally be able to stand toe to toe with the likes of the Hell Kings and Queens and others who, in the past, used to taunt them.
Elwen walked toward Indie and, with a graceful movement, placed the Underworld Crown on Indie’s head. The moment she did, Kent saw a golden light emanate from her body.
Then he felt it—a higher authority, one that even he could not ignore, descend upon Indie.
Suddenly, the bat paintings on the walls came alive, and one Grim Reaper after another emerged, every last one of them going down on their knees.
"All hail the Underworld Empress."
"All hail the Underworld Empress."
On the stage, Elwen and the rest of the six Silent Claws also went down on their knees and bowed, chanting the same slogan.
"All hail the Underworld Empress."
"All hail the Underworld Empress."
On the side of the Underworld Kings and Queens, Ronan was the first to get on his knees.
"All hail the Underworld Empress."

The rest soon followed. They could also feel the same thing Kent felt—a greater authority, one far stronger than the one they held, had been bestowed upon Indie, and so they had no reason to deny her authority.
She was the Underworld Empress, and she had just been crowned.
"All hail the Underworld Empress."
"All hail the Underworld Empress."
Reluctantly, they all began chanting the same slogan.

Kent and Miryssa sat in their chairs, smiles on their faces as they witnessed the rise of the Underworld. Back during the Primordial Era, the entire universe was sent into a state of panic when the Heavenly Dao suddenly recognized the Underworld.
Chaos never expected that, so he descended there to investigate.

To his shock, the Empress was the same assassin lady he had personally imprisoned there. That left him conflicted, and for a moment, he contemplated killing her before she merged the Underworld with the world of the living and caused chaos.
However, he allowed himself to assess the situation, and when he saw that she held no animosity toward him or the rest of the universe, he let her be.
Who would have thought she would be the first to come when Chaos called?
’I expect greatness this time, too, Indie. The last time, we never got the chance to get to know each other better. This time around, we will work together to elevate the standing of the Underworld.’

Suddenly, Yama, who had left with the chained Underworld God, returned, and he also knelt. Then, from the side, portals opened, and twelve powerful individuals, each no weaker than Yama, appeared. They all knelt.
"All hail the Underworld Empress."
"All hail the Underworld Empress."

Kent speculated that they might be the guards she had left behind in the thirteen layers before she departed for the Great War. They had been suppressed to the Demigod Stage, but he knew they were much stronger than that.
Kent watched them all bow, and after a minute, Indie gestured for them to stand.
"I have received the authority, but it will take me about a month to fully inherit everything. Go back now and prepare. A month from now, the Underworld will begin its rise to its former glory."
She waved her hand, and all thirteen Underworld Kings and Queens vanished alongside their aides.
She turned to the twelve new arrivals. "Welcome, all of you. Like the others, return for now. When everything is handled, I will summon you back so we can have a proper catch-up."
"As you command, Empress," they bowed and left, Yama included.
"I will leave guard duty to you, seven."
The Seven Silent Claws nodded.
"Rest assured, Empress, we will remain vigilant."
"I know you will." Indie smiled, turning to Miryssa. "Elwen will take you to the garden so you can start your cultivation."
Miryssa nodded, and soon she was gone from the throne room. Her reason for coming was to see if she could attain Extreme Ice like Elwen.

If she could, then she would remain undefeated at the Universal God Stage. For now, she and her sisters were cultivating the Ancient Path too, so becoming Supremes would not happen for another hundred years, perhaps a thousand.
But even so, she had nothing to worry about. Kent kept gaining powerful allies every day, and more powerful sisters kept joining the harem. They would be protected regardless of the danger.
After Miryssa left, Indie turned to Kent.
"What do you plan on doing now, my love?"
"Send me to the Ninth Layer. It is about time I met her again after thousands of years."
Indie nodded and waved her hand, creating a portal that led to the Ninth Layer of the Underworld.
"Say hi to my sisters for me, would you?"
"Only natural."
Kent stood up and walked toward the portal.
"Give me a heads-up before you break the seal."
"I will."
He walked through the portal, and he was gone. After he left, Indie tapped the armrest of her throne, and a door opened behind her.
"I will be leaving now. See you, ladies, soon."
"Good luck, Empress."
Indie nodded and walked through the door. It shut behind her, and the entire throne room was left in silence once again.
Meanwhile, in front of a large black mansion, a portal opened, and Kent stepped out. The moment he did, two minotaurs blocked his path and drew their weapons.
"Who are you, and what are you doing wandering around here? Aren’t you afraid you might anger the Queen?"
Kent smiled and nodded.
"Fair point. However, kindly let your Queen know there is a man named Kent looking for her..."
Kent wasn’t finished speaking when a command came from the black mansion.
"Let him in now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1668: Reunited with Nyx
paragraphs: Kent walked through the gate with a smug expression.
He sensed Nyx’s gaze land on him the moment he stepped out of the portal, so he knew facing the two guards wouldn’t be a problem.
All Nyx needed to hear was who he was, and she would allow him entry.

As he walked toward the black mansion, his appearance returned to its true form, shedding the dark hair, mask, clothes, and even his eyes. His purple hair with strands of red and gold appeared, and his purple cloak covered his body.

He soon arrived at the door leading to the mansion. It opened on its own, and he walked inside, his gaze landing on Nyx, who was currently seated on her throne, gazing back at him with sparkling eyes.
Kent smiled inwardly, sensing that Nyx was deliberately suppressing her joy just to look more nonchalant. Her eyes betrayed her miserably on that front.
Even so, she remained seated.
"Long time no see, Nyx," Kent said, flashing a handsome smile.
He walked straight toward Nyx, and just when he was right in front of her, he grabbed her hand and pulled her straight into his arms.
His left hand moved with practical ease, and before Nyx could process anything, their lips met. Her eyes widened, but she closed them the next second and allowed the kiss to overwhelm her mind.
It had been a very long time since they had met.

Back then, just like some of the ladies Kent met when he traveled to the past and ventured into the Flame Sea, she wasn’t sure about her feelings for him. However, over time, she found herself missing him until she couldn’t hold herself back any longer.

Because of the time difference, it had been three million years since she last saw Kent. She slept through most of that time simply because she couldn’t handle the growing feelings she kept developing for him.
At first, she thought it was merely curiosity.

After all, Kent was unlike anyone she had ever dreamt of loving ever. He was reckless when he should have been cautious, shameless when he should have been respectful, and impossibly confident even when facing people far stronger than himself.
She witnessed his Hell Road Trial, and while he had some leeway thanks to the rules, she knew the opponents Kent fought and killed were legendary warriors.

Every one of them was comparable to demigods, gods, and even some Supremes. Even when suppressed, they were supposed to have an advantage due to their battle experience. However, Kent soloed them, and he did so with ease.
All that strength and recklessness made him a bit of a wild card. Nyx despised people of that nature. She hated her father because, just like Kent, he was also reckless.
Yet, despite all of that, he somehow managed to leave an impression on her heart.
What began as curiosity slowly became interest.
Interest became attachment.
And attachment eventually became longing.

Three million years was an insignificant amount of time for powerful beings such as herself. Many Underworld Kings and Queens would spend far longer periods in seclusion without even noticing the passage of time.
However, those three million years felt unbearably long to her.
Without even realizing it, tears rolled down her face as the kiss became more intense. She missed Kent so much that she couldn’t bring herself to stop kissing him.
Kent also had no plans to back down now.
Nyx wrapped her arms around Kent’s neck and deepened the kiss, pouring three million years of longing into that single moment.
The cold and indifferent Queen of the Ninth Underworld had completely disappeared.
At this moment, she was simply a woman embracing the person she had missed for millions of years.
Kent could feel the emotions hidden behind her actions.
’I guess I have a lot of catching up to do with her. Luckily for me, I am now a monster in bed,’ he smiled inwardly, already prepared to make sure Nyx felt every aspect of his love for her.
Five minutes later, Nyx finally pulled away, though her forehead remained pressed against his chest. Kent could feel her warm breath pouring on his chest.

He wrapped his arms around her, gently patted her back, and whispered into her ear, "I am sorry, Nyx. I should have come earlier, perhaps even right after I left Hell. However, I had things in the outside world demanding my attention.

I know no explanation would make up for the time you had to wait for me here all alone. So now that I am here, I am at your service. Whatever you need, as long as I can provide it, I wouldn’t hesitate."
Nyx said nothing and simply continued to hug Kent.
After ten minutes had passed, she slowly lifted her head and looked at him.
"I have mastered the first four forms of the Nine-Fold Calamity Whip Art."
"You did?" Kent smiled, his mind going back to his final moments in Hell when he bestowed the Nine-Fold Calamity Whip Art upon Nyx.
He had told her that when they met again, he expected her to master the first four forms. Who would have thought she would take his words to heart and actually accomplish it?
He used his hand to lift her chin, causing her to look him in the eye.
"I am proud of you, Nyx."
She blushed and buried her head against his chest.
Kent laughed. "So, what do you think about the Nine-Fold Calamity Whip Art?"
"None of the demigods in the Underworld can defeat me if I use just the first form."
"That’s strong, huh?" Kent was a bit surprised to learn that the technique he had given her was that powerful.
Nyx pulled her head back and looked at him.
"I don’t know who created that technique, but from what I have seen, just the first form is comparable to a Supreme Technique."

"Damn." Kent smiled and nodded. "I guess it is a good thing I gave it to you. Once Indie breaks the seal and your cultivation ascends to the Supreme or Celestial stage, you will be undisputed within the same rank."
Nyx smiled, then asked a very important question.
"So the Empress is one of your wives, huh?"
Kent smiled. "Yes. Her name is Indie, a Catkin and the one who united the Underworld for the first time during the Primordial Era."
"I see. She seems sweet."
"She is sweet, and she said hi."
Nyx nodded. However, before she could say anything else, Kent lifted her off the ground and asked in a teasing tone, "Where is your bedroom? We can continue catching up there."
Nyx blushed, but a few seconds later, they were inside a room with walls painted black. Curtains, chairs, tables, and even the bed are completely black.
Kent set her down on the bed and admired her beauty.

He never knew Nyx was an Abyssborn. But now that he did, he could only wonder which lineage she was from. He had crossed paths with the Abyssal Race during the Primordial Era, so he knew a thing or two about them.
He could tell Nyx wasn’t using a disguise, but as far as he could remember, he had never met a member of the Abyssal Race who looked like an elf.
This was a first for him.
Still, that was a mystery for another time.
For now, he was simply happy to be reunited with the Queen he had not seen in forever.

Kent thought about what he must do next, and for a moment, the ideas he came up with sounded far too evil.
Thankfully, his understanding of alchemy was good enough.
All that was required of him now was the willingness to rise through the ranks and become a Pill Immortal soon.
He was currently a Pill Monarch and had to become a Pill Sovereign, Pill Legend, and Pill Divine before reaching the Pill Immortal stage.

It sounded like a lot, but Kent knew that if he had focused on alchemy as much as he had on his other professions, he would have already reached the Pill Immortal stage or at least been much closer to it.
He needed to succeed because the revenge would depend solely on his alchemical brilliance.
"With a year and a half before the Trial of Wisdom at the Cult of Wisdom headquarters and three more years before the Genesis Sword Dao Competition, I believe I can become a Pill Immortal by then."
Kent sighed and made up his mind.
"Until Axim and his friends arrive at the Whispering Wind Sword Sect, I have some free time to become a true alchemist, at least until they get there.
When I go back, I will enter the world of alchemy and start making a name for myself there as well."
Kent walked back to the bed and lifted Nyx, carrying her to the bathroom.
He returned, cleaned the bed, then went back in to clean her body.
Afterward, he brought her back, laid her on the bed, and took out a canvas, a brush, and some paints.
"Time to add another beauty to my collection," he said, starting to paint Nyx and making sure he captured every detail of her.
He had done the same for all his wives during the four years he spent with them.
Inside a mansion in the Harem Tower built specifically for him, he had paintings of all his wives hanging on the walls.
None of them ever asked why he painted them.
They were simply happy to pose for him, some even fast asleep like Nyx, while he painted them.
Two hours later, a beautiful portrait of Nyx covered the canvas.
After admiring it for a while, he stored it away and lay beside Nyx.
A few minutes later, he fell asleep, only to find himself face-to-face with a man clad in bone-like armor and wearing a bone-like hat.
Most importantly, he was seated upon a bone-like throne.

chapters.title: Chapter 1672: Bone Lich Undead Emperor
paragraphs: Two people stood facing each other, fierce looks in their eyes, frowns on their faces, and fists clenched.

On one side, a man with red hair and red eyes sat on a throne made of bones. His right leg was placed on the seat, elevating it and putting him in a perfect posture to support his chin. He was clad in black armor adorned with bone ornaments.
A bone staff ending in a skull crown with hollow eyes hovered beside him.

The crown, or judging by its horrible nature, a helmet that better fit the name, rested atop his head, and his shoulders were covered in a warm embrace of ash fur, the kind that made him appear both intimidating and a bit handsome.

Well, he is indeed handsome, and considering he appeared to be around 35 years old while the one facing him looked to be in his early 20s, he was more mature and, more importantly, extremely dangerous.
Compared to the man seated on the throne, Kent appeared more docile.
The man exuded a necrotic Qi (Death Qi) so intense and suffocating that Kent, who tried to remain indifferent, soon found himself feeling pressured. The aura around the man is on another level.
"And they get weirder and weirder," Kent muttered, a sigh escaping his lips.
He regarded the man for a few more seconds before addressing him. "So why am I here?"
Kent knew the man on the throne was him, or more accurately, one of his incarnations. Just like Chaos, Faceless, and Ruthless Bandit, this man was also one of his 13 incarnations.
Under normal circumstances, he would have been happy if they had met of his own accord. He mostly used the memory keys to retrieve his memories when he wanted to.
But for a while now, they had just been coming to him either in his sleep or when he saw something or someone familiar.
This time around, instead of Ruthless Bandit, he was face-to-face with another incarnation he had yet to recall.
The man on the throne tapped his armrest, and a chair appeared behind Kent. A force pushed him down into it. Kent had no choice but to sit.

"It is a bit weird meeting myself in a different body and more alive," he grinned, looking at Kent with eyes that told the Chaos Dragon he had met Ruthless Bandit 2.0. "I am more fond of dealing with the dead, you see."
"So it was you who killed the first 13 Underworld Kings and Queens?" Kent asked, his eyes narrowing.
"They gave me no choice but to turn them into useful warriors. I merely wanted the bones of an Abyssal Chaos Prince, yet they made it seem like they had some power."
The man smirked and asked, "If you were in my shoes, what would you have done?"
"I would have knocked them out and taken what I came for. Shit, I would have negotiated something more calm and understandable with them or exchanged the bones for something of equal value."
The man looked at Kent and smirked. "I had no other choice but to make them understand what true power looks like. After all, I promised them a new life, one where eternity is forever."
Kent shook his head and sighed. He had hoped that after Ruthless Bandit, he would not meet another incarnation this cruel and evil.

However, while this one had no evil Qi around him, the aura he exuded was even worse. Kent could only imagine a scenario where this bastard hated living things and made it his business to play with the dead.
"Just so you know, we have pissed off the Empress of the Underworld, so congratulations. We are now the killers of your own wife’s subordinates."
The man furrowed his brow upon hearing Kent’s words.

"I have no idea what any of what you just said means, but be happy you are or would be living my life. Trust me, I was one of the most dangerous beings to ever grace this universe with my honorable existence."
A chuckle escaped Kent’s lips, and he asked in a slightly louder tone, "So what is it that I am here for, and more importantly, who are you?"
The man changed his posture, crossing his left leg over his right.

"I go by many names and titles. Some called me the Bone King. Others called me the True Undead Emperor, the Grave Necromancer, Master of the Memento Mori. Some called me the Renegade King, and the heavens once called me the Bone Lich.
"However, I once ruled the Realm of the Undead, bearing the title of the Bone Lich Undead Emperor. Pleasure meeting you or me."
The smug look on his face made Kent sneer.
"Bitch, I asked for your name, the name your mother gave you."

"Oh, that? You should have been specific with your question." He laughed and flipped his hair to the side. "My dear mother, the Goddess of the Divine Temple, and my father, one of the Heaven Guards, named me Sanders Dreamchild."
"Hold on, bastard. Did you just say your mother is a Goddess at the Divine Temple, and your father is one of the Heaven Guards?"
"Yes," Sanders answered.
"Then why the hell are you a Necromancer? Isn’t the entire mission of the Divine Temple to rid the universe of necromancers and evil cultivators?"
"I know, right?" Sanders laughed.
"Unbelievable."

Through Ruthless Bandit’s memories, Kent had come to know some of the organizations that had tried to kill him back then. One of them was the Divine Temple, and they had come close to killing him a few times.

From what he knew of them, they were blessed by the heavens to rid the universe of beings who violated the natural order. Ruthless Bandit had disturbed the heavens in all the worst ways, and so they had tried many times to kill him.
If what Sanders said was true, then his mother must have tried to kill him several times.
He looked up and saw that Sanders was smiling at him.

"Whatever you are thinking about, wipe it from your mind, punk. Mom never tried to kill us. In fact, she was the reason I became the strongest in my era. Our mother loved us greatly, and because of her love, we must ensure she remains happy forever.

"That starts by killing a few people, the first of them being the one who called himself the King of Light. He killed a friend of mine, the Goddess of Light, and imprisoned our mother and father in the Chaos Abyss."
"Say what now?"
Waves of evil Qi exploded from Kent’s body, making Sanders grin.
"I tried to save them, but failed. However, I prepared an army powerful enough to aid you in rescuing them this time around."
"Looks like some people just choose to court death for nothing." Kent gritted his teeth, his gaze burning with dangerous fire.
"Tell me more."
Sanders grinned. "Why tell you when you can experience everything from the day you were born?"
"Then what are you waiting for? Send me down memory lane."
Sanders chuckled and asked, "By the way, how is Kaizo?"
"How did you..." Kent’s eyes narrowed.
"I can smell him on you."

Kent sighed, forgetting he was standing in front of the incarnation who had formed the Undead Legion. This meant he knew Kaizo and the others. He was already away. Kaizo also came when he called during the Primordial Era.

This also told him he had been living Sanders’ life all along. In fact, he had this nagging feeling that he had been living all 13 lives. The only thing left was to unlock his memories and reclaim his job classes.
"He is fine and battle-ready as ever."
"As expected of my pal Kaizo." Sanders smiled and grabbed his bone staff. "The next time we meet, I want to hear some good news."
He fired a beam that landed on Kent’s forehead.
The next second, he found himself as a baby crying in the arms of the most beautiful woman he had ever seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 1673: Tale of a Dead Child (1)
paragraphs: Kent found himself as a newborn child, crying in his mother’s arms.

Maybe Sanders did it deliberately, but surprisingly, Kent didn’t seem offended. In fact, looking at his mother’s smile, he felt very happy. He liked the feeling of being a baby in his mother’s arms once again.
His mother was a beautiful blonde with sharp features and blue eyes. While Adina, the succubus, was the most beautiful woman in his harem, his mother was on another level.

Turning slightly, Kent saw a man clad in armor standing beside his mother. The man had short dark hair and a pair of green eyes. His ears were longer than a human’s, and judging by the bow in his hand, Kent concluded that he was an elf.
His mother was human, at least by her appearance. But she is way prettier than most elves.
Aside from them, another woman was in the room. She was also good-looking, and, since she had delivered Sanders, Kent concluded that she was close to his parents.
"Anara, looks like your son has your eyes," the woman said, widening Sanders’ mother’s smile.
"I gave birth to him, after all." She smiled and planted a kiss on Sanders’ forehead, something Kent instantly liked.
Sanders’ father, David, one of the Heaven Guards, smiled. "He will grow up to become a legendary warrior like his father."
Anara smirked but said nothing to dispute David’s words. "I just hope he grows up happy and surrounded by love."
And so, years passed, and, as Lady Anara wished, Sanders grew up in a world surrounded by love. He had everything and was loved by everyone.
The woman who had helped deliver him had a daughter two years older than Sanders. Growing up, she became his big sister and spoiled him rotten.
Sanders received basic archery training from his father and divine magic from his mother long before he turned sixteen. With the power and position his parents held, he had a significant head start.
However, everything changed on the day of his awakening.
That day, he was surrounded by his family, friends, and people from both the Divine Temple and the Heaven Guards. They had all come to welcome the next great figure in the world of combat and magic.
Everyone knew he would become a legendary figure, so they came to witness it.
However, on that very day, the Soul Temple attacked, and Sanders was killed.
The Soul Temple saw him as a threat, and so, before he could awaken, the 100th Soul Elder and the 78th Soul Elder led a team of Blood Warriors to attack.
According to a prophecy spoken years ago by the Grand Blood Seer, a Child of the Dead would be born, and he would plunge all life into the domain of death and darkness.
According to what the Soul Temple revealed, this child was Sanders, so they believed they were doing the universe a favor.

What many did not know was that the prophecy also stated that the Child of the Dead would rise and judge the universe, deciding who deserved to die while taking command of death itself to carry out its unholy work.
His true purpose was to rid the universe of the Soul Temple and other organizations that thrived by capitalizing on the deaths of others. He was meant to become one of them to get rid of them.
In the end, Sanders, alongside a few others, died.
However, as his parents and friends shed tears, Sanders finally came face to face with his true destiny.
Deep within the Undead Realm, he stood before a book that would one day become known as the Undead Codex.
When his blood touched the cover of the book, he awakened the long-lost Necromancer profession, the Bone Lich Emperor Class.
Legends spoke of a time long ago when a legendary necromancer walked through the Primal Chaos, wielding the power to create life from bones.
It was said that with a single bone, this necromancer could create life and bestow upon his creations powerful abilities, traits, bloodlines, and much more through the power of the Undead Codex.
The legends further stated that deep within the River of Time, this undead man walked, and the heavens named him the Bone Lich Emperor.
The day Lady Anara held the torch, preparing to light the pyre and burn Sanders’ body, he rose, and under the stunned gazes of everyone present, his appearance changed.
His blond hair and blue eyes turned crimson.
A bone-like throne appeared behind him, accompanied by a bone staff and a grimoire that the universe would later come to know as the Undead Codex.
That day, the living child of the Divine died and rose as the Child of Death.
Sanders looked at his mother and smiled.
"I will always have you in my heart, Mother."
With those words, he vanished, and nobody heard from him again for 200,000 years.
Throughout those 200,000 years, his parents were pressured repeatedly to reveal his whereabouts, but their answer remained the same: they did not know where he had gone.

His mother lost her position as one of the Goddesses of the Divine Temple, and his father was dismissed from the Heaven Guards. Their businesses were destroyed, and they were plunged into poverty and hardship.
Within their inner circle, only one person remained supportive: Sanders’ big sister, Yumy, whose mother died when Sanders was killed by the Soul Temple.
She supported Sanders’ parents, and despite the backlash she continuously received, she never wavered.
Eventually, the Church of Light stepped in and attempted to suppress her, but no matter what they did, she never yielded.
However, after 200,000 years of trying, they finally killed Yumy and imprisoned Anara and David.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
Even then, Sanders did not return.
It was only after another 300,000 years that tales began to spread of a necromancer commanding an undead force so powerful that entire armies trembled before him.
It turned out that when Sanders left, he had gone to the Undead Realm to grow stronger, as it was the only place where he could truly develop his newfound powers.
Everything that happened to his parents had remained unknown to him. In fact, he left so they wouldn’t be pushed into the situation of choosing him or their roles in the universe.
He had experienced his fair share of dangers within the Undead Realm. There, he built his strength until he reached the Undead God Stage before finally returning.
However, when he returned to the land of the living and discovered what had happened, blood flowed, and the dead no longer remained dead.
Kent witnessed with his own eyes as legendary undead warriors laid waste to entire armies.
The one named Kaizo served as the vanguard, blasting his way through every obstacle in his path.

Years later, it would be written within the dark Chapters of the Divine Temple that whenever the phrase "Here I come!" echoed across the battlefield, what followed was a mountain of a man clad in golden armor and bathed in golden lightning.
Kent also witnessed Kaizo’s creation.
Kaizo had been forged from the skull of a Divine Titan, a being who had existed long before the True Primordial Era.
Their race had reigned supreme during the Nameless Era.

Years later, after finding no way to kill the one truly responsible for the death of his best friend and his big sister, Yumy, and the imprisonment of his parents, Sanders decided to rescue them instead.
However, he soon found himself facing two major problems.
First, he had no way of cultivating Chaos Qi, and since the Chaos Abyss was a place that only beings who cultivated Chaos Qi could enter, he had no means of venturing there.
None of his undead could either.
Second, even if he somehow found a way to cultivate Chaos Qi, he would first have to travel to the Abyssal Realm and seek permission from the Abyssal Monarch to use the Chaos Gateway.
Unfortunately for him, he had already offended that fellow back when he was in the Undead Realm, so that option was completely out of the question.

However, through years of research, Sanders discovered that a very long time ago, an Underworld warrior had killed a prince from the Chaos Abyss, and his bones had been preserved within the Underworld Vault.
"If I get my hands on those bones, I can create my first Abyssal Chaos Undead. They will help me rescue Mom and Dad."
Thus, he ventured into the Underworld.

First, he had no way of cultivating Chaos Qi, and since the Chaos Abyss was a place that only beings who cultivated Chaos Qi could enter, he had no means of venturing there.
None of his undead could either.
Second, even if he somehow found a way to cultivate Chaos Qi, he would first have to travel to the Abyssal Realm and seek permission from the Abyssal Monarch to use the Chaos Gateway.
Unfortunately for him, he had already offended that fellow back when he was in the Undead Realm, so that option was completely out of the question.

However, through years of research, Sanders discovered that a very long time ago, an Underworld warrior had killed a prince from the Chaos Abyss, and his bones had been preserved within the Underworld Vault.
"If I get my hands on those bones, I can create my first Abyssal Chaos Undead.
They will help me rescue Mom and Dad."
Thus, he ventured into the Underworld.

chapters.title: Chapter 1674: Tale of a Dead Child (2)
paragraphs: Kent may have judged Sanders too early.
From what happened and the mindset he was in when he ventured into the Underworld, killing the Thirteen Underworld Kings and Queens was justified.
Per what he wanted and how he was recieved, it was perfectly in his right to do what he did.

He went there with a reasonable request. He only wanted a single bone from the Abyssal Chaos Prince skeleton. However, the Thirteen Kings and Queens decided to ride their high horses and threatened him, saying he had to leave or they would kill him.

Sanders did not get angry. He offered something very valuable, something that all the Underworld Kings and Queens wanted. However, they tried to snatch it from him, using their authority over the Underworld to suppress him.
Sanders then snapped, and by the time he calmed down, they were already dead.
"I tried to warn you losers, but you wouldn’t listen. Now I have offended the Underworld Empress and her minions."
The moment the rulers died, he knew he could not stay in the Underworld anymore, so he grabbed the entire skeleton of the Abyssal Prince and left.

After leaving, Sanders returned to the Undead Realm, where he spent ten years creating the perfect warrior he deemed capable of leading him and his legion into the Chaos Abyss, one of the most dangerous realms in the Void.
The day he finished creating the undead that he named Prince Anvil, Sanders wasted no time and left for the Abyssal Realm.

He knew the person he was going to face was not someone he could afford to offend. The Abyssal Monarch was a legendary figure. They said he was someone who came into existence when the Void was transformed into the universe.
His power was unfathomable, and his rule over the Abyss was absolute.
So Sanders went into what he believed would be a losing battle.
However, to his shock, when he reached the Abyssal Realm and requested an audience with the Abyssal Monarch, it was granted.
"We finally meet, Bone King," a man with flowing white hair seated upon a throne spoke, his voice laced with mockery.
Sanders felt the teasing in his words, but he maintained his composure and responded, "Likewise, Abyssal Monarch."
"Oh, don’t be silly. You can just call me Sir Madok, and I will call you Sanders."
"I don’t mind," Sanders replied to the suggestion, and Sir Madok laughed.
"Better."
His gaze lingered on Sanders for a few moments before he spoke again.
"So, the last I heard, you killed three of my people and even threatened to bring the Abyssal Realm and everyone in it to their knees." He grinned and narrowed his eyes at Sanders.
"Tell me, Sanders, do those people you wish to bring to their knees include me as well?"
Sanders smiled weakly and cursed himself for being unruly when he encountered the people from the Abyssal Realm during his time in the Undead Realm.

They were arrogant and uncivilized, so they offended him. In his fury, he killed some of them, wounded others, and arrogantly sent the rest running back to the Abyssal Realm with a warning that he would bring them to their knees one day.
His bluff was being called now, and he had nowhere to hide his face.

"I was just kidding, Sir Madok. I had just learned that my mother and father were imprisoned in the Chaos Abyss, and on top of that, my best friend had been killed, so I wasn’t in the right state of mind when I met your people.
"If I had been in a clearer state of mind, I would have handled things differently."
Of course, he lied, but this lie was what earned him the chance to enter the Chaos Abyss.
As it turned out, the Chaos Abyss was a no-man’s land. It was a place where only the strong ruled.
From what he later learned from Sir Madok, the Chaos Abyss was one of the many places in the Void where only danger resided.
Sanders learned that for years, the Abyssal Race and the Chaos Race had tried to eradicate the Chaos Abyss but had failed. In the end, they chose to seal it instead.

Later, the Chaos Race attacked the universe, and they lost. This meant that the gateway they were supposed to manage had begun to weaken, and when it finally collapsed, the universe would be attacked by the Chaos Abyss.
After all, many powerful individuals had been imprisoned there, and after years of suffering, they desired nothing but revenge.
When Sir Madok learned that Sanders wished to go there, he merely nodded and opened the gateway for him.
However, he gave him one mission.
Regardless of whether he succeeded or failed, since he could not die, he had to leave the Chaos Abyss through the Chaos Gateway.
Sir Madok handed him a seal capable of permanently sealing that gateway.
Sanders accepted the mission, and so he ventured inside, with Prince Anvil protecting him.
To their shock, the Chaos Abyss was not a forest filled with monsters lurking everywhere. It contained countless continents, each ruled by beings stronger than Celestials.
The first hundred years were spent searching for news of his parents across three continents, but he found nothing.
Eventually, he realized that he could accomplish nothing unless he became stronger.
So he began searching for ways to increase his strength while he continued to search.
However, no matter what he tried, he failed.
Later, he chose a different path.
He decided to leave signals throughout the Chaos Abyss for his parents.
Ten thousand years later, he learned that a couple—one a deadly mage and the other a remarkable archer—lived on a continent several light-years away from where he had received the information.
Sanders wasted no time and set out immediately, hoping to reunite with and rescue his parents. He knew the mage was her mother and the archer was his father, so he wasted no time.
However, after traveling for a hundred years, he encountered a roadblock.
To reach the Unholy Chaos Continent, he had to pass through a formation that only allowed Abyssal Chaos Beings to enter.
This was a barrier he could not cross.
So, with a sigh, he did the only thing he knew he could do.
He sacrificed a portion of his soul and created a pseudo-soul for Prince Anvil. This way, even long after he died, Prince Anvil would continue to live.
"I don’t know how long it will take, Anvil, but I will return. So go and find my parents, and continue to protect them in my stead. One day, I will come back."
"I will not fail you, Emperor," Prince Anvil said, pressing his hand against his chest and bowing deeply.
"I know you won’t, Anvil. Tell my parents I love them and that I am happy, so they shouldn’t worry."
With that, they went their separate ways.
Two hundred years later, Sanders returned to the land of the living.
Later, he learned that Sir Madok had also ventured into the Primal Chaos, and no one had heard from him again.
Five hundred thousand years later, after Sanders had become a Celestial and amassed a powerful undead army, he returned to the Abyssal Realm to see if he could help locate Sir Madok.
However, what greeted him was an attack launched by an alliance formed between the Abyssal Race, the Resentful Race, and the Undead Race.
That battle marked the beginning of Sanders’ greatest wars.
He fought them for a hundred years, and when he finally managed to escape, they invaded the universe instead.
That was the last battle Sanders fought before he, too, vanished from the face of the universe.
The Undead Era witnessed an invasion by three deadly Void races: the Abyssal Race, the Undead Race, and the Resentful Race.

When the danger reached its peak, when the Divine Temple, the Universe Council, and the Soul Temple were overwhelmed to their very foundations, it was the necromancer whom many despised who stepped forward and saved the universe.
