chapters.title: Chapter 1675: Bone Lich Undead Emperor Awakening
paragraphs: From the start of the memory retrieval to the end, Kent’s body underwent countless changes.

On the first day of the memory retrieval, his body was cocooned within a bone-like shell oozing with the power of death. He underwent the same transformation as Ruthless Bandit, so it felt only right that he experience it as well as the bone lich emperor.
Unfortunately for Nyx, as the hours passed, the power of death grew increasingly overwhelming, forcing her to wake up.

When she saw the cocoon, she was startled. However, a small angelic fairy child with beautiful golden hair, who introduced herself as Tower, was inside the room when she woke up and explained that her master, Kent, was perfectly fine.
Nyx accepted her explanation, but she was still worried.
Tower laughed when she saw her frightened expression. The sight made her happy because, at the very least, her master had found yet another woman who would place his needs above her own.
The second day brought even more worry when a dark-covered book radiating the power of death appeared.
The Undead Codex had arrived, and as if it were a competition, another tattered book, the Book of Evil, also appeared to challenge it.
Their rivalry escalated quickly. Had Tower not stepped in, they might have destroyed each other.
This interaction made Nyx wonder just who she had given her heart to and how many more secrets he was hiding.
On the third day, she needed reinforcement, so she called Zeraphine to come and experience the weirdness with her.
Zeraphine had been rescued by Uncle Drew some time ago and brought to the Underworld.
Since then, she had been training nonstop, motivated by how close she had come to death and how narrowly she had escaped it.
She sought to destroy her enemies, who also happened to be her best friend, or at least someone who used to be and her friend’s family.

While the others had already reunited with Kent before he left for the Underworld, she had been focused entirely on training. Thanks to the difference in time flow, she had already reached the realm of a Demigod.
With Zeraphine joining her, Nyx managed to relax a little.
However, on the fourth day, when a voice she recognised all too well entered her mind, she felt as though everything she knew about Kent and his life was merely a small piece of a much larger puzzle.
It turned out that Indie had regained her authority as the underworld Empress, and she wanted to inform Kent before she broke the seal on the cultivation in the underworld.
However, since he was unconscious, she reached out to Nyx instead.

While they could not communicate with those outside the Underworld, being within the same realm allowed them to communicate. Furthermore, now that Nyx had joined the harem, Indie was able to contact her directly.
After Nyx calmed down, she informed Indie of everything that had happened.
Indie, of course, did not panic.
After all, she had witnessed Kent undergo countless strange evolutions before, so she knew he would be fine.
However, she chose to halt the release of the seal that would remove the cultivation limit imposed on everyone.
She wanted Kent to wake up before doing that.
A while later, the Undead Staff also appeared out of thin air and came to rest beside Kent’s cocoon. It appeared to be awakening alongside the Bone Lich Undead Emperor.
Thankfully, on the fifth day, the cocoon cracked, and a wave of death qi seeped through the opening.
Soon, the crack widened further, and before long, every last fragment of the cocoon shattered apart.
Kent was revealed, now sporting crimson hair and crimson pupils.
While he still looked the same, the feeling he gave off had completely changed.
He felt like a dead man walking, and the aura of death surrounding him further enhanced his undead appearance.
His clothes had transformed into those of a combat necromancer.
He was now clad in a set of black robes and trousers, paired with leather boots. In addition, a fur-lined scarf rested around his neck.
The moment he stood up, a throne made of bone materialised behind him, and he calmly sat upon it.
The Staff of the Undead and the Undead Codex hovered beside him, just as they had in the past.
Lastly, his cultivation had advanced beyond the True Immortal Stage and reached the peak of the Immortal King Stage.
When Nyx and Zeraphine met his gaze, they felt as though they were staring directly into the eyes of death.
"Kent, are you still in there?" Nyx asked, a little sceptical about Kent’s well-being, even after Tower had assured her countless times that nothing bad would happen to Kent.
Kent looked at her for a few seconds before smiling.
"Of course I’m still in here. After all, I’m still the same person."
"So you were responsible, huh?" Nyx sighed, recalling what Ronan had revealed when Indie asked who knew what had happened to the first rulers. "You killed the Thirteen Rulers of the Underworld."
"Unfortunately, yes. But it wasn’t like they gave me any choice. In the end, they had it coming."
"I see," Nyx said, saying nothing more because she knew it wasn’t her place to judge.
"How are you dealing with all of this, though?" she asked.
However, she noticed that Kent was looking at Zeraphine.
After spending so much time with Zeraphine, Nyx had realised that she harboured feelings for Kent.
Unlike Nyx, who wanted to jump into his arms the day they reunited, Zeraphine was still in the budding stage of her feelings, even after thousands of years had passed.
So, seeing the two stare at each other, she knew that despite no words being spoken, emotions were being exchanged.
After staring at one another for a good five minutes, Zeraphine walked toward Kent and wrapped her arms around him.
It had been many years, but the person who had given her the strength to keep moving forward, even when surrounded by enemies, had finally returned to her side.
"I missed you so much," she said, resting comfortably in Kent’s arms.
"I missed you, too, Zera."
Hearing Kent use the shortened version of her name, she smiled happily. She would never allow anyone else to call her by that name. Only Kent had that privilege.
So hearing it again filled her heart with joy.
"You’ve become even more powerful and beautiful, Zera. I have a feeling the others will become jealous when they see the new you."
Zeraphine’s smile widened.
"I can’t wait to see them again."

"Sure. We’ll be leaving soon, so be ready by then. That said, since the seal on the Underworld is about to be released, we have to leave first. Or do you want to stay and cultivate a little longer to strengthen your foundation even more?"
"I’ll leave with you."
"Okay, then."
After making sure they had covered the basics, with matters such as revenge against her former friend and everyone who had tried to kill her being postponed until later, Kent turned to Nyx.

"You should enter seclusion soon. Indie is ready to release the seal, and once that happens, my presence here will be revealed. That would be bad news for all of you, so I must leave until everything is settled."
"Oh."
Nyx’s mood immediately soured upon hearing that Kent was leaving.
"Relax, Nyx. Indie will bring you back to meet the rest of your sisters. I’ll be waiting for you there. For now, I should leave before my old enemies sense my presence."
It took some convincing before Nyx finally nodded.
Kent later spent a few more hours with her, making sure she was at ease before returning to the Underworld Palace with Zeraphine.

chapters.title: Chapter 1676: Complex Plan
paragraphs: "So you are leaving?" Indie asked, holding Kent’s hand.
After inheriting the underworld empress’s authority, her presence now radiated absolute power. She appeared more powerful and exuded the aura of royalty.

"Yes, I have to leave before the Resentful Race, Undead Race, and Abyssal Race sense my presence," Kent laughed. "I didn’t expect I would recover my memories this early. Most importantly, I never expected that I was also the one who killed your subordinates."
He studied Indie’s expression, and when he saw no anger in her eyes, he sighed in relief. "I am sorry for that, Indie."

"Don’t worry, Kent. I am sure you had a reason for your actions." She reached out and planted a kiss on his forehead. "While it would have been nice to return and meet them still alive, I am not mad that they aren’t here anymore."
Kent smiled and nodded. While Indie clearly missed her subordinates, because of her relationship with Kent, she chose not to get angry.
If it had been someone else, she would have already started planning to avenge them.
He said nothing since he wanted to give her space to process things.

"Focus on your breakthroughs, Indie. The last time I was here, I reinforced the seal so that no one from outside the underworld could enter during this critical moment. When you are done, return with Nyx to meet the rest of her sisters."
Indie nodded. After sharing a kiss, she turned to Zeraphine. "We will catch up when I return to the land of the living."

Zeraphine smiled and nodded. She never knew that one of Kent’s wives was the Empress of the Underworld, whom Nyx had talked about during the five days’ wait while Kent was undergoing his undead evolution.
Now, it seemed she had another thing to be surprised about.
"Tell Miryssa I left. I am sure the reason she is not here is that she is having a good time in the garden."
"Yes. She said she can break through to the Extreme Ice stage."
"That is good, then. I will leave her in your care."
After Kent shared another kiss with Indie, she opened a portal for him and Zeraphine to return to the land of the living.
"See you soon, Indie."
With a wave, Kent and Zeraphine walked through the portal, and it closed behind them.
"See you soon, Kent."

Indie stood there for a few minutes before walking back to her cultivation space. After making sure she had everything in place, her voice spread throughout the underworld, reaching the thirteen rulers.

"I will open the seal three minutes from now. Use this time to break through and unlock your true authorities as Underworld Kings and Queens. Once everything is over, we will meet again to plan the future of the underworld."
A few minutes later, the seal broke, and they all felt a weight lift from them. Indie planned to let them reach their peak first before allowing the others to go through the same process.
She wanted them to gain their true authorities first so they could control their respective layers.
Soon, powerful auras began to appear throughout the underworld.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
[Three Deadly Enemies]
Meanwhile, deep within the Resentful Kingdom, hidden beneath the River of Styx, a man with six eyes and six arms, his body covered in countless tattoos, slowly opened all his eyes.
A wave of power so vast and unfathomable spread from his body. Each eye contained enough power to suppress entire galaxies.
This man was the King of the Resentful Kingdom, King Ossaki, the first resentful spirit to gain the power of the Dao. His strength existed on an entirely different level.

"Hmmm, looks like she has returned," King Ossaki muttered, a grin forming at the corner of his lips. "Since you have returned, it won’t be long before the seal that madman placed around the underworld breaks."
He tapped the armrest of his throne and chuckled.
"All in due time, Underworld Empress. All in due time."
Clearly, he sensed nothing of his true enemy, the Bone Lich Undead Emperor. If he had, he would have already mobilised an army to forcibly break the Underworld Seal.
And he wasn’t the only one.
Far within the Undead Realm, a man with pale white skin and a bone-like skull also smiled as he stood atop a mountain that pierced through the clouds.
His name was Undead Monarch Hagan.
Nobody truly knew how the Undead Realm came into existence. However, from what had been observed during the Undead War, only those who cultivated the power of death could truly kill them.
In most cases, unless they killed themselves, death was not something they feared. Unlike many necromancers who could lose their undead to divine powers, they are immune.
It was one of the main reasons even the Divine Temple, the Church of Light, and other powerful organisations had been powerless against them.
They are undead, but on another level.
Undead Monarch Hagan smirked.

"I have waited so long for your return, Underworld Empress. The last time we met, you chose to break the code and aid the living. For that, your death is inevitable, and when it happens, you will never be able to return from the dead again."
As someone who ruled the vastness of the Undead Realm, his power surpassed even that of Pandora.
Yet despite his strength, he also failed to sense the return of his one true enemy.
The same was true for Abyssal Monarch Morona, the person Kent planned to kill this time around, no matter what.
After the first Abyssal Monarch, Sir Madok, left for the Primal Chaos and never returned, she took control of the Abyssal Realm to rule over all nine kingdoms.
After all, she was Sir Madok’s firstborn.
It was also one of the reasons Sanders went there to search for Sir Madok. He believed he could trust her to help him find his benefactor, her father.
However, what he encountered was an attack from three sides—a betrayal he never forgot and would repay in due time.
"By now, those two bastards are probably planning to invade and plunder. I’d better be ready when they make their move."
She grinned evilly despite being one of the most beautiful women in the Abyssal Realm.
Her golden skin, golden eyes, and golden hair made her appear beautiful and, in some ways, angelic.
For her to grin so wickedly, it was only fitting that she was ranked among the most evil powerhouses of the three realms.
"Though I wonder why I feel a bit uneasy. The only time I felt this way was when that bastard broke his third seal and unleashed his death powers."
An image of a furious red-haired half-elf appeared in her mind.
"Don’t tell me he has also returned."
Her body shuddered, but she quickly collected her thoughts and sighed.
"I will face him when the time comes."
Unbeknownst to these three individuals, the person they planned to attack had long since sensed their malicious intentions and was already preparing to welcome them.
However, because they were focused on the underworld, they failed to realise that the true danger was the man who had just appeared on a planet somewhere within the Immortal Realm.
[Planet Fiamha - Chaos Star System]
Kent and Zeraphine appeared in front of a river so vast that, as far as their eyes could see, there was nothing but water.
Kent quickly activated his [Omniscient Jade Eye] to scan the planet and identify its name.
"Planet Fiamha, huh?"
Zeraphine’s body trembled at the mention of the planet’s name.
Seeing this, Kent asked, "Do you know this planet?"
She nodded and answered, "It is my home planet. This is where that bitch lives."
"Then let’s pay her a visit and make sure she stops breathing for good."

chapters.title: Chapter 1677: Complicated Life
paragraphs: Zeraphine was slightly stunned when she heard what Kent said.
"Are you sure we should go there? The last time I checked, she had several Immortals and over a dozen Demigods protecting her thanks to her family’s standing on Planet Fiamha."
Kent smirked, finding Zeraphine’s concern unnecessary.
In his opinion, even if the entire planet came after him, they wouldn’t be able to scratch his back. After all, he could summon dozens of Demigods with a flick of his hand.
But even if he chose not to, he alone could handle them.
His power was more than enough.

"You have nothing to worry about, Zeraphine. We are merely going for her head, so it should be simple enough. Of course, I want you to redeem yourself, and the only way to do that is to show her that even in the face of thousands, you have absolutely nothing to fear."
He reached for her hand and gave it a gentle squeeze.
"The last time I checked, you’ll be going with me. And let me tell you, I am far stronger than I look."
Indeed, he was far stronger.
Just like how the Symbiosis innate skill would allow him to inherit a percentage of the power of his Beast Legion, his Undead Class possessed a similar ability known as [Undead Bond].
This bond allowed him to inherit the power of his undead without affecting them in any way.𝑓𝑟𝑒𝘦𝓌𝑒𝑏𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝘭.𝒸𝘰𝑚
Since he had awakened that ability after his undead evolution, his strength had reached an entirely new level. He had inherited part of Kaizo and the other 11 undead currently under his command.
With that much power under his command, getting revenge for Zeraphine would be as simple as walking in and walking out.
"I have some things to take care of, so let’s get your revenge before I move on to them."
Zeraphine nodded after a few minutes of thought.
"In case we find ourselves in a dangerous situation, we should run immediately."
Kent smiled and nodded.
"We will. But I do hope we don’t find ourselves in such a situation."
They soon took flight and sped toward Crayon City, where the family of Zeraphine’s so-called best friend lived.
Kent had now awakened his Undead Class, and with it, he had recovered his memories.
However, instead of feeling happy, he realized his life had just become far more complicated.
Inside his Undead Codex was the Undead Legion he had once commanded.
However, to bring them back, he first had to perform a series of rituals, rituals that could only be carried out in specific locations.
Kaizo and the others were fortunate to have already been revived.
Now, he was left with unlocking some of their abilities and helping them awaken their full potential.
He planned to do that for all twelve undead currently under his command.
After that, he would embark on a journey to awaken the rest while preparing to venture back into the Chaos Abyss, this time with no intention of leaving without his parents.
Of course, to do that, he had to become a Demigod or even a god first.
But Kent had no plans to wait that long.
He had no idea what condition his parents were in after millions of years had passed, so delaying was not an option.
Thankfully, the tower had quests for him to follow, quests that involved reclaiming his undead while building his strength on the side.
The only downside now was his other professions.
He had a series of tasks to complete before becoming a Sword Legend.
He also had to become a Pill Immortal so he could carry out the revenge on the pill god for vexthra.
He also needed to participate in the Trial of Wisdom, as it was the only way to gain access to hidden records and further expand his knowledge of the universe.
Lastly, he had to prepare for the Chaos Rift’s awakening.
Ever since the day he learned about it, he had been plagued by a sense of unease.
Something deep within him kept warning him not to enter.
Yet Kent knew he had no choice.
After all, he had already received a quest related to it.
As they soared toward the city, Kent couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
’Sorry, Mother, Father. You will have to wait a little longer. I have some things to take care of first, plus I am not strong enough.’
If they were still alive and had met Prince Anvil, they would reunite with him one day.
’For now, I must focus on my alchemy while awakening the rest of my undead.’
Zeraphine had no idea that while they were flying toward the city, hundreds of Shadow Fiends continuously emerged from Kent’s shadow, each one moving in a different direction.
As they headed toward different targets, it wouldn’t be long before more undead joined his legion.
He wanted to stay ahead of things.
By the time the city came into view, thousands of Shadow Fiends had already escaped from his shadow.
Many had successfully slipped into the shadows of travelers who would soon leave the planet for other worlds, bringing them, and by extension, Kent, closer to his intended targets.
For now, only revenge occupied his thoughts.
They landed and quickly made their way toward the city gate, where five guards stood watch.
The moment their gazes landed on Zeraphine, Kent noticed a cold glint flash through their eyes.
All five were Immortal Emperors.
However, since Zeraphine was now a Demigod, they showed no arrogance beyond the obvious hostility in their eyes.
One of them retrieved a communication token and sent a message to whoever was on the other end.
A few minutes later, Kent and Zeraphine stood before the gate, with the five guards blocking their path.
"I wonder why you are blocking us when everyone else paid and was allowed to enter," Kent said, a smile forming on his face.
"You are not welcome in Crayon City," one of the guards said, his gaze locked onto Kent, whom he assumed was the weaker of the two.
After all, Kent was merely an Immortal King, while he himself was an Immortal Emperor.
Going against Zeraphine, a Demigod, seemed like a terrible idea.
Unfortunately for them, they had targeted the wrong person.
Kent laughed upon hearing the guard’s response.
"But today is my first time ever coming here. Are you saying I am too handsome to be allowed entry?"
His words caused the guards to frown.
However, with Zeraphine standing beside Kent, it was practically impossible for them to make a move.
Kent noticed their hesitation and laughed even harder.

"I know you contacted your employer and informed them that Zeraphine is here. That is fine, since I came for the big fish anyway. However, since you dare prevent my magnificent self from entering the city, I hereby sentence the five of you to ten days of eternal torment."
Kent flicked his hand, and black smoke engulfed the five guards.
Their screams soon echoed throughout the city, drawing the attention of thousands.
Kent stepped over the bodies of the guards he had just cast into the Realm of Evil, where they would endure endless torment.
He had come for revenge, and so he decided to wield the power of evil to punish his enemies.
Kent summoned the Undead Throne and sat down.
Then, with a gentle wave of his hand, Zeraphine was pulled onto his lap.
She had no idea how it happened, but she did not resist.
"My name is Kent Madson, and this message is for the Crayon Great Family."
His voice was calm, yet it carried across the entire city.
"Hand over the bitch named Mercy, and I will leave this place without laying a finger on any of you. Resist, and watch me bring an end to your fragile lives."
His voice spread throughout the city, traveling over 200,000 kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1678: Absolute Power
paragraphs: As Kent’s voice spread far and wide, many people began making their way toward the city gates from which the voice originated.
Many wanted to know what the mysterious Kent Madson looks like. After all, his name had spread far and wide, shocking countless people with his feats.
He had appeared on three Dao Tablets, something that had never happened before.
Naturally, that was more than enough reason for people to be curious about him.

However, while his arrival would finally satisfy their curiosity, the contents of his words made many wonder what exactly the Crayon Great Family had done to someone who was already the most wanted man in the universe.
"Is that him?" those who reached the city gates first whispered to one another.
"I think that’s him. He’s so handsome," some of the ladies said, blushing. It was a natural reaction that showed Kent was indeed worthy of his reputation.
"He is also very young," others muttered, hoping their words would not reach Kent’s ears.
"I wonder who the lady sitting on his lap is."

"I know her. She is the daughter of that old man whose entire family was slaughtered on their way back from the Green Wealth Festival. I heard that she was the only survivor and was later raised by the Crayon Great Family."
The man paused for a moment before continuing.
"I believe her name is Zeraphine, one of the most outstanding cultivators this city has ever produced."

Many who heard him nodded. After all, they had heard of Zeraphine before. It was said that she cultivated hypnosis and illusion techniques, transforming her soul flame into one of the deadliest hypnotic flames in the world.
Years ago, she had suddenly vanished, sending the Crayon Great Family into a panic. However, she returned about 20,000 years ago only to vanish again.
"If she was raised by the Crayon Great Family, then why is she here demanding the Young Miss’s head? Weren’t they like real sisters the last time I checked?"
"Indeed. I even heard that the Young Miss stopped eating after Lady Zeraphine disappeared years ago."
"If she really came here to kill her, then I think she’s ungrateful. I wouldn’t harm the hand that fed me, especially if it belonged to a family like the Crayon Great Family."

Many began criticizing Zeraphine, carefully keeping their voices low enough not to be overheard. However, as those opinions started spreading through the crowd, someone who knew a different version of the story suddenly spoke up.

"Haven’t you heard? The Crayon Great Family raised her as a treasure for Lady Mercy. A friend of mine, who serves as a guard at the Crayon Mansion, told me that, some time ago, thousands of immortals and demigods were sent to hunt down someone.
"At first, he didn’t know who the target was. However, after he was added to the mission later and gathered more information, he learned what had truly happened.
It turned out that after Lady Zeraphine returned from wherever she had disappeared to, her strength had risen to an entirely new level.
More importantly, her soul flame had undergone a miraculous evolution and had become a Primordial Flame.

CRACK!
The whip descended once more.

CRACK!

"I was a fool, Mercy."
CRACK!
"I should have known from the beginning."
CRACK!

BOOM!

Not when she was merely an Immortal Lord facing a Demigod who had trained every single second in the Land of the Dead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1679: The Ruthless Bandit Unleashed
paragraphs: The more attacks Zeraphine rained down on Mercy, the more the frustration and anger she had held back all these years poured out. Indeed, while she was in the Flame Sea, not a single day went by without her thinking of her friend, her sister.
She had always thought of her, imagining the day they would meet again.
However, when they finally met, her true nature was revealed, and Zeraphine realized that the one she had called a sister for years was actually the devil herself.

Fast forward to after she was rescued by Uncle Drew and brought to the Underworld, Zerpahine finally learned what had happened to her parents from Nyx, whose underworld-queen powers allowed her to see the dead’s memories.

It turned out that when Zeraphine awakened her spirit root, it was actually a Supreme-grade spirit root that had been mistaken for a Diamond-grade one. Somehow, Lord Crayon discovered the truth, and so he plotted the assassination of Zeraphine’s entire family.
Then, after succeeding, he swooped in and took Zeraphine in, hoping to raise her until she was old enough for him to harvest her spirit root for his daughter.
What he never expected was that, aside from her spirit root, Zeraphine would also awaken her Soul Flame and an innate talent that partially awakened her bloodline.
This discovery was what prolonged Zeraphine’s life throughout the years she lived with them.
They wanted her to grow into the impressive young lady she was destined to become before taking everything from her.
Unfortunately for them, she was pulled into a void vortex while out adventuring, and for years, she was stuck in the flame sea.
After years without seeing her, they speculated that she might have learned what happened to her family and run away.
If that was the case, they had to find a way to draw her back into their sight. That was when they chose to use the bond she shared with Mercy.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
Word spread that Lady Mercy was in trouble. When Zeraphine returned to the Immortal Realm and heard this, she rushed back, only to find the people she had called family pointing their weapons at her.
The betrayal cut too deep, and so now that she had the chance to exact her revenge on the one whose betrayal had wounded her the most, she held nothing back.
Meanwhile, on the side, Kent had only counted to eight when a demigod with flowing white hair and a long beard stepped out of a void portal.
Following him were eight other demigods, proving that Zeraphine had been right; they had about a dozen demigods. With his eyes, Kent immediately knew that the man was the bastard he was waiting for.

He raised a finger and snapped, deactivating the [Evil King’s Judgment] and [Domain of Evil] skills he had activated. When the mist cleared, and the details of what had transpired within were revealed, many took a step back.
Only one demigod remained barely alive.

The rest had been cut into several pieces, heads and body parts scarred all over. Nobody knew what had happened inside the mist, but now that they had seen the aftermath, they wished they had never had.
The demigod who survived looked terrified when his gaze met Kent’s.
The bastard merely smiled and waved his hand dismissively.
"You are free to go."
The demigod vanished from sight, running as though his life depended on it.
Well, his life did depend on it.
After all, what he had witnessed was the wake-up call he needed to realize that the life he was living was not the right one for him.
After he was gone, Kent turned toward the white-haired old man.
"I am going to offer you a chance at redemption.
"First, get down on your knees and confess that you were the one behind the murder of Zeraphine’s parents. Then apologize to her.
"Second, get on the ground and crawl through the city gate, and I might consider taking only one of your hands.

"Third, judging by how little you care about the fact that your daughter is getting thrashed, I know you’re a cold-hearted bastard just like me. So how about you call me Big Brother Kent, and I’ll let you live. After all, death is inevitable, no matter how tragic it may be."
"How about a fourth option where you crawl over here and kiss my feet?" the old man said with a sneer.
The moment Lord Crayon spoke, thousands of portals opened across the sky, and thousands of immortal warriors stepped through them.
"You may be Kent Madson, but don’t think your status will save you from me today."
Kent watched as thousands of immortals began to surround him. Soon, he was completely encircled, and some of them even moved toward Zeraphine.
"So you choose death, huh? That’s exactly what I’d expect from a blockhead like you."
Kent smirked.

Then his cloak-like armor shifted. Black cloak mixed with leather spread across his body, forming a sinister suit of armor. Behind him, thirteen tendrils extended outward like dark cloaks swaying in the wind.
His [Evil Armor] fully covered his body, and with it, his Evil Core surged with power.
"I hope all of you can bear witness to this. I offered your master a chance at redemption, but he rejected it. Now, allow me to take out the trash."
The moment he finished speaking, Kent moved.
What followed was a bloodbath beyond anything anyone had imagined.

Every swing of his sword sent heads flying through the air. Every movement of his body caused the thirteen tendrils behind him to lash out like living serpents, piercing the heads of immortals with terrifying precision.
On the other side of the battlefield, the immortals and the two demigods pursuing Zeraphine were suddenly forced to halt.
Shadowy figures emerged from the darkness.
One after another, they solidified into existence before them.
Kent had summoned Shadow Fiends to protect Zeraphine.
Not that he was worried about her safety. Zeraphine was more than capable of protecting herself.
Rather, he wanted her to take her time and enjoy her revenge.
As the battle continued, it quickly became obvious who was winning and who was losing.
In fact, many immortals began to flee once Kent’s slaughter reached an unprecedented level.
Unfortunately for them, they never got far.
Shadow Fiends emerged from every direction, cutting off all paths of escape.
With Kent’s legion constantly clearing dungeons, their kills continued to clear more requirements, allowing him to unlock even more Shadow Fiends.
As a result, despite deploying countless fiends across different worlds he planned to visit, he still had more than enough to spare.
"There is no need to run. I already gave your master a chance to redeem himself, and he rejected it. Now, you have only yourselves to blame for following a blind master."
Less than an hour later, the skies above Crayon City had turned crimson.
Panic spread throughout the city.
Everyone was terrified.
By then, Zeraphine had already completed her revenge.
Yet, to everyone’s surprise, she did not kill Mercy.
In truth, death would have been a kinder fate.
Instead, she crippled Mercy’s cultivation, destroying everything she had spent her life building.
But while Zeraphine had shown mercy to her greatest enemy, Kent, who had completely lost himself in the slaughter, he spared no one.
Hours later, only a single person remained alive.
Lord Crayon.
Many hoped Kent would toy with him for a while before ending his life.
Instead, Kent’s sword suddenly moved with a sharp and precise arc.
Lord Crayon’s head separated from his body and flew into the air.
The battle ended instantly.
The moment Lord Crayon died, Kent returned to his true form.
His dragon horns reappeared, and his long purple hair flowed behind him once more.
The terrifying aura of evil surrounding him vanished completely.
Only then did everyone realize that the suffocating coldness weighing upon their hearts had disappeared.
Kent calmly walked back to his Bone Throne and sat down.
"When they ask what happened here today, tell them this..."
His gaze swept across the trembling crowd.
"Kent Madson never forgets a promise of revenge."
The next moment, he and Zeraphine vanished from sight and reappeared directly inside the Dungeon Tower.
Meanwhile, back in Crayon City, chaos erupted.
With Lord Crayon dead and the Crayon Great Family destroyed, countless people rushed toward the family’s estates, vaults, and treasure houses.
Since the owners were now dead, everyone wanted a piece of the enormous wealth the family had accumulated over countless years.

Instead, Kent’s sword suddenly moved with a sharp and precise arc.
Lord Crayon’s head separated from his body and flew into the air.
The battle ended instantly.
The moment Lord Crayon died, Kent returned to his true form.
His dragon horns reappeared, and his long purple hair flowed behind him once more.
The terrifying aura of evil surrounding him vanished completely.
Only then did everyone realize that the suffocating coldness weighing upon their hearts had disappeared.
Kent calmly walked back to his Bone Throne and sat down.
"When they ask what happened here today, tell them this..."
His gaze swept across the trembling crowd.
"Kent Madson never forgets a promise of revenge."
The next moment, he and Zeraphine vanished from sight and reappeared directly inside the Dungeon Tower.
Meanwhile, back in Crayon City, chaos erupted.
With Lord Crayon dead and the Crayon Great Family destroyed, countless people rushed toward the family’s estates, vaults, and treasure houses.
Since the owners were now dead, everyone wanted a piece of the enormous wealth the family had accumulated over countless years.

chapters.title: Chapter 1680: Legendary Moment In Alchemy
paragraphs: [Planet Qilin - Everlasting Pill Mountain]
"I can’t believe a day like this would ever come," a man clad in a green robe said as he sat among others wearing the same robe.
Around them, thousands of others, many bearing the same color of clothing and badge, could be seen seated, all staring at the stage where a beautiful silver cauldron stood.
Clearly, whatever reason there was for all of them to gather here had to do with alchemy. Every last person present was either a Pill Divine or a Pill Immortal.

"The last time something like this happened was when Pill God Brandon attempted to concoct a Tier 22 pill with one Crimson, three Violet, and five Azure pill rings. To think Pill Immortal Flura is attempting the same tier of pill but with two Crimson Pill Rings. If she succeeds, it would be mind-blowing."
"I know, right? When she submitted her request to the Eastern Pill Council, I expected them to reject her. But to think she was actually granted permission to host this gathering."
"I learned that the Five Pill Sects and the Four Pill Clans had been threatening her to join them, or else they would destroy her, but she refused. If she succeeds, all of them would be beneath her."
"If that was her reason for this gathering, then I hope she succeeds. Those bastards sure have some nerve threatening a fine alchemist such as Pill Immortal Flura."
"They should be ashamed of themselves."
As more people discussed various topics, others kept arriving, the majority of them Pill Immortals. Some wore silver Pill Immortal badges, while others wore gold Pill Immortal badges.
Soon, someone unique with a Platinum Pill Legend badge arrived and took his seat in a quiet corner.
The man possessed the aura of an Immortal King, and he looked far too young to be sitting among Pill Immortals, some of whom appeared to be in their sixties.
He was also a red-haired half-elf, something that made him stand out like a sore thumb.
The moment he settled down, many started whispering about him.
"Look, that Mad Alchemist is here as well."

"I learned that he spent an entire month moving from one Pill Sect to another, challenging alchemists to duels. The last I heard, he had defeated a Pill Legend, and a day later, he became a Pill Legend himself.
Three days later, he concocted a Tier 19 pill with two Violet and four Azure Pill Rings.
Right now, I’m sure he’s here to gain inspiration and attempt to become a Pill Divine."
"What a monster."
"Between him and Pill Immortal Flura, who do you think is better?"
"That remains to be seen, but he is a good alchemist for sure... minus the mad part, that is."
The redhead smiled slightly, ignoring what people were saying about him. Though he didn’t mind, since everything they said was true. He had indeed done all they said and then some.
Naturally, this redhead was Kent in disguise.
When he and Zeraphine returned to the tower, Kent decided to focus on alchemy. Using the time inside the tower to his advantage, he completed the requirement and finally became a Pill Sovereign.
He had to concoct a Tier 15 pill, which he managed after spending a week practicing.

The moment he accomplished that and became a Pill Sovereign, memories of his life as Pill Celestial Kevin Sage returned to him. It wasn’t all of his memories, but it was enough to pave the way for him to reach the Pill God stage.
However, with his memories restored, the requirements to become a Pill Legend also tripled.
He completed some of them inside the tower, while the rest led him to the Pill Star System of the Eastern Region.
The moment he arrived, he began challenging prominent alchemists who stood at the peak of their respective levels to make a name for himself.
His first pill duel was against a Pill Sovereign who had already earned a Diamond Badge.
In alchemy, there are several badge ranks. The first is Bronze, followed by Copper, Silver, Gold, Diamond, and Platinum.
Some say there is also a Ruby Badge, but that is only awarded to Pill Gods. But it had been many years since anyone had earned such a badge.
After defeating that Pill Sovereign, he went on to challenge others, and soon his name began to spread throughout the Eastern Region.
In no time, he became a Pill Legend, and he continued onward, building an even greater reputation. He concealed his identity since he wanted to draw more attention before revealing who he truly was.
Another reason he hid his identity was to ensure Pill Immortal Flura would not recognize him. This way, he could surprise her later.

Luckily for him, he learned of her event and decided to attend. A part of him wanted to see how far she had grown and also identify those who were using their power and influence to pressure her into submitting to them.
If they dared make a move on her, he wouldn’t mind sending them to the afterlife.
With his path now leading toward the Pill Divine stage, he planned to cement his status first before revealing himself to the world of swordsmen.
His swordsmanship had already surpassed his alchemy by a considerable margin before he ascended to the immortal realm.
But now, he had improved his alchemy far beyond even his swordsmanship.
While he sat there, his gaze remained fixed on a blue panel that nobody aside from him could see. Displayed on it was a quest he had received upon arriving here.
He never expected the Tower and the Quest Pool to give him such a quest.
[Quest Name: Renegade Alchemist]
[Rank: SSS+]
[Description: Foil the plans of Pill God Brandon and sow the first seed that will sprout and bloom into your inevitable clash.]
[Reward: Fruit of Resentment]
The quest description was very vague. However, Kent knew his target was the bastard Vexthra wanted him to kill.
’So your name is Brandon, huh? Very good. I will begin my revenge today and, in the near future, I will rip your tongue out of your mouth.’𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
A cold light flashed across his eyes, but it vanished the next second when a drop-dead gorgeous lady he recognized all too well walked onto the stage with a beautiful smile on her face.

Kent had no idea what had happened, but Pill Immortal Flura was now sporting long green hair paired with dreamy green eyes. Just like before, her breasts were moderate in size, and her hips were exactly as he remembered—not overly large, but broad and accentuated by her slender waist.
Her facial features had also become more refined. Her delicate cheekbones and cherry-blossom lips made her even more beautiful than before.

As she walked toward the stage, Kent could sense the aura of nine Absolute-Grade Primordial Flames within her. These were the very flames he had helped her obtain back when they entered the Pill Ascension Realm together.
Now, she had nurtured them, strengthened them, and completely adapted to every single one of them, finally completing her [Nine Flames Refining Art].
’Way to go, Flura. Now let’s see whether you can make history and earn recognition from the Pill Dao.’
What she was about to attempt had never been done before.
Not even the legendary Kevin Sage had attempted such a feat.
It seemed Flura truly wanted her name engraved upon the Pill Dao Tablet. That was why she had chosen this path and worked tirelessly to arrange this legendary moment in the history of alchemy.
If she succeeded, her name would spread far and wide throughout the universe...

chapters.title: Chapter 1681: Making History (1)
paragraphs: The moment Pill Immortal Flura stood at the center of the stage, everyone quieted down. They all turned their attention toward her.
After all, they had come to witness her attempt at the impossible.
Pill Immortal Flura first turned toward an elevated platform where ten elders sat behind a table laden with lavish fruits and other delicacies.
The first five were the Sect Masters of the Five Pill Sects in the Eastern Region. They are among the powerhouses in the pill world in the Eastern region.
The number of alchemists they had produced over the years was simply too great to count.
They had nurtured Pill Gods, Pill Supremes, and even a few Pill Celestials. Their status, therefore, stood on a different level entirely.
In the past, they had competed fiercely among themselves to recruit Pill Immortal Flura, who they claim was a talent unlike any they had witnessed in the past one million years.
However, to their disappointment, she had rejected all their offers.

While they had ultimately accepted her decision not to join any of their sects and even felt like they had been disrespected by a junior, the moment news spread that she was attempting to create a pill miracle, they all came to witness it firsthand.
The other four elders seated beside them were the heads of the Four Pill Clans.
They, too, had tried to bring her under their banner, but they failed. Over time, some of them even attempted to use force and intimidation, only to meet failure after failure.
Eventually, they stopped, but never let a chance to shoot their shot pass them by.
Lastly, the final elder, whose authority had ultimately determined whether this gathering could proceed, nodded toward Pill Immortal Flura, and she nodded back in return.
"Thank you all for coming," she said.
"Then you’d better make my trip here worthwhile," Clan Chief Laiyan said as he took a bite of meat.
He was the only one among the four clan heads who had never threatened Pill Immortal Flura.
That said, he had spent years trying to set her up with one of his grandchildren, but Flura rejected all of them. In a way, she saved them from Kent’s wrath.
Hearing him speak, Pill Immortal Flura smiled and nodded.
Just as she was about to address everyone and then start with her concoction, a dark-haired beauty entered the arena with a brown-haired lady by her side.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
The dark-haired woman was an Immortal King, just like Pill Immortal Flura.
However, the lady accompanying her was a Demigod, and judging by the bloodlust hidden within her eyes, she had clearly fought her way through countless hardships and near-death experiences.
"Sorry, I’m late, Pill Immortal Flura. I hope I didn’t interrupt anything," the dark-haired beauty said with an apologetic smile.
Pill Immortal Flura smiled and shook her head.
"Right on time, Lady Veth."
"Wonderful," Lady Veth replied with a bright smile before quickly taking her seat.
The brown-haired Demigod beside her also sat down.
Looking around, Kent could tell that many throughout the arena couldn’t hide their surprise.
Who in the Eastern Region didn’t know Lady Veth, the owner of the legendary [Dream Pill Emporium]?
Almost every pill produced within the Eastern Region—and even many from other regions—could be found within her stores.
In fact, even if they didn’t have a particular pill in stock, they would find a way to acquire it for you, provided you could afford the price.
Her influence stretched far and wide.
As such, the moment she arrived, many who had not been taking Pill Immortal Flura’s gathering seriously immediately sat upright.

Meanwhile, Kent smiled slightly from his corner when he saw Lady Veth arrive alongside the Serpent Guard he had given her back when he traveled through time to the Pill World to act as her friend and guardian.
It seemed that even after all these years, she still trusted the guardian he had left in her care.
’Looks like she had indeed built a life for herself in the Immortal World as she promised.’
He smiled again and decided to let her be for now. When the time was right, he would reveal himself.
"Thank you for all coming," Pill Immortal Flura began. "I called you all here not to waste your time, but to witness history being written right before your eyes.
"Over the years, I have learned, relearned, and continued learning everything I could about alchemy.

"From the day I set out to become an alchemist, I faced many obstacles. The first obstacle was arrogance. Back in the High World, I felt like I was the best among my peers. Because of that, I looked down on everyone around me.
"However, an encounter with someone far below my rank changed everything. He not only defeated me without even trying, but he also made sure I understood what it truly meant to be an alchemist.
"In his own words, he said that on the path of alchemy, there is always someone better. However, if you wish to make a difference, you must carve your own path and walk it wholeheartedly.
"His words touched me, and since then, I have been walking my own path. It has served me well to this very day.
"Today, I seek to accomplish what has never been achieved in the history of alchemy.
"I seek to concoct a Tier 22 Soul Tempering Pill with two Crimson, five Violet, and ten Azure Pill Rings. To do so, I will use 14 high-quality Tier 22 ingredients.
"As for whether or not I can accomplish this feat, I believe I can. That is why I invite everyone here to witness the birth of the first Immortal-Grade Pill with two Crimson Pill Rings."
After saying what she had to say, she opened the floor for questions.
Many immediately began asking all kinds of questions.
She answered each one to the best of her ability, but when one particular question was asked, the entire venue fell silent.
Kent, who had been seated quietly, suddenly raised his hand and stood up.
"Hello. I only have one question," Kent said, a smile forming on his face.
"From what I have read, nobody has ever attempted what you are about to accomplish.
"And if history serves us right, all those who achieved what was once considered impossible were recognized by the Pill Dao, and their names were forever engraved upon the Pill Dao Tablet.
"Are you seeking to have your name placed there, among legends such as Pill Celestial Kevin Sage and the recently added young prodigy, Kent Madson?"
Pill Immortal Flura blinked a few times before smiling.
"I have always dreamed of having my name there. So yes, this endeavor is my attempt to have my name engraved upon the Pill Dao Tablet and be recognized by the Pill Dao.
"That said, I do not consider myself equal to the founding fathers who paved the way for us.
"But if history wishes to place my name there, then who am I to refuse?" She smiled, which made many also smile.
"Thank you for answering my question, and I wish you all the best," Kent said with a smile before sitting back down.
Now that the memories of Kevin Sage had returned to him, he could tell at a glance that Pill Immortal Flura was extremely confident in herself.
That made him wonder where such confidence came from.
Then again, time would tell.
After answering a few more questions, she bowed lightly and sat behind her cauldron.
She gently brushed her palm across its surface for a moment before smiling.
Soon, a yellow flame ignited and surrounded the cauldron.
Then a red flame emerged and joined it, beginning to heat the cauldron from another angle.
Many widened their eyes at the sight.
Activating two flames from the very beginning was enough to shock even experienced alchemists.
Over the years, countless people had wondered just how many flames she possessed.
Perhaps, before this event ended, they would finally receive their answer.
Meanwhile, as soon as she began, Kent quietly began sending Shadow Fiends into strategic positions throughout the venue.
He had no intention of taking any chances.
In total, he released more than three hundred Shadow Fiends, each hidden and ready to strike the moment danger appeared.
Aside from that, he also instructed Tower to stream the event to his wives and the various legions currently grinding inside the Dungeon Tower.
After heating the cauldron for several minutes, Pill Immortal Flura picked up the first ingredient and tossed it into the cauldron.
With that single action, the making of history officially began.

chapters.title: Chapter 1682 - 1679 - Making History (2)
paragraphs: The ingredients Pill Immortal Flura had selected for the Soul Tempering Pill were all of the highest quality, each worth billions of Spirit Stones.
A single ingredient alone could support the cultivation needs of an entire Medium World for several years.
As such, everyone who understood the value of those ingredients sucked in a cold breath when she tossed the [Spirit Wind Vein] into the cauldron.
After all, she had prepared only a single set of ingredients.
One mistake would mean the end of everything.
Her control over the flames was precise as she began refining the ingredient, carefully extracting every last trace of essence hidden within it.
Unlike Kent, who had already mastered Perfect Extraction—a feat he had achieved even in his previous life—Flura had yet to reach that level of mastery.
Even so, she managed to achieve a ninety-five percent extraction rate, a result that very few alchemists in existence could rival.
Most alchemists became stuck at eighty percent.
Talented individuals could reach eighty-five percent.
The best of the best, often referred to as geniuses, could push themselves to ninety percent.
As for prodigies, they generally ranked between ninety-one and ninety-five percent.
Already, achieving ninety-five percent extraction was an extraordinary accomplishment.
However, whether she could maintain that level of precision through all fourteen ingredients remained to be seen.
Once she finished extracting the essence of the first ingredient, she tossed the [Sandering Flame Seed] into the cauldron and immediately began refining it.
This time, the process took less time than before.
Soon, the second ingredient was completed.
Then came the third ingredient.
An [Ancient Soul Bone] harvested from an extremely powerful soul-type beast.
Next came the [Chaos Pearl] and the [Mind Clearing Herb].
As more ingredients were refined, the gathered alchemists began to sense a faint aroma rising from the concentrated essences floating within the cauldron.
The [Soul Silver], [Heavenly Torment Root], and the bloodline essence of a soul-type beast soon followed.
With every ingredient successfully refined, more and more people found themselves wondering the same thing.
Could she truly refine all fourteen ingredients without ruining even one?
The answer remained unknown as they watched ingredient after ingredient disappear into the cauldron.

After extracting the essences from treasures such as the [Starlight Soul Jade], [Void Crystal], [Dragon Spirit Scale], [Phoenix Soul Feather], and [Primordial Night Dew], it was finally time for the main ingredient.
Pill Immortal Flura carefully lifted the [Soul Lotus Core].
With a delicate motion, she allowed it to hover above the cauldron for several seconds before gently releasing it.
The moment it descended into the cauldron, countless eyes narrowed.
Many of those present had attended the previous Quarter Auction held by one of the Eastern Region’s most prestigious auction houses.
They could clearly remember the fierce bidding war that erupted over the [Soul Lotus Core].
At the time, Pill Immortal Flura and another Pill Immortal had battled relentlessly for ownership of the treasure.
In the end, Pill Immortal Flura emerged victorious.
Back then, many believed she had overpaid.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Now, however, they finally understood why she had refused to back down.
After all, the person she had competed against was widely recognised as someone destined to become a Pill God in the near future.
Yet she had still fought for the treasure without hesitation.
And now, standing before them all, she was about to prove exactly why.
The person in question was present, albeit in disguise.
When he saw the precious lotus he had lost at the auction being lowered into the cauldron, he sighed and clenched his fist.
’Bitch, just wait. Soon, I will make you pay for ruining my plans.’
He gritted his teeth as a faint killing intent flashed across his eyes.
Kent, who was extremely sensitive to any form of intent, immediately picked up on the fluctuation and silently commanded a Shadow Fiend to slip into the man’s shadow.
The moment he made a move, his head would be rolling off his shoulders.
Hours passed.
Soon, after seven hours, all fourteen ingredients had been successfully refined and their essences extracted.
The moment the extraction phase was completed, everyone shifted in their seats.
They all knew that the next step would determine whether Pill Immortal Flura would succeed or whether everything up until now had been for nothing.
The five Sect Masters, the four Clan Heads, and the elder from the Pill Council all sat at the edge of their seats, eager to see what Pill Immortal Flura had prepared next.
Sect Master Qianyu let out a sigh.
"The last time, it was at this stage that Pill God Brandon failed, causing him to lose one Violet Pill Ring."
"Indeed," another elder replied. "I was there as well and witnessed everything. He overheated his cauldron, which resulted in more essence being burned away than intended."
Pill Immortal Flura smiled and took a deep breath.
The next second, she flicked her hand.
Three additional flames ignited.
Gasps instantly echoed throughout the arena.
Already, the fact that she had been controlling two flames simultaneously was enough to turn heads.
Now, she had unleashed three more, bringing the total to five.
The moment the flames appeared, they surrounded the cauldron and moved in perfect synchrony, assisting their master in purifying the remaining impurities from the essences.
"This is unreal," a Pill Immortal seated among the crowd muttered, looking dazed as he watched the five flames work together seamlessly.
"The last time I checked, only Pill Gods and above could control more than two flames at once. Just how powerful is her soul that she can manage five?"

"Forget that. What I’m focused on is the fact that all five flames are Primordial Flames, and every one of them has reached the Absolute Stage. Where did she even find them, and how did she make all of them submit to her?"
"Wait... you’re right!"
"No way. That completely escaped me."
"Just where did she obtain five Primordial Flames?"
The more questions people asked, the more details they began noticing.
The mere fact that she possessed five Primordial Flames was enough to make countless people wonder about her true background.
No answers were forthcoming.
The only person capable of providing them was completely focused on burning away the impurities within the extracted essences.
Meanwhile, Kent continued observing Pill Immortal Flura from his seat.
While everyone else was focused on her possession of five Primordial Flames, his attention was fixed on something entirely different.
Something far more shocking.
’This feeling... has she already cultivated her flames to the Extreme Stage?’
The thought surfaced in his mind as he sensed that the truly astonishing part had yet to be revealed.
Pill Immortal Flura appeared far too relaxed for someone currently handling such a delicate process.
Kent, having interacted with powerful elementals in both this life and his previous one, could sense that there was something profoundly different about the flames she was controlling.
And he was right.
While everyone around her continued discussing and speculating, she was calmly enjoying a conversation with her flames.
What many people—including Kent—didn’t know was that Pill Immortal Flura had long ago nurtured her Primordial Flames to the point where all nine of their Flame Spirits had reached the Extreme Stage.
However, several months ago, something even more astonishing had occurred.
Without warning, all nine Flame Spirits evolved into a new state.
A state they referred to as Primordial Flame Spirits.
According to them, just as humans could awaken Primordial Souls, they too had crossed into a similar realm of existence.
Furthermore, they claimed that if she could eventually nurture them to the Eternal Stage, they would one day transform into Sacred Flames, just like the legendary Nine Nirvana Flames.
Her confidence had never come from discovering some ancient alchemical secret.
Nor had it come from hidden knowledge left behind by ancient masters.
No.
Her confidence came from the absolute trust she had in her Nine Primordial Flames.
She believed they would help her accomplish what no one else had ever achieved.
’Taiyang, don’t rush to finish too early, buddy. We have more than enough time to show these old fogies who’s boss.’
Her yellow flame immediately responded.
’Okay, Big Sister. It’s just that I can’t wait to see what we’re making this time.’
’Me too, buddy.’
Pill Immortal Flura smiled inwardly.
’Xuanyuan, I like the flow. Keep it this steady, and we’ll make history soon.’
A gentle feminine voice answered.
’I’m looking forward to it too, Big Sister.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1683: Making History (3)
paragraphs: ’Youming, isolate the essence and burn the tiniest impurity you can find.’
’Hundian, I like how you are protecting the essence. Keep at that, and I will reward you when we are done.’
’Benyuan, buddy, I can tell you have learned from your previous mistake. That is nice. Keep learning, and I have no doubt that when we meet Kent again, we will beat him black and blue.’

Pill Immortal Flura kept issuing commands while controlling the flames herself to burn the impurities. All around, many could only stare in shock as all five flames worked together to burn the impurities.

It was simply too mind-bending, and that was perfectly understandable. Four hours later, she exhaled and smiled. This was a signal that she had finished burning the impurities and was now about to condense the pill.
This part was also very essential. After all, condensing a pill without wasting any essence meant retaining more than enough essence to refine pill rings.
After making sure she had calmed down a bit, she got right to condensing the pill. So far, she had spent eleven hours extracting the essence and burning impurities.
Condensing took less time, but to be on the safe side, she started slowly.
Soon, a couple of minutes passed, but nothing out of the ordinary happened, which was a good thing.
After all, burning the essence would have been alarming. But to everyone’s shock, she had yet to make any mistakes.
And that trend continued for another hour and a half before people started to smell the aroma coming from the pill. This showed that she was close to completing the condensation process.
Thirty minutes later, the pill was fully condensed, and the next major stage began.

Everyone retrieved recording jades and started recording the refining process. If she succeeded, this moment would go down in history, so many began recording, making sure every single moment was captured clearly and perfectly.
Kent also shifted in his seat when the process was about to begin. He knew with certainty that this was where Pill Immortal Flura would show her true prowess, so he sat back, relaxed, and watched.
Lo and behold, the moment she started refining the pill rings, a sixth flame lit up.
This shocked everyone else, but Kent remained calm, observing closely to uncover the hidden nature of her flames and what was giving her such confidence.
As she continued refining the pill rings, Kent noticed that she was still holding something back. However, since he did not yet know what it was, he allowed her to continue.
Soon, the first pill ring was formed.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
She started with the lowest rank, forming an Azure Pill Ring.
Then, in less than a minute, the second formed, and soon the third followed.
Forming ten Azure Pill Rings was as simple as breathing for a Pill Immortal, so it did not take long before Pill Immortal Flura completed all ten Pill Rings.
Then she moved on to the next stage: the Violet Pill Rings.
"Is she seriously forming the lower rings first before the major ones? I mean, shouldn’t she have tried forming the two Crimson Pill Rings she claimed she would be forming first?"
"I asked myself the same question. This feels like a lost cause to me."
"Same here."
More and more people started wondering the same thing. From what they had come to learn about pill rings, after refining a pill, forming the most important rings first was always ideal.
Since there was no endless supply of essence to refine, going for the best was always the path every alchemist took.
So, for her to have started from the lowest rings felt a bit unreal to them.
On the platform, the invited elders shared the same mindset.

"She is deviating from her objective. At this point, she might as well stop before she fails to form even a single Crimson Pill Ring," Sect Master Tianheng exclaimed, a look of disappointment appearing on his face.
Some of the elders and clan heads shared the same opinion, except for Elder Zhen Kai from the Pill Council.

"I think you are all mistaken about one thing. While it is true that forming the major rings first is the most appropriate path, we choose it only because we usually have limited essence to work with.

"This young lady, however, has done the impossible. She extracted the essence and burned away the impurities without a single drop wasted. This means she has more than enough essence to accomplish what she set out to do.
"This means she has absolutely nothing to worry about."
"If that is the case, then she truly is someone worthy of her reputation," Clan Chief Longue added, and the others nodded.
Unbeknownst to any of them except Kent and Pill Immortal Flura, what was happening inside the cauldron was simply mind-bending.

To everyone else, Pill Immortal Flura only had six flames, but to Kent, she had nine, with three hidden inside the cauldron doing something Kent never imagined another person besides himself would be crazy enough to attempt.
Inside the cauldron, one flame was refining the pill, another was refining a Crimson Pill Ring, and the last was doing the same thing, refining the second Crimson Pill Ring.
From what many knew, until one gained the qualification to become a Pill Supreme, refining a pill rings outside the pill was impossible.
It had to be done from within the pill itself. Once the ring appeared, it could no longer be refined.

Refining them separately and later merging them with the pill was something only a madman would attempt. It was one of the few things Kevin Sage had invented back in the day, and now, Pill Immortal Flura was doing it.
’Did she gain some enlightenment, and the Pill Dao reveal some of my techniques to her?’ Kent wondered.
Though inwardly, he was more than happy to see someone think outside the box for a change.
’Proud of you, Flura. But damn, what do you have up your sleeves that I just can’t see, even with my overpowered eyes?’ His frustration was evident, but Kent remained calm.
His gaze stayed fixed on the Crimson Pill Rings taking shape. Soon, all five Violet Pill Rings were formed, and by then, the fragrance of the pill had filled the entire arena.
All around, many could sense the overwhelming power radiating from the pill. They could all tell it had been refined to perfection, which made them smile and applaud her.
However, with none of the Crimson Pill Rings visible, many were left wondering what had happened.
Kent, who had been seated, slowly stood and lifted his head toward the sky.
With his [Omniscient Jade Eyes], he was able to see the tribulation clouds gathering, and at once, he knew Pill Immortal Flura would not be able to handle what was coming alone.
Inside the tower, his wives and legion were paying close attention. Just like him, some of them had also sensed that what was coming was beyond the level of an Immortal Lord.
’Do you need help?’ Vexthra asked.
’No, at least not yet. If I need help, I will call you over.’
’Okay.’ She nodded.
Meanwhile, back on the stage, Pill Immortal Flura suddenly slapped the side of the cauldron, and a lid opened, shooting a golden pill into the air. This action caused many to widen their eyes.
Before anyone could say anything, her other hand struck the cauldron, and two red pill rings flew out, causing jaws to drop.

chapters.title: Chapter 1684: One of a Kind Pill Tribulation
paragraphs: As jaws hung low, Pill Immortal Flura formed a series of hand seals, and all nine flames under her command surrounded her. They remained in their ball-of-flame forms, each bearing a different colour and aura.
However, the moment they appeared, Pill Immortal Flura waved her hand, and the pill, alongside the two Crimson Pill Rings, flew toward her.
"What is happening?" someone asked, but no one answered because no one had an answer.
The shock of everything that was happening left them all stunned, their minds blank as they struggled to comprehend the scene before them.

The fact that Pill Immortal Flura had performed External Pill Ring Refinement on two Crimson Pill Rings while only at the Pill Immortal was more than enough to shock even Elder Zhen Kai, who was ranked among the top ten Pill Immortals in the entire Eastern Region.
He might be the best, but even he hadn’t grasped the concept of External Pill Ring Refinement. That is what someone Pill Supremes and above do.
Yet Pill Immortal Flura had, and that alone was astonishing. Added to the fact that she possessed nine Primordial Flames, everyone could only watch in stunned silence.
Pill Immortal Flura first looked up and saw that the clouds had started to change. This made her smile, completely unaware of the danger that was approaching.

Instead, she focused on the two Crimson Pill Rings and, with a series of hand seals, one of them moved and wrapped itself around the pill, which already possessed five Violet Pill Rings and ten Azure Pill Rings.

Everyone held their breath, watching closely as the first Crimson Pill Ring wrapped around the pill. A few minutes later, waves of soul-nourishing energy passed through everyone’s souls, causing many of them to clap out loud.
This was a moment they had all come to witness, and as it happened, it was unfolding right before their eyes.
They all understood that soon, another Pill God would rise from the Eastern Region. She would be noticed by the Pill God Council if she hasn’t already, and then she would be promoted.
Forming one Crimson Pill Ring with only one more left to merge was enough for Pill Immortal Flura to gain that recognition.
The moment she successfully merged the first Crimson Pill Ring with the pill, she immediately began forming more hand seals.
"This is actually happening," Sect Master Tianheng muttered, his previous expression of disappointment now replaced by shock.

"This is history in the making. Two Crimson Pill Rings, five Violet Pill Rings, and ten Azure Pill Rings on a single Tier 22 pill. It has never happened in the history of alchemy," Sect Master Yunshan stated, and the others nodded in agreement.

"I really shouldn’t have doubted her. She clearly surpasses all of us, and that is obvious now," Sect Master Baijun muttered, a pale smile appearing on his face. "And we tried to bring someone like her under our control. We would have limited her potential."
"Indeed. It looks like we’ve dodged a bullet from the Pill Dao. By failing to recruit her, this day was allowed to arrive—a day that will go down in history."
While the sect elders and clan chiefs were talking among themselves, Pill Immortal Flura was almost done forming the final hand seal.
The moment she completed it, the second Crimson Pill Ring moved, and everyone held their breath yet again.
The final moment had arrived, and even Kent was focused intently on the pill.

Inside the tower, his wives and his legion were no different. They all knew that Pill Immortal Flura meant a lot to Kent. In the past, whenever he talked about Pill Immortal Flura, they would tease him, calling her his unofficial disciple.
So now, watching as she stood on the verge of making history, they found themselves just as nervous and excited as everyone else.

Just as the ring was slowly merging with the pill, the disguised Pill Immortal whom Pill Immortal Flura had defeated in the bid for the [Soul Lotus Core] retrieved a talisman and was about to crush it when a hooded figure emerged from the shadows and pressed a dagger against his throat.
"Move a finger, and you won’t even know when you died."
The warning made him freeze, giving the Shadow Fiend enough time to act again. Before the Pill Immortal could react, his vision blurred.
The next moment, he found himself standing at the shore of a river on a remote planet, countless light-years away from where he had been only seconds ago.
"NOOOOOOOOO!"
His scream echoed through the heavens, but it was already too late. By the time he returned, his rival would have long since made history.
Kent smirked when he watched the bastard scream through the eyes of one of the shadow fiends who would make sure the bastard would face some hardship before finding his way back home.
The next second, Kent’s soul resonated violently. Then deep within his soul, an explosion occurred.
BOOM!
The bottleneck that had restrained him at Tier 30 shattered instantly, allowing him to finally step into the rank of a Demigod in Soul Cultivation.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
[You have ascended to the demigod stage in soul cultivation]
’Damn, Flura. What kind of monstrous pill have you created?’
His eyes burned with greed as he stared at the pill, resisting the urge to snatch it away and swallow it immediately.

All around the venue, countless people experienced breakthroughs of their own. Every single one of them looked at the Tier 22 Soul Tempering Pill with undisguised desire, wishing they could absorb even a fraction of its power.
At that moment, the second Crimson Pill Ring successfully merged with the pill.
"YESSSSSSS!"
Pill Immortal Flura’s excited shout echoed throughout the venue.
Around her, the nine Primordial Flames began jumping around excitedly, still maintaining their spark-like forms.
CLAP! CLAP! CLAP!
Thunderous applause erupted from every direction, and everyone rose to their feet.
Even though the pill had yet to be judged by the Pill Dao, congratulations were already pouring in from all sides. What Flura had accomplished was unprecedented, and they are all celebrating her.
Suddenly, the heavens rumbled, and a terrifying pressure descended upon everyone.
High above the clouds, three colours appeared: Azure, Violet, and Crimson.

"Three-Coloured Pill Rainbow! It is the Three-Coloured Pill Rainbow! Hahahahahaha! The heavens have acknowledged the pill rings, everyone!" Elder Zhen Kai shouted, his laughter echoing across the venue.
If someone didn’t know better, they would think he was the one who had refined the pill himself.
Yet no one found that strange.
Instead, everyone lifted their heads to observe the phenomenon happening in the clouds, knowing that the upcoming tribulation would be unlike anything they had ever witnessed.
As discussions erupted among the crowd, a ring-shaped platform suddenly emerged from within the tribulation clouds.
At the same time, the aura of a Celestial descended upon the gathering.

However, instead of suppressing them, those with deep insight felt as if they were being allowed a glimpse into the Heavenly Laws themselves—the very laws that only a handful of Demigods and Gods could perceive.
Kent, who had been prepared to intervene the moment anyone tried to disrupt Pill Immortal Flura’s pill refinement ceremony, suddenly felt a familiar sensation wash through his body.
’This feeling...’
His brows twitched slightly, then a smile slowly formed on his face.
’Master is here.’
The platform descended slowly.
Standing atop it was a man with flowing white hair and a youthful appearance. He wore a black-and-white robe, with white being the dominant colour.
Pinned perfectly to his chest was a Platinum Pill Celestial badge.
A gentle smile spread across his face as he guided the platform toward Pill Immortal Flura.
When the platform landed, he stepped off it gracefully.
He first glanced at the tribulation clouds before turning his attention toward Pill Immortal Flura.

"I never knew a day would come when I, Zathoriel Prime, would meet someone whose potential runs that deep and whose actions are that reckless, madness even. External Pill Ring refinement at the Pill Immortal stage, huh..." the Celestial said.
The statement caused countless eyes to widen, including Pill Immortal Flura’s.
"Zathoriel Prime..." she muttered. Her mind rapidly searched through old records and legends.
Then suddenly, her eyes widened.
"Are you the Pill Dao Arbiter, one of the Nine Pill Elders of the Universe Pill Council?"
"The one and only," Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime replied, maintaining his gentle smile.
RUMBLE! RUMBLE! RUMBLE!
As shock continued to spread across the faces of those present, the tribulation clouds announced their imminent descent. The heavenly tribulation would arrive in five minutes.
