chapters.title: Chapter 1685: Pill Judgement (1)
paragraphs: "We greet the Pill Dao Arbiter,"
Everyone went down on their knees to greet Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime. This included Pill Immortal Flura and Kent.
Kent did it because it was the right thing to do toward a senior who had set him on the path to a future he had grown to love.

In his past life as Kevin Sage, he did only one thing as a teenager: run cons with his father, one of the best con artists to ever live. He was good at it because he was quick to learn and had a robust mind, one that was far more advanced than most people.
Long before he reached the age of sixteen and began cultivating, he possessed brainpower that rivalled even that of True Immortals.

So he was not only a good con artist but also a brilliant child. However, when his father died, and grief overwhelmed him, it was Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime who picked him back up and set him on the right path.
He taught him everything he knew until Kevin Sage surpassed him, becoming one of the greatest alchemists and the most intelligent man to ever live.
So, putting his status as the Primordial Chaos Dragon aside, he went down on his knees and bowed to his master, Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime.

"Get up, everyone. I am happy to be here, meeting all of you together and witnessing such a monumental moment in alchemical history," he laughed, making others feel proud that they had come to witness this moment.
Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime turned and looked at Pill Immortal Flura.
"What is your name, young lady?"
"Pill Immortal Flura."

"Wonderful. You have done well, young lady. You have impressed the Pill Dao, so you will be rewarded. However, before that, you have to prove to the Pill Dao that you have what it takes to become a Pill God."
"Pill God... But I am..." Pill Immortal Flura frowned.

"No need to be confused, young lady. I pleaded on your behalf for a direct ascension, so this tribulation will both judge your pill and act as your ascension ceremony. Unfortunately for you, passing the tribulation is not something you can do alone. But fear not, I have a solution for you."
Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime smiled and continued,
"A very long time ago, a Pill God who was crazy enough to challenge the Pill Dao accidentally invoked its wrath instead.
As we all know, the Dao is neutral and does not take sides. However, what if I told you that Daos have favourites, and standing here before you, I am one of them?"

Many furrowed their brows upon hearing what Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime said. They had never expected there to be favourites of the Daos. But hearing it from someone like the Pill Dao Arbiter made them believe.
"I am a favourite because I have been recognised by the Pill Dao, and so have others whose names have been engraved upon the Pill Dao Tablet.

So when this Pill God invoked the wrath of the Pill Dao, he knew he was at death’s door if he did not act. Fortunately, this Pill God was also extremely intelligent, and so he tapped into the ancient records and invoked a rule that allowed him to call upon a secondary.
A secondary is someone who would stand beside you and face the tribulation with you. If they succeed, they will share the blessing with you.
Right now, the tribulation coming is not one you can face on your own, so you must pick a secondary. They must be an alchemist and below the rank of a God. That means Demigods and below."
"Pill Immortal Flura, pick me."
"Please pick me. I can help you."
"Pick me, please. I want to help you for free."
Many started offering their help in every shameless way possible.
They knew the rewards outweighed the danger, and so they were willing to bet their lives on it. If they were picked, it would either be their fortune or their misfortune.
Pill Immortal Flura found herself at a crossroads, unsure of what to do. Unfortunately for her, the tribulation cloud was only three minutes away.
If she had the option to pick just anyone, she would have gone for Ursa, the phoenix that Kent had given to her 370,000 plus years ago to act as her guard.
But that option had been taken from her since Ursa was not an alchemist.
This, of course, left her at a crossroads. However, just before panic could set in, a confident voice entered her ears, causing her to turn to her left.
"I will do it."
Unlike the others who remained in the stands, shouting their willingness to serve as her secondary, this man stepped toward her with a calm expression.
When his gaze met hers, Flura felt a sense of familiarity, but because of his appearance, she couldn’t quite place where she had sensed such a presence before.
However, she knew this version of Kent, having witnessed him duel a Pill Legend three weeks ago, and even gave Ursa an invitation to today’s event.
Now, this same man who had managed to pique her interest in the path of alchemy stood on the same platform as her, willing to become her secondary.
All around them, many who wished to become secondaries started hurling insults at Kent, who, in their eyes, was merely an Immortal King, while most of them were Immortal Lords and Demigods.
But Kent ignored everyone and looked at Flura.
"I can help you, if only you want me to. Though I must warn you, aside from me, nobody else here can help you."
His words silenced everyone for a moment.
Then, insult upon insult started raining down on him.
Even Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime couldn’t help but raise a brow at Kent’s clear arrogance.
For a moment, the image of a troublemaker he once called his disciple appeared in his mind, causing him to smile.
’Although he is not him, this kid sure has the nerve to say such bold words.’
He smiled faintly and looked at Pill Immortal Flura to see what she had to say.
Knowing that time was running out, Pill Immortal Flura sighed and asked one important question.
"What makes you think you can help me? You have to understand that this is my passion project, and I would willingly die rather than let just anyone interfere with it."
Kent smiled and flicked his hair back.
"The reason is simple. In the vast universe out there, there is no one under the heavens and beyond who is better than I, Kent Madson."
As he said that, his hair colour changed, and soon, his appearance reverted to that of the handsome dragon everyone had heard so much about.
Flura’s eyes widened, and in the stands, Veth’s eyes widened as well.
All around, everyone who had heard of the latest alchemist to appear on the Pill Dao Tablet sucked in a cold breath, their expressions revealing the shock in their hearts.
The idea that the Mad Alchemist who had shaken this part of the Eastern Region over the past few weeks was actually Kent Madson—the Kent Madson was just mind-blowing.
Kent smiled at Flura’s expression.
"Long time no see, Flura. Looks like you’ve made a life for yourself here."
Flura stood there for a few seconds before jumping into Kent’s arms, earning waves of shock, gasps, and confusion.
Even Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime was confused by what he was witnessing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1686: Pill Judgment (2)
paragraphs: Flura clearly wasn’t expecting Kent to appear here today.

When she woke up this morning, she had thought of him, and even before she started concocting the pill, he had crossed her mind once more. But never, not even for a moment, had she expected him to appear here.
Yet here he was, like a ghost stepping out of the past. And the best part was that he could actually help her. She knew that base on past interaction.
At this moment, Flura could very well be considered the happiest woman in the universe.
She and Kent had met as rivals, but that rivalry had quickly evolved into mutual respect, born from their shared love and obsession with alchemy.
So, unlike some of the women Kent had met in the Pill Worlds who had fallen deeply in love with him, Flura had not—at least not to the extent one would expect.
She liked Kent, and she would love to be with him one day.
However, her obsession with alchemy, coupled with her aspiration to someday surpass Kent, had driven her to spend the last 370,000 years learning and continuing to learn, all for this single moment.
"EHEMM."
Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime cleared his throat and said, "The tribulation is less than one minute away, so the hugging can wait for now."

A smile appeared on his face. He was happy that he would get to witness a Pill God arise through natural ascension, and he was equally pleased to finally meet the Kent Madson he had tried several times to find but had always failed to locate.
Pill Immortal Flura quickly let go of Kent and blushed.
Kent smiled and used a finger to brush aside a few strands of hair covering the side of her face.
"Let’s handle this first. Then we can have a proper reunion."
Flura nodded.
Kent smiled before turning toward Veth, who was looking at him with sparkling eyes. She seemed incredibly happy, and that was all Kent wanted to see.
He nodded at Bryna, the dragon he had left behind to protect her, and then at Ursa, Flura’s bodyguard and friend.
Afterward, Kent turned toward Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime and smiled.

"Thank you, Senior, for pleading on Pill Immortal Flura’s behalf. I know you can’t stay for long, so please accept my gratitude. And when we meet again, I hope we will have more time to talk and discuss matters related to alchemy."
Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime smiled and nodded.

"I would like that, Pill Legend Kent Madson. That said, you will have to defend against three lightning bolts, each containing purification runes that will be absorbed by the pill after you successfully defend against them.
Failure to withstand all three strikes will result in your death and the destruction of the pill. So do your best to survive, kid."
Kent nodded.
"Good luck. I hope you reach the peak one day."
After saying that, Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime teleported back onto his circular platform, and the next moment, he vanished from sight.
As a Celestial, his mere presence in the Immortal Realm was dangerous. If this had been a God World or one of the unique realms, he could have remained for as long as he wished.
RUMBLE!
The tribulation cloud churned violently as waves of terrifying pressure descended upon Kent and Flura.
Kent casually waved his hand and chaos energy surged outward and surrounded Flura, forming a protective shield around her.
Instantly, the crushing pressure bearing down on her vanished as though it had never existed.
"Wait here. I will handle the rest."
"Okay," Flura nodded.
Kent ascended into the air. When he was high enough, he sat down in a lotus position and formed a few hand seals.
Suddenly, the clothing covering his upper body vanished, revealing his well-defined physique.
The sight caused many women in the crowd to blush. However, Kent paid no attention to them, not when he intended to kill two birds with one stone.
His Lightning Element had been on the verge of a breakthrough for quite some time now. Initially, he had expected it to awaken after ascending to the Immortal Realm.
But it hadn’t.
For the past few weeks, he had been searching for a solution, trying to find a way to trigger the awakening.
He never found one.
At least, not until today.
By undergoing the baptism of the Pill Tribulation, he would finally awaken his dormant element, giving him yet another powerful force to rely upon.
RUMBLE!
Kent looked up and smiled.
"Bring it on, old friend," he muttered and the tribulation responded.
High above, the clouds split apart, and a bolt of azure-colored lightning descended toward him.
A smile appeared on Kent’s face.
Then he opened his arms wide, welcoming the deadly bolt.
"What is he doing?" Elder Zhen Kai asked, his expression turning pale as he watched the azure lightning descend upon Kent.
"This kid is insane."
Everyone held their breath, their eyes fixed on the scene as the lightning crashed into Kent’s body with a thunderous explosion.
"Kent!"
Flura called out, her fists clenched as Kent’s entire body disappeared within the chaotic sea of azure lightning.
A powerful shockwave erupted from the impact.
But as the air cleared, Kent remained seated in the same lotus position, the same smile still present on his face.
This time, however, green-red runes could be seen spreading across his skin.
The sight shocked many.
But the most shocking thing happened moments later.
The Soul Tempering Pill hovered in the air, absorbing the purification runes carried by the lightning.
Then, before everyone’s eyes, two of the Azure Pill Rings transformed into Violet Pill Rings.
The pill now possessed two Crimson Pill Rings, seven Violet Pill Rings, and eight Azure Pill Rings.
This means potency had increased once again.
That alone was enough to make many people clench their fists and swear to themselves that they would one day create a miracle of their own.
Pill Ring mutation, or Pill Ring Evolution, as it was more commonly known, was not unheard of.
However, it was incredibly rare for two rings to evolve simultaneously.
That alone demonstrated the extraordinary level of mastery that had gone into refining the Soul Tempering pill.
RUMBLE!
The tribulation cloud churned once more.
This time, violet lightning filled the sky, the tribulation churning like mad lion.
Meanwhile, Kent quickly read the notification before him and smiled.
[You have absorbed a large amount of Lightning Essence.]
[Your Chaos Lightning is awakening.]
[Time until completion: 120 seconds.]
’One hundred seconds more to go.’
He smiled and looked up.
The violet lightning would descend at any moment now, and so he prepared himself accordingly.
As expected, a few seconds later, another bolt descended from the heavens.
This time, his body was completely swallowed by a sea of violet lightning, causing gasps to spread throughout the arena.
Yet once again, Kent emerged victorious.
And this time, three Azure Pill Rings evolved into Violet Pill Rings.
But something else caught everyone’s attention.
One of the Violet Pill Rings had begun turning crimson.
Kent noticed it as well.
’No way...’
His eyes sparkled as he watched the pill slowly devour the remaining purification runes.
By the time the final rune was absorbed, the Violet Pill Ring had already transformed halfway into a Crimson Pill Ring.
This made him genuinely happy.
As someone who had accomplished the impossible countless times, Kent knew that the higher the Pill Rings, the stronger the pill became.
So he was eager to witness the birth of a third Crimson Pill Ring.
That would undoubtedly make him happy for Flura.
RUMBLE!
The tribulation cloud churned one final time.
The third and final bolt was coming.
Crimson lightning illuminated the heavens.
Kent glanced at the countdown and saw that his Lightning Element would awaken before the crimson bolt descended.
Before that, however, he silently thanked the heavens that Flura wasn’t the one facing this tribulation.
If it had been her, she would have already been on her last legs.
He sighed inwardly, then a pale smile formed on his handsome face.
Five seconds later, dark-red lightning began dancing around his body.
Thousands upon thousands of crimson lightning runes covered his skin like dragon scales.
Before his eyes, a message appeared.
[You have awakened your Chaos Lightning.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1687: Pill God Ascension
paragraphs: Kent felt waves of overwhelming strength surge through his body the moment his Chaos Lightning awakened.
At the same time, the crimson lightning descended.
"Let me test your power."
He raised his hand and opened his palm, causing dark red lightning to surge around his arm. He controlled it, forming a terrifying claw.
The bolt of crimson lightning shot straight at him and landed on his open palm.
BOOOOOOM!

A powerful explosion rocked the space, shaking the ground and distorting the air around Kent. Many who had already sensed the danger of the violet lightning and distanced themselves moved even farther back when the powerful shockwave swept over them.
They felt their blood boil, and a wave of panic slammed into their bodies.
However, the one at the receiving end of such devastating lightning merely felt a minor zap that vanished the next second.
But as if that wasn’t shocking enough, the message that appeared before his eyes made him grin.
[You have devoured a large amount of lightning essence. You have formed 5 Lightning Runes.]

’Lightning Runes? What are those?’ Kent muttered inwardly, but he was forced to turn away from the system interface and look at the pill that had begun releasing waves of a sour yet nourishing sensation.
On its surface, he saw that the violet pill ring had turned completely crimson, while the five remaining Azure pill rings had all become violet.
The moment this mutation ended, the pill flew into the air. Once it reached a sufficient height, it released a sharp cry, and a golden glow surrounded it.
Beneath it, a golden lotus appeared, and a golden dome appeared around it.
Once that was done, Pill Immortal Flura was also lifted off the ground.
Before she could resist the force pulling her, her vision darkened. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself standing before a massive green tablet carved from ancient jade.
Seventeen names were engraved upon the stone.
She quickly scanned the names and recognized every one of them.
Although she had only met two of them in person, years of extensive research allowed her to know the kind of people this name represent.

She knew with absolute certainty that all seventeen names belonged to beings who had, at some point in history, accomplished something so extraordinary that they earned the recognition of the Pill Dao.
At the very bottom was Kent’s name, engraved neatly into the stone.
A smile formed on her face when she saw her own name beginning to appear in the eighteenth position. A few seconds later, the engraving was complete.
At that moment, she became the eighteenth alchemist in history to be recognized by the Pill Dao.

All across the universe, bells rang within every Pill Council headquarters, announcing that a legend had emerged on the path of alchemy, someone who would forever carry the pride and glory of alchemy upon her shoulders.
"Congratulations, young Alchemist. You are the eighteenth person to have accomplished the impossible. For that, I have recognized you and will reward you," a voice came from the Pill Dao Tablet.
Flura smiled and nodded. "I will be glad to receive whatever the Pill Dao has for me."
"Good," the tablet said.
A beam shot from it and landed on the badge on Flura’s chest.
Visibly, her Pill Immortal Badge transformed into that of a Pill God. But after the badge transformed, it glowed for a few seconds. When the glow finally faded, the badge had turned golden.
This showed that she had been promoted to a Golden Badge Pill God, just one level below Platinum Badge.
"For your second gift, I will bestow upon you a technique called [Pill Life]. It is a technique that allows you to give life to your pills, enabling them to grow indefinitely."
Another beam emerged from the tablet and merged with Pill God Flura’s forehead. Waves of information regarding the technique poured into her mind.
At once, she understood the technique completely, almost as if she had been studying it for millions of years.
’This is...’
Her eyes widened as she examined the contents of the technique.
From what she knew, pills became sentient from Tier 18 onward. This meant they gained intelligence, and with enough pill rings, they could even transform.

However, aside from that, they were still fundamentally pills. They could not grow stronger or rank up on their own. Yet, with the technique she had just received, she could make a Tier 22 pill grow into a Tier 23 pill and beyond.
’This is basically creating living beings at this point.’
She smiled, and perhaps noticing the joy on her face, the Pill Dao Tablet decided to pour some cold water on her excitement.
"You must know that not every pill can be made alive. That said, the pills that can be transformed into Living Pills will be revealed to you when they pass their tribulations."
Pill God Flura did not let the condition sour her mood. This was a victory in her eyes, so she accepted it with grace.
"Now for your third gift."
A beam emerged from the tablet yet again and merged with Flura’s forehead.
"It is another technique, but this one is a Pill Ring Refinement Technique. Master it, and one day you will be able to refine high-level pill rings."
"Thank you, Senior Pill Dao."
"You are welcome. Now go back and make me, and the world of Alchemy, proud."
A beam descended from the heavens and enveloped Flura’s body.
Everyone rose to their feet, and clapping and cheering filled the space as they celebrated the successful ascension of one of their own.
Throughout the history of Alchemy, only a handful of people had ascended the natural way. One of them was the Mad Alchemist, who had turned out to be Kent Madson all along.
Now, she too had become a Pill God through natural ascension.
Compared to other Pill Gods, she could be considered a true Pill God. After all, she had ascended through the natural path, meaning the Pill Dao itself had acknowledged and approved of her.
The light dissipated, revealing her figure once more.
When everyone’s eyes landed on her golden badge, they gasped.
"She just ascended, and she’s already a Golden Badge wielder. What a monster."

Many people began muttering among themselves, some even wondering what the implications of this development would be once the Pill God Council learned that an Immortal had become a Pill God and had been promoted to Golden Badge status on the very same day by the Pill Dao.
Pill God Flura had no intention of paying them any attention.
Instead, she flew into the air and appeared beside Kent, whose focus remained on the pill currently cocooned within the golden dome.
"Congratulations on becoming a Pill God, Flura," Kent said, flashing a charming smile.
Flura nodded and approached the pill. When she stood directly before it, she extended her hand and touched the dome.
A few seconds later, she withdrew her hand and smiled.
She turned to Kent and spoke.
"I will trouble you to protect me for a few minutes. There is something important I must first handle."
"Don’t worry about anything. I won’t allow anything to happen to you."
Flura nodded, sat down in a lotus position, and began forming hand seals.
Kent walked back and sat down as well, preparing to review the messages he had received.
However, he had barely finished pulling up the notifications when dark clouds began to gather overhead.
A few minutes later, fifteen Demigods emerged from within them, forcing everyone present to their knees.
’And here they come.’
Kent grinned as a wicked light appeared in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1688: Lackeys of Pill God Brandon
paragraphs: Kent stood up and looked at the fifteen demigods, who wore smug smiles as they gazed down on everyone. With the kind of aura they possessed, the pressure bearing down on everyone was simply too overwhelming.
The only one still on his feet was Kent.
He used his [Omniscient Jade Eyes] to scan the person leading them.
[Name: Axten Zul]𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
[Title: Blood River God]
[Rank: Demigod (God Emperor)]
[Job Class: Swordsman]
[Observation: Axten Zul is one of the enforcers in Pill God Brandon’s faction. He carries out his dirty work.]
’So they are gods suppressed to the demigod stage, huh?’ Kent grinned, then narrowed his eyes and said,
"This place is not somewhere you losers can come and do as you please. Can’t you see we are in the middle of something more important than your little dick lives?"
His words struck like needles, instantly changing the arrogant expressions on the faces of the fifteen people in the air. Before they could fire back at him, Kent walked forward and added,
"I know you losers were sent here by that dog calling himself Pill God Brandon. Now, I don’t know what you losers were thinking before coming here today, but allow me to open your eyes.

If any of you dare lay a single finger on Pill God Flura, I will make sure today is the last time you breathe the air of the living. So make your decision, and let’s get this over with. I have more important things to do than waste my time on people like you."
"Brat, who do you think you are?" Axten shouted, his sword manifesting firmly in his grip.

"I am your father, punk. Better watch your tone before I drive a spear up your ass and skewer your intestines," Kent responded with an added mocking laugh, causing visible smoke to practically rise from Axten’s head.
His face turned grim, and his body trembled with sheer anger.
"KILL HIM!"
His words came out hoarse, and the effect was immediate. Fourteen demigods lunged at Kent, surrounding him from all directions at once. They drew their weapons and charged up their attacks.
Seeing this, Kent smiled and shook his head. "What a pity. Death is inevitable at this point. Then again, they asked for death, so I will grant them just that."
"DIE, YOU BASTARD!" the fourteen demigods roared, their killing intent locking onto Kent.

However, just before any of them could breach the one-meter mark, shadowy figures clad in cloaks and wearing hoods appeared like ghosts behind all fourteen of them and plunged poison daggers into their necks.
There wasn’t even a struggle. The moment the daggers went in, all fourteen fell from the sky and slammed into the ground, causing everyone below to gasp in shock.
The shadowy fiends vanished as quickly as they had appeared, and Kent grinned at Axten, who was the only one left alive.
"Now, to the main reason why you losers are here."

Kent moved and appeared before Axten, who had turned pale, his body trembling like a frightened child. Before he could react to Kent’s sudden movement, a deadly fist slammed into his stomach, sending him flying backwards.
Kent tapped into the Soul Map and instantly appeared behind him, landing another punch squarely on his back and sending him hurtling in the opposite direction.
He repeated the same thing three more times, each strike heavier than the last, before finally catching Axten by the head.
"Before I send you running back to your master, allow me to vent some of the anger I’ve had piled up."
His knee moved.
BANG!
It landed directly on Axten’s nose.
Blood gushed out immediately, but Kent didn’t stop. He coated his knee in ice and delivered three more brutal strikes, completely shattering Axten’s nose.
After that, he held the man’s head firmly in place and unleashed slap after slap across his face, cheeks, ears, temples, and every other part of his head he could reach.
PA! PA! PA! PA! PA!
The sound echoed throughout the area.
By the time Kent was finished, Axten had been reduced to a pitiful state, causing many people to sympathise with him despite the fact that he was clearly in the wrong.
He had come here believing that, because he was a god, he could do whatever he pleased.
Reality had proven rather disappointing.
Once Kent had finally had enough, he extended his hand, and a fruit appeared.

Tell him I said he is impotent and that his dick is as small as a pickle.
Tell him he should stop calling himself a god and focus on calling himself a loser instead. Tell him I said he is a disappointment to both his mother and father.
And tell him that if he dares to look at Pill God Flura funny even one more time, I will personally come to the God Realm and beat him black and blue.
Finally, tell him, and this is very important. Tell him that I, Kent Madson, think he is..."
Kent stopped and smiled.
Then he flicked his hand.
The poor bastard was instantly sent flying 200,000 km away.

CRACK!

"WOOOW!"
Everyone gasped in shock when they saw the beautiful little girl.

chapters.title: Chapter 1689: Lili Thara
paragraphs: "Huh? Where is the pill?" someone suddenly blurted out.
Just now, the pill was surrounded by a dome of energy, perched on a lotus flower. However, in its place is now a little girl, so his question had some merit.
However, the next second, a smack landed on the back of his head.
"Idiot! Can’t you see the pill had transformed into a human child?" another alchemist seated beside him said, his index finger pointed at the young lady suspended mid-air.
But just as he managed to draw everyone’s attention to the little girl, his own thoughts finally registered the reason why the person had asked where the pill was in the first place.
"A human child?"
The man’s eyes widened, disbelief appearing on his face. His finger trembled, threatening to fall from his hand as he pointed at the little girl.
Soon, gasps spread throughout the crowd as more people realised what had happened and its implications.
"Wait... pills can turn into humans too?" someone said, his shock evident on his face.
"I thought they could only transform into beasts, weapons, flowers, or other spiritual forms."
"Since when could a pill become a person?"
"This doesn’t make any sense."
Their voices rose in turn as shock swept through the gathering.
Even the Sect Masters, Clan Chiefs, and Elder Zhen Kai were all staring at the little girl with disbelief written all over their faces.
Even with their vast experience and knowledge of the path of alchemy, they had never encountered a pill that had transformed into a living human before.

But even if they had, they knew pills were just pills. They held no life force within them aside from the natural essence they were meant to possess. So a pill could take on a humanoid form, but it would still be nothing more than a pill.
However, what they were witnessing wasn’t merely the birth of a pill spirit.
No.
This was something far rarer, something more profound and unheard of.
The little girl slowly opened her eyes.
The moment she did, an ancient and noble aura descended from the heavens and enveloped everyone.
At the same time, countless medicinal laws manifested around her, forming rivers of glowing runes that revolved around her tiny body.
This sight sent yet another wave of shock through everyone witnessing this monumental climax fo what could be considered one of the best and unforgettable Pill conferences in history.
The little girl blinked a few times, looked around in confusion, and then her gaze landed on Pill God Flura.
Almost instantly, her eyes brightened.
"Mama!"
Her sweet voice echoed across the silent arena, and at once, everyone forgot how to speak.
In most cases, when the pills transformed, they tried to run away. However, this one remained and even chose to call Pill God Flura her mother.
Even Pill God Flura was shocked by the way the little girl addressed her.

But before she could become overwhelmed by emotion, the little girl flew toward her with her arms wide open. Instinctively, Flura opened her arms as well, and the little girl hugged her, pressing her tiny face against her chest.
Kent furrowed his brow...

’So the Pill Dao had given her the technique, too, huh? I should have seen that coming,’ he thought with a faint smile, annoyed that the Pill Dao hadn’t asked his permission before sharing the [Life Pill] technique with others.
It was his creation after all, but it seemed the Pill Dao was sharing it like candy. However, he was happy for Flura, since he knew she would use it for good.
After hugging for a few moments, the little girl pulled back and looked Pill God Flura in the eye, as if committing her features to memory.
When she had had enough, she turned to Kent, who stood relaxed a few meters away from Pill God Flura.
Noticing her gaze, Kent smiled. "I suppose you are now sentient and alive. Since that is the case, what is your name, little girl? My own is Kent Madson."
The girl blinked a few times, then replied in a clear, sweet tone, "Lili Thara’s name is Lili Thara."
Kent smiled; a part of him already expected her to speak in the third person long before he asked the question. But hearing her refer to herself that way still made him smile.
Gaia and the others mostly refer to themselves in the third person, too.
"Lili Thara. Nice name," Kent said, and Lili Thara smiled.
"Kent, do you know how she came about?" Pill God Flura asked out of curiosity. While she was the one who used the technique on the pill, this outcome still shocked her.
Hearing her question, Kent smiled and nodded. "I do. She is a living pill, or as most call her, a pill spirit."
Pill God Flura smiled weakly and shook her head. "Of course, you knew. Why did I even bother asking?"
It was Kent she was talking to after all. From their past interactions, she knew there was absolutely no way he wouldn’t know Lili Thara was a living pill.
"I have surpassed you, Kent," Pill God Flura said, and Kent nodded.
However, just before he could reply, something—or more accurately, someone—landed gently on his head and grabbed hold of his dragon horns.
Pill God Flura used her hands to cover her mouth, holding back her laughter.
"Lili Thara, is that you?" Kent asked, already aware of the answer.
"Yes," the little girl replied.
"Dare I ask, but why are you standing on my head?"

Indeed, the little girl stood happily on his head, her tiny hands gripping his horns as though they were a steering wheel. The sight was amusing, and many people, despite the shock they were in, couldn’t help but smile.
"Lili Thara wants to stand on Big Brother Kent’s head a little because Lili Thara likes the colour of Big Brother Kent Madson’s hair and horns."
"I see. But shouldn’t you have asked me first before doing so?"

Lili Thara blinked a few times, realising that she should indeed have asked permission before stepping onto Kent’s head. However, it was already done, and so she resorted to a more peaceful way of remaining there.
She let go of one of Kent’s horns and extended her tiny hand.
Before everyone, a pill bearing ten violet pill rings and two crimson pill rings appeared on her palm, and she handed it to Kent.
"This is..." Kent muttered.
He then scanned the pill with his Omniscient Jade Eyes. When the results were displayed, his eyes widened.
[Tier 21 Soul Tempering Pill. Pill Rings: 10 Violet and 2 Crimson. Purity: 100% (x138)]
Kent was blown away by what he was staring at.
Pill God Flura, who didn’t know what had happened, soon discovered the nature of the pill and widened her eyes as well. The people gathered in the air quickly followed.
"What in the world of alchemy am I witnessing today?" Sect Master Yunshan muttered.

"First, it was natural ascension to the rank of a Pill God, then a pill turning into a humanoid, and now a pill manifesting pills not much weaker than the original. Does this mean she can indefinitely manifest Tier 21 Soul Tempering Pills?"
The question caused many to wonder the same thing.
Kent himself wanted to know, so he asked, "Lili Thara, how many of these can you create?" He showed her the pill she had given him.

"Lili Thara can make more, but Lili Thara first has to gather medicinal herbs and eat to become stronger so Lili Thara can create more powerful ones. Lili Thara can create many, many pills if Big Brother Kent wants."𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎

chapters.title: Chapter 1690: Invitation to the Pill Immortal Council
paragraphs: A Pill having the ability to manifest another Pill, even if it was a tier lower than itself, was simply too mind-bending. Kent, with his vast knowledge, had never witnessed such an occurrence before.

While he was the one who invented the [Pill Life] technique, he had never created a pill with such a unique ability. At most, a living pill could release some of its effects without being consumed first.
Some even chose to live inside the soul of their owner, nourishing them at the very foundation of their true nature.

In such a case, someone like Lili Thara would become a Pill spirit, continuously tempering the owner’s soul. That was essentially the nature of living pills, and even some non-living pills possessed similar characteristics.
But having the ability to manifest more pills from itself was something entirely different.
Kent knew Lili Thara was overpowered, and so did everyone else.

Naturally, as one would expect, countless offers immediately began flying through the air as people desperately tried to secure the Soul Tempering Pills that Lili Thara was capable of creating with a mere flick of her hand.
The amounts of spirit stones, precious herbs, rare treasures, and other alchemical ingredients being offered were simply absurd.

Some even went so far as to offer entire sects’ yearly revenues, ancestral herb gardens, and collections accumulated over thousands of years, all for the chance to obtain a single Soul Tempering Pill.
The atmosphere instantly turned chaotic.
"900 billion high-grade spirit stones!"
"I’ll offer 999 billion!"
"My Celestial Herb Pavilion is willing to exchange three Heaven-tier soul-nourishing herbs for a Tier 21 or even Tier 20 Soul Tempering Pill."
"I have a Seven-Colored Soul Blossom that has matured for ninety-nine thousand years!"
"Forget spirit stones! I’ll exchange a complete inheritance left behind by an Immortal Monarch who specialised in the art of soul mapping."

The offers became more outrageous with every passing second, and someone like Kent, whose greed for treasures knew no bounds, started smiling at everyone while Lili Thara played with his horns, now settled peacefully on his head.
Many of those present knew that spirit stones could always be earned again, treasures could be found again, and inheritances could be sought elsewhere.
But opportunities to strengthen one’s soul were exceedingly rare.
A powerful soul affected nearly every aspect of cultivation.
Whether it was comprehending laws, refining pills, controlling formations, forging weapons, or surviving soul attacks, the benefits were immeasurable.
That was why the crowd was losing its mind.
In the world of Alchemy, some of the rarest and most sought-after pills are always soul-based pills.

Regardless of how one viewed it, when it came to the soul, pills capable of strengthening it were sought after even by Celestials. So Kent could understand their eagerness to get their hands on just one of those pills.
Even the Sect Masters, Clan Chiefs, and some of the powerful alchemists present at today’s event were eager to get their hands on the pill.

Their eyes burned with desire as they stared at the adorable red-haired girl seated on Kent’s head and playing with his horns. Well, she had been playing happily before the noise started filling the space.
Lili Thara blinked her large eyes in confusion as she gazed at everyone, who looked at her with strange expressions.
She tilted her head slightly as she looked at the countless cultivators shouting offers toward her.
Then, in a sweet and innocent voice, she asked,
"Why are they so noisy?"
Kent smiled and answered, "They want to give you precious herbs in exchange for some of your pills. Do you want to do it?"
Lili Thara turned and looked at Pill God Flura, who smiled at her. Seeing her Mama give her an encouraging expression, she nodded.
"Lili Thara likes precious herbs, so Lili Thara will give them some pills in exchange for precious herbs."
Hearing the little girl’s words, everyone became overjoyed.
Kent used the opportunity to demand even more than if Pill God Flura had been in charge.
"You all heard that Lili Thara is willing to share her pills with everyone. However, to ensure she isn’t extorted, only herbs ranked Tier 21 and above will be accepted.

"And know this: the higher the Tier of the herb, the earlier you will receive your pill. So, people, it would be wise to go all out, because let me tell you, a soul-related pill is not an opportunity you can afford to miss.
"That said, we will use the services of Lady Veth to ensure fairness and the safe delivery of goods between both parties."

If Kent were an ordinary person, many would have rained insults on him. But they had all witnessed him beat a Demigod as though she were a sack of potatoes, so they said nothing despite his outrageous demands.
Basically, he was trying to say that if someone brought a Tier 21 herb and another person brought two Tier 21 herbs or a Tier 22 herb, the latter would receive their pill first.

While time was not something immortals paid much attention to, the fact that news had already begun spreading to other parts of the Eastern Region and beyond, even reaching the God Realm, meant that countless offers would arrive soon.
So offering just one herb would place them on a very long waiting list.
In short, Pill God Flura was about to be swimming in pill ingredients, and that was all because Kent’s big brain had foreseen this outcome long before it happened.
While many rushed away to their home planets to secure herbs they could exchange for a pill, Elder Zhen Kai stood up and walked toward Kent and Pill God Flura.
"Congratulations on the success of your Pill event, Pill God Flura," Elder Zhen Kai said, bowing politely. Pill God Flura was now a Pill God, so naturally, her status ranked above his.
"There is no need for such politeness, Elder Zhen Kai. We are both alchemists, so we shouldn’t let our ranks define us."
Her words made Elder Zhen Kai smile and nod.
He didn’t mind calling Pill God Flura a senior. However, he could tell that Flura genuinely didn’t care how she was addressed, so he nodded in agreement.
"Very well. I am glad your heart remains as calm as it was before your ascension.
That said, before your ascension, I intended to invite you to participate in the upcoming Intergalactic Alchemy Competition that will be held by the Eastern Pill Immortal Council this time around.

"However, now that you are a Pill God, I wish to invite you to become one of the judges, the presiding judge, to be precise. I am certain the other regions would not mind having a Pill God preside over such a monumental event."
"When is the competition?" Pill God Flura asked.
"One year from today. So that would be three months before the Trial of Wisdom," Elder Zhen Kai answered.
"I see. I will be there, Elder Zhen Kai."
"Wonderful."
His face beamed with joy, but he quickly composed himself and turned to Kent.
"How about you, Pill Legend Kent? Will you also be attending?"
"Of course. After all, I plan on participating, so expect to see me there, old man."
Elder Zhen Kai blinked a few times, not because he had been called an old man, but because he had never expected Kent to say that he would be joining the Intergalactic Alchemy Competition.
Seeing his expression, Kent smiled and said,
"Relax, Elder Zhen Kai. I know it is a competition for Pill Immortals. However, I may not be a Pill Immortal, but I can create Tier 20 pills and above."
He grinned and flicked his hair back. Lili Thara mirrored his actions, flicking her hair back in exactly the same manner.
"My name isn’t on the Pill Dao Tablet for no reason, Elder Zhen Kai."

sentences.text: A Pill having the ability to manifest another Pill, even if it was a tier lower than itself, was simply too mind-bending.
Kent, with his vast knowledge, had never witnessed such an occurrence before.
While he was the one who invented the [Pill Life] technique, he had never created a pill with such a unique ability.
At most, a living pill could release some of its effects without being consumed first.
Some even chose to live inside the soul of their owner, nourishing them at the very foundation of their true nature.
In such a case, someone like Lili Thara would become a Pill spirit, continuously tempering the owner’s soul.
That was essentially the nature of living pills, and even some non-living pills possessed similar characteristics.
But having the ability to manifest more pills from itself was something entirely different.
Kent knew Lili Thara was overpowered, and so did everyone else.

Naturally, as one would expect, countless offers immediately began flying through the air as people desperately tried to secure the Soul Tempering Pills that Lili Thara was capable of creating with a mere flick of her hand.
The amounts of spirit stones, precious herbs, rare treasures, and other alchemical ingredients being offered were simply absurd.

Some even went so far as to offer entire sects’ yearly revenues, ancestral herb gardens, and collections accumulated over thousands of years, all for the chance to obtain a single Soul Tempering Pill.
The atmosphere instantly turned chaotic.
"900 billion high-grade spirit stones!"
"I’ll offer 999 billion!"
"My Celestial Herb Pavilion is willing to exchange three Heaven-tier soul-nourishing herbs for a Tier 21 or even Tier 20 Soul Tempering Pill."
"I have a Seven-Colored Soul Blossom that has matured for ninety-nine thousand years!"
"Forget spirit stones!
I’ll exchange a complete inheritance left behind by an Immortal Monarch who specialised in the art of soul mapping."

The offers became more outrageous with every passing second, and someone like Kent, whose greed for treasures knew no bounds, started smiling at everyone while Lili Thara played with his horns, now settled peacefully on his head.
Many of those present knew that spirit stones could always be earned again, treasures could be found again, and inheritances could be sought elsewhere.
But opportunities to strengthen one’s soul were exceedingly rare.
A powerful soul affected nearly every aspect of cultivation.
Whether it was comprehending laws, refining pills, controlling formations, forging weapons, or surviving soul attacks, the benefits were immeasurable.
That was why the crowd was losing its mind.
In the world of Alchemy, some of the rarest and most sought-after pills are always soul-based pills.
Regardless of how one viewed it, when it came to the soul, pills capable of strengthening it were sought after even by Celestials.
So Kent could understand their eagerness to get their hands on just one of those pills.
Even the Sect Masters, Clan Chiefs, and some of the powerful alchemists present at today’s event were eager to get their hands on the pill.
Their eyes burned with desire as they stared at the adorable red-haired girl seated on Kent’s head and playing with his horns.
Well, she had been playing happily before the noise started filling the space.
Lili Thara blinked her large eyes in confusion as she gazed at everyone, who looked at her with strange expressions.
She tilted her head slightly as she looked at the countless cultivators shouting offers toward her.
Then, in a sweet and innocent voice, she asked,
"Why are they so noisy?"
Kent smiled and answered, "They want to give you precious herbs in exchange for some of your pills.
Do you want to do it?"
Lili Thara turned and looked at Pill God Flura, who smiled at her.
Seeing her Mama give her an encouraging expression, she nodded.
"Lili Thara likes precious herbs, so Lili Thara will give them some pills in exchange for precious herbs."
Hearing the little girl’s words, everyone became overjoyed.
Kent used the opportunity to demand even more than if Pill God Flura had been in charge.
"You all heard that Lili Thara is willing to share her pills with everyone.
However, to ensure she isn’t extorted, only herbs ranked Tier 21 and above will be accepted.
"And know this: the higher the Tier of the herb, the earlier you will receive your pill.
So, people, it would be wise to go all out, because let me tell you, a soul-related pill is not an opportunity you can afford to miss.
"That said, we will use the services of Lady Veth to ensure fairness and the safe delivery of goods between both parties."
If Kent were an ordinary person, many would have rained insults on him.
But they had all witnessed him beat a Demigod as though she were a sack of potatoes, so they said nothing despite his outrageous demands.
Basically, he was trying to say that if someone brought a Tier 21 herb and another person brought two Tier 21 herbs or a Tier 22 herb, the latter would receive their pill first.

While time was not something immortals paid much attention to, the fact that news had already begun spreading to other parts of the Eastern Region and beyond, even reaching the God Realm, meant that countless offers would arrive soon.
So offering just one herb would place them on a very long waiting list.
In short, Pill God Flura was about to be swimming in pill ingredients, and that was all because Kent’s big brain had foreseen this outcome long before it happened.
While many rushed away to their home planets to secure herbs they could exchange for a pill, Elder Zhen Kai stood up and walked toward Kent and Pill God Flura.
"Congratulations on the success of your Pill event, Pill God Flura," Elder Zhen Kai said, bowing politely.
Pill God Flura was now a Pill God, so naturally, her status ranked above his.
"There is no need for such politeness, Elder Zhen Kai.
We are both alchemists, so we shouldn’t let our ranks define us."
Her words made Elder Zhen Kai smile and nod.
He didn’t mind calling Pill God Flura a senior.
However, he could tell that Flura genuinely didn’t care how she was addressed, so he nodded in agreement.
"Very well.
I am glad your heart remains as calm as it was before your ascension.
That said, before your ascension, I intended to invite you to participate in the upcoming Intergalactic Alchemy Competition that will be held by the Eastern Pill Immortal Council this time around.
"However, now that you are a Pill God, I wish to invite you to become one of the judges, the presiding judge, to be precise.
I am certain the other regions would not mind having a Pill God preside over such a monumental event."
"When is the competition?" Pill God Flura asked.
"One year from today.
So that would be three months before the Trial of Wisdom," Elder Zhen Kai answered.
"I see.
I will be there, Elder Zhen Kai."
"Wonderful."
His face beamed with joy, but he quickly composed himself and turned to Kent.
"How about you, Pill Legend Kent?
Will you also be attending?"
"Of course.
After all, I plan on participating, so expect to see me there, old man."
Elder Zhen Kai blinked a few times, not because he had been called an old man, but because he had never expected Kent to say that he would be joining the Intergalactic Alchemy Competition.
Seeing his expression, Kent smiled and said,
"Relax, Elder Zhen Kai.
I know it is a competition for Pill Immortals.
However, I may not be a Pill Immortal, but I can create Tier 20 pills and above."
He grinned and flicked his hair back.
Lili Thara mirrored his actions, flicking her hair back in exactly the same manner.
"My name isn’t on the Pill Dao Tablet for no reason, Elder Zhen Kai."

chapters.title: Chapter 1691: Proper Reunion
paragraphs: Unlike swordsmanship, where a swordsman’s rank is determined by both their mastery and their sword realm or domain, in alchemy, it is all about soul power, technique, and flames.
If an alchemist possesses all three, then they can easily rise through the ranks.
Initially, Kent had limitations in some areas, keeping him at levels he couldn’t rise above.
However, after ascending to the Immortal Realm, his soul had undergone countless changes, and with the memories of Kevin Sage returning to him, he can now be compared to a Pill God.
Of course, it would take some practice and polishing before he could concoct Immortal-grade pills and above.
However, with time on his side and a requirement to meet, he knew that nothing would stop him from participating in the Intergalactic Alchemy Competition.
He may be a Pill Legend, but when it comes to true mastery, even Pill Immortals would find themselves competing against him.

Elder Zhen Kai still seemed hesitant, not because of what he thought, but because letting a Pill Legend represent the Eastern Pill Immortal Council sounded like an insult to the other Pill Immortals who had already been selected.
Kent could read his thoughts from his expression, so he found a way to help him relax a little.
"You clearly came here to invite Pill God Flura to participate in the Intergalactic Alchemy Competition, right? So, how about this? Since she is now overqualified, why don’t you give her spot to me?

Of course, if anyone has a problem with that, they can come challenge me any day, at any time. While I hate stealing the spotlight from my friends, I wouldn’t mind concocting a pill that hasn’t been seen for billions of years."
He let out a chuckle while Elder Zhen Kai and Pill God Flura both seemed interested in hearing more about such a pill.

Of course, Kent knew they would be curious, but since he had no reason to create a spectacle for now, at least not until Pill God Flura’s fame died down, he simply smiled and brushed the matter aside.

"Since that is the case, then I will report to the Pill Council that you will be the tenth candidate representing the Eastern Region. However, make sure to report to the council before the competition begins."
Elder Zhen Kai knew he stood no chance against Kent, so he conceded while the brat was still willing to play nice.
What Kent had displayed today was more than enough to demonstrate the kind of monster he truly was.
His name appeared on three Dao Tablets, two of which were combat-oriented tablets. So while he might be a great alchemist, he was also a deadly swordsman and the wielder of a True Ice Element.
"I will surely come, Elder Zhen Kai," Kent replied.
To become a Pill Divine, he had to win the Intergalactic Alchemy Competition, so securing a place among the participants was a step in the right direction.
Surprisingly, his life in the Immortal Realm was shaping up to be one of the best periods of his journey back to the peak, like it had been in all 13 lives he had lived.
Perhaps he would even surpass that level this time around.

After Elder Zhen Kai left, Kent proceeded to outline several rules regarding how the distribution of the Soul Tempering Pill would be handled through the Dream Pill Emporium, the one-stop store for all things pill-related owned and managed by the infamous Lady Veth.

Once that was settled, Kent took Flura, Veth, Ursa, and Bryna into the tower, arriving at the Tower Garden. Unlike Sylvara and Vey, who had practically run straight into his bed, Flura and Veth were different.
In fact, among the women he had met while traveling through the Pill World, Veth, Lady Wu, and Flura were the only ones with whom nothing particularly serious had happened.
So he brought them to the garden rather than the Harem Tower.
"This place is wonderful," Veth said as she looked around the beautiful garden.
Flura and the others felt the same. The beauty of the garden took all of them by surprise.
Lili Thara jumped down and immediately started running around, chasing butterflies throughout the garden.
"Everyone, welcome to my home. It is a place accessible only to me unless, of course, I grant you permission to come and go as you please.
In here, there is no such thing as suffering, so make yourselves at home because this is where you will be spending most of your time from now on."
They nodded, none of them opposed to the arrangement he had for them. Even without Kent saying anything, they all felt at peace simply standing within the garden.
Ursa and Bryna began looking around some more, using that as an excuse to give Kent some privacy for a proper reunion with Veth and Flura.
They both hugged Kent the moment they got some privacy. It had been a while since they had last seen him, so the hug lasted for a couple of minutes.
"I miss you ladies," Kent said, flashing a handsome smile.
"We miss you, too, Kent."
They shared another hug, and then Kent started asking about their lives and how they had managed during the 370,000-plus years they had been apart.

Veth told him all about the adventures she had while building the Dream Pill Emporium, one of the largest and most powerful Pill stores in the Eastern Region. She had cemented her position as one of the wealthiest people in the Immortal Realm.
As for Flura, her 370,000 years had been spent studying alchemy, hoping to surpass Kent when they met again.
"I have surpassed you, Kent," she said again, a happy smile on her face.
Indeed, she had surpassed him in rank. After all, she had just become a Pill God while Kent was merely a Pill Legend. However, in terms of experience, she was still severely lacking.

Kent was the wisest and most intelligent man who had ever lived. On top of that, he was one of the most accomplished alchemists the universe had ever seen. So, saying that she had surpassed such a person was just too cute.
His memories were returning to him every now and then, so surpassing him was simply impossible.
But Kent wanted her to be happy, and Flura herself knew Kent wanted her to have this moment. So, she allowed herself to be happy, and that alone was more than enough for Kent to see her happy.
"I am proud of you, Flura," Kent said, giving her hand a gentle squeeze. "With how fast you are growing, there is no telling what you will be able to accomplish in the near future."
She smiled and nodded. "I will work hard to do more than I have done now."
"Then be ready to become one of the best because, guess what? There are many alchemists, but only a few have managed to impress the Pill Dao.
You are now one of them, but compared to the achievements of those who came before you, you must become even more impressive.
The universe needs more alchemists, but it also needs those who can make a huge difference."
"I will, Kent. While I am perhaps the weakest among all eighteen names, I will one day become one of the strongest and the best."
"I have no doubt you will, Flura." Kent laughed and continued to chat with the two ladies.
Meanwhile, outside, word of what had happened at the Everlasting Pill Mountain continued to travel from one planet to another, reaching as many people as possible.
Aside from that, the appearance of a Living Pill and the offer given to everyone had started causing many to go all out, chasing after treasures to use in exchange for just one Soul Tempering Pill.
At the same time, Axten had returned to the God Realm and started moving to Pill God Brandon’s private world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1692: Upgrading The Undead Legion
paragraphs: Reuniting with Veth and Flura made Kent very happy.

It had been a very long time since they had seen him, even if it had been only a few years for him. But as someone who had lived on Earth, a place where someone above seventy-five years old is considered fortunate, the years apart had been a long time for him, too.
But now, he was happy that he had finally started reuniting with them.

"You said Lady Wu would be holding a mega auction in a few months’ time, huh?" Kent asked Veth, who, from what he had learned, was much closer to Lady Wu than the rest. Since they both ventured into business, it was only right that they stayed connected.
Veth nodded. "Yes. The Brown Maple Auction Empire is the largest auction empire in the Eastern Region. Whatever you gave her before you left the Pill World helped her very much. It helped all of us.

Now, we have influence everywhere in the region and in other regions as well. We even have connections to some gods, and recently, I managed to form a connection with a Pill Supreme." She made sure Kent understood that the money he gave her wasn’t spent on foolish things.

"As for Lady Wu, every ten thousand years, she holds an auction attended only by the richest and most powerful. I honestly don’t know how far her influence has reached, but if you attend, I am sure you will be amazed.
I have an invitation, so we can go together if you want."
Kent smiled. "I guess I will go to Lady Wu first before visiting the others."
"Wonderful. When you are ready to leave, let me know."
A few seconds later, Zeraphine and the others whom he had met in the Pill World arrived in the garden after Kent had informed them that Veth and Flura were now in the tower.
He wasn’t the only one who needed this reunion. It had been years since they last saw each other, so this reunion was for all of them.
A few minutes after they arrived, Kent’s wives also started to appear. Every last one of them walked into Kent’s arms and hugged him before stealing a kiss.
Veth and Flura, who had just arrived in the tower, were stunned when they saw the dozens of beauties walking into Kent’s arms. For a moment, they felt like they had underestimated him.
When Val finally kissed him, Lili Thara landed on Kent’s head, causing everyone who had just arrived to direct their attention toward her.

"Kent, who is this tiny child?" Vexthra asked, looking at Lili Thara with eyes that clearly said she wanted to hold her. In fact, his wives, including the Evil Queen Pandora, all wanted to hold Lili Thara.
Seeing that they all wanted to know who the little girl was, Kent smiled and replied, "She is my child."
Their eyes widened, including Lili Thara’s.

While the ladies felt their heartbeats quicken, Lili Thara was at a loss for what to say. She clearly had no idea what Kent meant, but judging by how everyone was looking at her, she knew she was the center of attention.
Kent grinned when he saw the expressions on his wives’ faces.
"Relax, all of you. Lili Thara is a Living Pill. She is a Tier 22 Soul Tempering Pill that was brought to life using a technique called [Pill Life]."
The ladies let out sighs of relief, but they still glared at him for nearly making them ask who the mother was and also demand their own children.
They had already planned to bring up the subject, but knowing that the universe was far from safe, they wanted to reach a stage where, with or without children, no threat could endanger them.
"Hold on a minute." Indie stepped forward and narrowed her eyes at Lili Thara. "Since when can pills gain life? And can she continue to grow beyond her current stage?"
Kent smirked. "Your knowledge of alchemy is weak, Indie. And yes, pills can have a life of their own. Such pills are mostly referred to as Sentient Pills.
However, Lili Thara is a special case. She gained both sentience and life force, meaning she can continue to grow beyond the limits of a Tier 22 pill."
"Unbelievable."
Some of his wives, who were only just learning about something this shocking, stared intently at Lili Thara, who clung to Kent’s horns and tried to hide her face.

"Who even created a technique that can give life to a pill?" Pandora wondered aloud. "From what I have learned, giving life to something can only be achieved if you possess some understanding of the Law of Origin. Creating a technique capable of doing so would require an even deeper understanding of the Origin Laws."
She looked at Lili Thara before turning to Flura.
"There are no traces of the Law of Origin on her, which means the technique was given to her. Kent, did you give it to her?"
"Nope. The Pill Dao did after her name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet."
"Really?"
The ladies immediately turned toward Flura, who was smiling proudly.
"Congratulations, sister," they all said, causing Flura to blush slightly before nodding.
"Just incredible," several of them murmured as they continued admiring Lili Thara, who had regained some of her confidence and was now sitting upright on Kent’s head.
"Do you also have the technique to create Living Pills?" Camilla asked.
"Yes." Kent grinned before adding, "After all, I was the one who created it."
"WHAT?!"
The shocked cries echoed throughout the garden.
Kent laughed at their reactions.

"I created it during one of my past lives. Back then, I was an alchemist and one of the top scholars. One day, I encountered a strange beast that could turn living things into non-living ones and vice versa.

We spoke for a while, and after exchanging knowledge, I received a manual that helped me begin to understand the Law of Origin. Later, after becoming a Pill God, I created the [Pill Life] Technique and used it to give life to my pills.
After I died, the Pill Dao copied the technique and began granting it to accomplished alchemists."
The ladies exchanged glances before breaking into laughter.
The kind of person Kent was continued to blow their minds. Every time they thought they had uncovered all of his secrets, another implausible story would emerge from one of his countless past lives.
"You are a monster, Kent," Neomi said.
The others nodded in agreement.
Kent merely laughed. Even he occasionally found himself shocked by the kind of life he had lived in the distant past.
"So, are you going back out there, or are you planning on joining us in clearing the dungeons?" Vexthra asked as she rested her head against Kent’s shoulder.
Meanwhile, Lili Thara had grabbed a strand of Vexthra’s hair and was happily playing with it.
"Not yet. I want to upgrade my Undead Legion and awaken their true powers before heading back out," Kent replied as he gently squeezed Vexthra’s hand.
His gaze swept across the gathered ladies before he brought all of them to the Legion Tower, where he intended to awaken Kaizo and the rest of his Undead Legion’s true undead powers.
At the moment, they could only be considered half-awakened.
However, now that he had become the Bone Lich Emperor, he possessed the ability to bring out their true potential.
In fact, he planned to ensure that every single member of his undead legion advanced beyond their current stage and became strong enough to undertake a mission he had received from the tower.
Since he could not personally travel to the Undead Realm because of his conflict with the Undead Monarch, Kaizo and the others would carry out the mission in his stead.

Seeing that they all wanted to know who the little girl was, Kent smiled and replied, "She is my child."
Their eyes widened, including Lili Thara’s.
While the ladies felt their heartbeats quicken, Lili Thara was at a loss for what to say.
She clearly had no idea what Kent meant, but judging by how everyone was looking at her, she knew she was the center of attention.
Kent grinned when he saw the expressions on his wives’ faces.
"Relax, all of you.
Lili Thara is a Living Pill.
She is a Tier 22 Soul Tempering Pill that was brought to life using a technique called [Pill Life]."
The ladies let out sighs of relief, but they still glared at him for nearly making them ask who the mother was and also demand their own children.
They had already planned to bring up the subject, but knowing that the universe was far from safe, they wanted to reach a stage where, with or without children, no threat could endanger them.
"Hold on a minute." Indie stepped forward and narrowed her eyes at Lili Thara.
"Since when can pills gain life?
And can she continue to grow beyond her current stage?"
Kent smirked.
"Your knowledge of alchemy is weak, Indie.
And yes, pills can have a life of their own.
Such pills are mostly referred to as Sentient Pills.
However, Lili Thara is a special case.
She gained both sentience and life force, meaning she can continue to grow beyond the limits of a Tier 22 pill."
"Unbelievable."
Some of his wives, who were only just learning about something this shocking, stared intently at Lili Thara, who clung to Kent’s horns and tried to hide her face.
"Who even created a technique that can give life to a pill?" Pandora wondered aloud.
"From what I have learned, giving life to something can only be achieved if you possess some understanding of the Law of Origin.
Creating a technique capable of doing so would require an even deeper understanding of the Origin Laws."
She looked at Lili Thara before turning to Flura.
"There are no traces of the Law of Origin on her, which means the technique was given to her.
Kent, did you give it to her?"
"Nope.
The Pill Dao did after her name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet."
"Really?"
The ladies immediately turned toward Flura, who was smiling proudly.
"Congratulations, sister," they all said, causing Flura to blush slightly before nodding.
"Just incredible," several of them murmured as they continued admiring Lili Thara, who had regained some of her confidence and was now sitting upright on Kent’s head.
"Do you also have the technique to create Living Pills?" Camilla asked.
"Yes." Kent grinned before adding, "After all, I was the one who created it."
"WHAT?!"
The shocked cries echoed throughout the garden.
Kent laughed at their reactions.
"I created it during one of my past lives.
Back then, I was an alchemist and one of the top scholars.
One day, I encountered a strange beast that could turn living things into non-living ones and vice versa.
We spoke for a while, and after exchanging knowledge, I received a manual that helped me begin to understand the Law of Origin.
Later, after becoming a Pill God, I created the [Pill Life] Technique and used it to give life to my pills.
After I died, the Pill Dao copied the technique and began granting it to accomplished alchemists."
The ladies exchanged glances before breaking into laughter.
The kind of person Kent was continued to blow their minds.
Every time they thought they had uncovered all of his secrets, another implausible story would emerge from one of his countless past lives.
"You are a monster, Kent," Neomi said.
The others nodded in agreement.
Kent merely laughed.
Even he occasionally found himself shocked by the kind of life he had lived in the distant past.
"So, are you going back out there, or are you planning on joining us in clearing the dungeons?" Vexthra asked as she rested her head against Kent’s shoulder.
Meanwhile, Lili Thara had grabbed a strand of Vexthra’s hair and was happily playing with it.
"Not yet.
I want to upgrade my Undead Legion and awaken their true powers before heading back out," Kent replied as he gently squeezed Vexthra’s hand.
His gaze swept across the gathered ladies before he brought all of them to the Legion Tower, where he intended to awaken Kaizo and the rest of his Undead Legion’s true undead powers.
At the moment, they could only be considered half-awakened.
However, now that he had become the Bone Lich Emperor, he possessed the ability to bring out their true potential.
In fact, he planned to ensure that every single member of his undead legion advanced beyond their current stage and became strong enough to undertake a mission he had received from the tower.
Since he could not personally travel to the Undead Realm because of his conflict with the Undead Monarch, Kaizo and the others would carry out the mission in his stead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1693: Undead Legion (1)
paragraphs: When Kent arrived at the Legion Tower with the ladies, he discovered that Kaizo and some of the guys had ventured into a dungeon and had yet to return. So, out of the 12 undead legions under his command, only four were present.
He decided to wait for them since he came for all of them. Out of the 12 undead, seven were female, and five were male.
Kent didn’t know why that was at first, considering he personally created only three of them: Kaizo, Vaelros, and Sylara. The rest were all created by Gaia and her sisters.
However, now that his memories of Sanders had returned and he could recall what he had done in the past, none of this bothered him anymore.
He had already come to understand that, for the next couple of years, as long as his memories kept returning, everything happening in his life would be by design.
However, one day, he would reach the point where it would all end. From there, he could progress on his own terms, not one designed by his past lives.
But then again, the whole idea of reincarnation was for this very moment, so he had nothing to worry about.
After waiting for a few hours, Kaizo and the others returned, having cleared half of the dungeon. They planned to continue exploring the rest later.
He proceeded to inform all of them of his plans for them, and, as expected, Kaizo was over the moon upon hearing that he would be getting his upgrade early.
"Really, Master? We are getting an upgrade?"
Kent smiled and nodded.

"Yes, buddy. It’s time for you, 12, to start walking the path you once tread in the past. Once I fully awaken your bloodlines and innate bodies, you will understand everything. For now, let’s upgrade you all."
They all nodded at Kent’s words. Since they could not truly die unless Kent died, there was nothing to fear.
Kent sighed, and then he placed the bones at the feet of all 12 undead.
Kaizo stood in the first position because he was the first undead Kent had ever created. He was also the very first undead Kent created back when he was the Bone Lich Emperor.
So, he began with him.
Zareth was second.

In the past, he had been created from the bones of the Alabaster World Serpent and the Obsidian Void Dragon. Sanders (Kent’s necromancer incarnation) and Kaizo had endured countless hardships just to secure those bones.
When he was created, he emerged extraordinarily powerful and possessed the ability to summon those two deadly beast spirits.
He could also transform into a hybrid form that combined both beasts, raising his combat prowess to terrifying heights.
The third undead was Sylara, the Vampire Demoness, one of the deadliest assassins Sanders had ever created.
She was born from the bones of a deadly vampire warrior whose claws were as sharp and lethal as finely forged daggers.
As for the single eye she possessed in her true form, that was the result of a later modification involving a terrifying one-eyed demon capable of unleashing devastating beams from its eye.
Sylara was naturally deadly, but after undergoing those modifications, she became even more terrifying. Now, she was awakening to reclaim the power that once made her feared across countless worlds.
The fourth was, of course, Vaelros, the Chained Demon. His power revolved around chains. As long as a chain remained in his grasp, nobody could get past him.
He was created from the remains of the Chain-Tormented Wolf, a deadly beast said to have been personally chained by the Primordial Chaos Dragon during the Primordial Era.
The beast eventually died, and Sanders somehow acquired some of its bones, which he used to create Vaelros.

As for the rest of the undead, Elyndra, the Voidweaver Sorceress, stood in the fifth position. Her affinity for the void, space, souls, and arcane magic stemmed from the ancient creatures whose bones had been used in her creation.
Her true power remained a mystery even now, but one thing was certain—she was deadly. Kent wanted her back at his side once more for what he had planned in the future.
Morne stood in the sixth position. Her power came from the moon, shadows, curses, and Death Arts. Back in the day, she was both incredibly dangerous and undeniably badass.
Velmora stood in the seventh spot, while Varkhiel occupied the eighth. These two were created on the same day, making them twins, in a sense.
Sanders created them from the same source of bones, yet their personalities could not have been more different.
Velmora was proud and arrogant, while Varkhiel was quiet, patient, and calculating.
And that was precisely what made them so dangerous.
Seraphyne stood in the ninth position, while Velithra occupied the tenth. Long before her bones were used to create an undead, Seraphyne was a princess of an ancient Elven race.
Her family personally entrusted her remains to Sanders, who used her likeness and many of her original traits when creating her.
It had been one of the few moments in his past where Sanders was treated as a person rather than a monster or an undead.
Selantra occupied the eleventh position, and finally, Varyn, the Voidblade Knight, stood in the twelfth.
In this order, the first twelve undead Sanders had ever created were about to receive a complete makeover.
With the materials Kent was using, he expected every single one of them to emerge stronger, deadlier, and far more powerful than before.
The moment all the materials had been prepared, the [Undead Staff] appeared in his hand, and his appearance shifted into that of a red-haired half-elf.
He began muttering strange and ancient words.

A few minutes into the ritual, different colored cocoons formed around all twelve undead. The moment the cocoons fully materialised, the bones lying before their feet rose into the air and merged with them.
The bones dissolved quickly into cocoons, and the transformation began.
In the past, Sanders had created over sixty thousand undead, but among them, he had ensured that sixty-nine were crafted from some of the most powerful remains discovered during that era.
Just as Kaizo had been created from the remains of a Divine Angelic Titan, every one of those sixty-nine undead owed their existence to Sanders’ relentless pursuit of power and excellence.
Now, twelve of them were returning to him.
The rest would follow once he located the bones that the tower and the quest pools that Tower had pointed out to him earlier today.
Some of them were hidden within the Undead Realm, while others were located in terrifying places where he would have to fight for what he sought.
In essence, he was rebuilding his undead legion from the ground up.
And, as always, Kaizo was the first undead with whom he began.
