chapters.title: Chapter 1694: Undead Legion (2)
paragraphs: The process took hours but less than a day. The moment the clock struck the 18th hour, Kaizo’s cocoon cracked, and waves of energy poured out.
Golden lightning danced around the cocoon as more cracks started to appear on its surface.

A few minutes later, the cracks widened, and one half of the cocoon fell away, revealing Kaizo’s body. As always, he stood tall and muscular, but now with much longer golden hair and an even more refined physique.

As someone who once wielded the Divine Titan Physique and the Divine Titan Bloodline, Kent knew that Kaizo had awakened both powers, and that was why his body looked even more refined and filled with power.

As more pieces of the cocoon fell away, more of his body was revealed. His body was covered in metallic golden and black armour, with the upper portion sleeveless and the lower half protected by matching armoured trousers.
When the last piece of the cocoon fell, a wave of power that could only be unleashed by a Demigod burst from his body, filling the entire space.
Kaizo had gone from an Immortal King to a Peak Demigod in one go. That was the power of a True Undead.
He had also awakened his Unbreakable Fist Job Class, the same class that had made him a terrifying warrior back in the day.

When he was finally free, he summoned his gauntlets and flexed his muscles, something every brute in his position would have done. After making sure he had examined enough, he looked at Kent and smiled.
"I am finally back, Master."
He had recovered his past-life memories, and so he knew that Kent was the same person as Sanders, the Bone Lich Undead Emperor.
Sanders was Kent’s past incarnation, one who had lived during the Undead Era. He was the creator of the Undead Legion, a force led by the Undead Titan, Kaizo.
Now that he had awakened his true self, there was no telling what he would do next.
"Glad to have you back, Kaizo," Kent said with a smile before turning toward Zareth’s cocoon, which had also started to crack.
"ROARRRRRRR!"
"HISSSSSSS!"
A powerful roar and a dangerous hiss erupted from the cocoon as two beams of light shot into the air, and a wave of terrifying suppression descended upon everyone.
High above, the Alabaster World Serpent and the Obsidian Void Dragon appeared, each colossal and terrifying in their own right.
Kent, who had been the one to create Zareth in the first place, widened his eyes when he sensed the power level of the two beasts.
’True Gods. Then does that mean Zareth is also a True God?’

His thoughts, however, were interrupted when the cocoon fell apart, and Zareth was revealed. He was a Demigod, but he possessed the aura of a True God. Immediately, Kent linked that anomaly to the two beasts.
Honestly, even he didn’t know why these two beast spirits had come with Zareth in the first place.

From what he could remember, when he used the bones of the Alabaster World Serpent and the Obsidian Void Dragon to create him, he had expected a man with affinities for Void and Poison to appear, which he did. However, he had also awakened an affinity for Spirits.
This affinity granted him the ability to summon the two beast spirits and even merge with them, which would raise his power to an entirely different level.
Right now, he had awakened his Dual Coiled Beast Ancestors Bloodline and his Abyssal Warlock Job Class.

Most importantly, all three elements he had awakened were already at the Absolute Rank. He was also a Peak Demigod and had awakened the Spirit Symbiosis skill, an ability that allowed him to merge with the two Beast Spirits.

His skin remained pale, but now his hair had been braided into large locks that resembled living serpents. When he stepped down from the air, his spear appeared beside him, and a smile tugged at the corner of his lips.
"It is good to be back," he muttered, already planning which beast he would devour next in order to strengthen both himself and his two Beast Spirits.
Just when Kent was about to ask Zareth a few questions, Sylara’s cocoon cracked, and waves of blood qi filled the space.

Kent suddenly found himself surrounded by a dense blood mist, and before he could pull himself back, his consciousness was dragged away, appearing before a lady clad in crimson robes, seated upon a terrifying throne forged entirely from bones.

Kent recognised the lady at first glance. After all, it was none other than Sylara in her true form. She possessed a single eye, and with his Omniscient Jade Eyes, Kent could finally tell that the eye can do far more than simply fire destructive beams.
"I suppose you brought me to your soul space because of our agreement, Sylara," Kent asked, and she nodded.
"Indeed, Master. I was created from a single bone. However, the complete skeleton is located somewhere within the Undead Monarch’s personal vault. We must retrieve it so I can become whole."
"We will get it, Sylara. I promise that this time, we will recover your complete skeleton."
"Okay, Master."
She smiled, and the next second, Kent found himself back in his body.
"What a powerful Blood Qi," Velyra muttered, her brow furrowed as she studied the blood mist filling the surroundings.
As someone who also cultivated Blood Qi, she could immediately tell that Sylara, in her true Undead form, was a monster.
Sylara stepped out with silent, graceful steps.𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂

She was clad in a far more refined set of armour this time. She wore a pair of black trousers lined with crimson stripes and a long-sleeved shirt that clung tightly to her body and was zipped all the way to her neck.
A pair of daggers rested at her waist, while the claws extending from her fingers remained as elongated and deadly as ever.
Back in the day, she was known as the Crimson Harbinger, a terrifying assassin whose mere presence was enough to decimate entire battlefields.
Like the others, she had emerged as a Demigod, but only at the High Rank, unlike Kaizo and Zareth, who had reached the Peak Rank.
She had also awakened her Abyssal Reaper Job Class, while her affinities for Blood and Void had both reached the Absolute Rank.
Her Primordial Bloodmoon Wraith Bloodline had also awakened, bringing with it several powerful bloodline abilities.
The moment her awakening concluded, chains began to dangle through the air as a sudden storm filled with crimson lightning engulfed the entire space.
This signalled the awakening of the infamous Vaelros, the Crimson Tyrant.
"Everyone, move back," Kent instructed, and everyone immediately retreated farther away.
While the storm of crimson lightning was unlikely to kill any of them, creating some distance still seemed like the most logical decision.
As they moved back, the rattling sound of chains grew louder and louder.
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
The crimson storm overhead became increasingly violent as terrifying waves of energy washed across the area.
BOOOOOM!
Suddenly, an explosion rocked the surroundings.
High in the air, Vaelros’s body hung suspended amidst countless thick crimson chains.
His long red hair flowed freely behind him as waves of terrifying aura poured endlessly from his body.
"Looks like he awakened both his Chain Sovereign Class and his second class, the Abyssal Doombringer," Kaizo muttered.
Kent nodded in agreement.
Vaelros was renowned for his chains, and that explained much about his origin.
He possessed affinities for Chains, Lightning, and Darkness, all three of which had already reached the Absolute Rank.
His Abyss Chain Titan Bloodline allowed him to channel abyssal energy as part of his already versatile arsenal of power sources.

His long red hair flowed freely behind him as waves of terrifying aura poured endlessly from his body.
"Looks like he awakened both his Chain Sovereign Class and his second class, the Abyssal Doombringer," Kaizo muttered.
Kent nodded in agreement.
Vaelros was renowned for his chains, and that explained much about his origin.
He possessed affinities for Chains, Lightning, and Darkness, all three of which had already reached the Absolute Rank.
His Abyss Chain Titan Bloodline allowed him to channel abyssal energy as part of his already versatile arsenal of power sources.

chapters.title: Chapter 1695: Undead Legion (3)
paragraphs: Vaelros also came out as a peak Demigod, which made Kent smile happily.
It appeared he wouldn’t have to wait for Kaizo and the others to grow to the required stage before sending them to the Undead Realm to retrieve the bones needed to create the rest of his undead.

He wanted the majority of them to be Demigods before sending them there. This was because if he waited for all of them to become Gods before sending them, the chances of them getting noticed by the Undead Monarch would be high.
He most certainly had no plans on putting them under the radar of that unreasonable bastard.
Twelve deadly undead god stage warriors appearing out of nowhere would, without a doubt, raise suspicion.
However, Demigods would blend in well, and with their strength and the missions assigned to them, they could easily accomplish their objectives.
Vaelros remained inside the storm for a few more minutes before flying down. When he landed, the chains wrapped around him coiled and merged with his skin, leaving behind tattoos resembling chains.
"I never knew I would ever witness the return of legends," Yukiko muttered, staring at Vaelros.
As someone who had lived through the Undead Era, she had witnessed and heard countless stories about the sixty-nine undead generals who stood at the vanguard of the Bone Lich Emperor’s undead army.

While she had chosen to remain in the Tormented Chaos Abyss after the Divine Beast Tamer’s death, she would occasionally return to the universe whenever she sensed something alarming that required her strength to handle.
She had made a promise to Kent’s past incarnation, the Divine Beast Tamer, that she would continue protecting the universe for as long as she lived.
Because of that promise, she was very familiar with the Bone Lich Undead Emperor and his sixty-nine undead generals.

Witnessing the likes of the legendary Undead Titan Kaizo and Vaelros, the Crimson Tyrant, awakening to reclaim their power brought her mind back to the countless stories she had heard about them.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂
And she wasn’t the only one.

As some of Kent’s wives recovered their memories, it became increasingly clear just what kind of monsters some of them had been in their past lives, and the legendary figures they had either heard about or even fought alongside.
"Hey, Vaelros, stop showing off and get your ass over here," Zareth said, glaring at the muscular undead tyrant who fought as though he had no regard for his own life.
Vaelros smirked and walked toward Kent. When he was close enough, he smiled.
"Glad to be back, Master. I suppose this time around, we will finally get to visit that place."
Kent nodded.
"We will, Vaelros. After all, your final awakenings will happen there. So rest assured, we will go there one day."
Vaelros nodded and walked to the side, already planning to challenge Kaizo to a duel.
Kent could see the fighting intent in his eyes as Vaelros turned toward Kaizo.
’If I remember correctly, they dueled 2,991 times in the past, and Kaizo won every single one of them. Makes me wonder if he plans on changing that this time around.’
Scenes of the countless chaotic battles between Kaizo and Vaelros flashed through Kent’s mind, bringing a smile to his face.
Now, he finally understood why Kaizo had been made his right-hand man despite having many subordinates who were more powerful than him.
Kaizo never stopped fighting, no matter how dire the battle became.
No matter what they were up against, Kaizo always made sure he stood at the vanguard, fighting for everyone and, most importantly, for the safety of his master.
He had been Sanders’ first creation, and if Kent was being honest with himself, Kaizo had always been his favorite creation.
He had created many impressive undead, such as Zareth and Sylara, but Kaizo remained his favorite and, in many ways, his finest masterpiece.
So he deserved everything Kent had planned to give him.
’We will have many adventures this time around, buddy,’ Kent thought inwardly before letting out a soft sigh.
He then turned and looked at the fifth cocoon, which had begun to tremble violently.
As it shook, Kent could sense waves of Space Qi gushing out from within.
"Such powerful Space Magic," Pandora muttered, her eyes narrowing as she stared at the fifth cocoon that housed Elyndra’s body.
As someone whose strength stood at the very peak of the universe, she had seen her fair share of prodigies.
However, sensing the kind of Space Essence pouring out of the cocoon, she felt that the undead about to emerge was one of the most dangerous wielders of Space Magic she had ever encountered.

In truth, Kent, who knew everything about Elyndra, understood that her true power had once been sealed by the heavens because, from what he knew, if she were allowed to unleash her full potential upon the universe, she would become a danger to everyone.
Her understanding of Space Magic came from a special treasure Sanders had incorporated during her creation.
While he could only create undead from bones, that did not mean he was limited to using bones alone.
The bones were merely the core ingredient.
He could always use additional treasures to strengthen them or even fuse those treasures into the bones during the creation process.
For Elyndra, Sanders had spent an enormous fortune purchasing a Space Dao Stone, a treasure rumored to have originated from the Primordial Chaos itself.
From what he knew, the Primordial Chaos, or the Primal Chaos as many called it, was the center of the Multiverse.
It was a realm that existed outside space and time, a mysterious domain where countless wonders and impossibilities could be found.
It was also believed to be the birthplace of creation itself.
The heavens held no authority there, which meant treasures originating from the Primordial Chaos were free from heavenly restrictions.
Sanders had used one such Dao Stone during Elyndra’s creation, and the result was one of the greatest wielders of Space Magic to ever exist.
CRACK!
The cocoon suddenly shattered.
A woman with flowing silver hair and an athletic build emerged from within, a beautifully crafted staff resting in her hand.
Elyndra possessed the body of a warrior. Her figure was toned and graceful rather than exaggerated, yet her beauty was breathtaking.

She had also emerged as a Demigod at the peak level, and with strands of Space Essence dancing around her body, it was clear she had awakened both her Space Sorceress Class and her Twilight Angel Bloodline.
Aside from that, she had also awakened her Space, Void, and Soul affinity, all at the Absolute stage.

Behind her hovered a massive disc-shaped diagram, its surface covered in countless glowing runes. More than a dozen tendrils hung from the disc, swaying gently as though they possessed lives of their own.
"The Calamity Space Disc," Kent muttered, his expression brightening as he stared at the artifact hovering behind Elyndra.
"Looks like we’re bringing out all the big guns from the start this time around," Sylara said with a cheerful smile as she watched Elyndra approach.
When Elyndra finally stopped before Kent, a smile appeared on her face.
"Thank you for awakening me again, Master. I know it has been a long time, but now that I’m back, feel free to send me on any mission in places you cannot personally go."
Kent smirked as soon as he heard that.
"We’re not stealing from anyone’s vault this time around, Elyndra."
"Oh?" Elyndra’s smile widened slightly.
"Then tell me when you change your mind, Master."
Naturally, Kent’s wives were completely lost.
They had no idea what had just transpired.
However, the members of the Undead Legion immediately understood the meaning behind that exchange.
Back during the Undead Era, one of the major reasons they had all been able to rise to such terrifying heights despite the growing demand for resources to upgrade them was because of Elyndra.
Or as they had affectionately called her back then...
Sticky Fingers.
With her mastery over Space Magic, she could quite literally go anywhere she wanted.
As a result, she had developed a rather notorious habit of visiting the vaults of powerful individuals.

Many of the cultivation resources, treasures, divine materials, and inheritances that had fueled the growth of the Undead Legion had mysteriously found their way into Sanders’ possession through her efforts.
In fact, had it not been for Elyndra, even the legendary Underworld Vault would have remained impenetrable to Sanders.
Kent shook his head helplessly.
Even after all these years, some habits clearly refused to die.
Just as he was about to tell Elyndra that he would never change his mind, the remaining seven cocoons simultaneously exploded.
BOOOOOOM!
Seven terrifying waves of aura erupted into the sky.

And before the stunned gazes of everyone present, seven deadly undead emerged from the shattered cocoons, each a monster in their own right, their presence alone distorting the surrounding space as though the world itself could barely tolerate their existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1696: Undead Legion (4)
paragraphs: Varyn, Morne, Selantra, Seraphyne, Varkhiel, Velithra, and Velmora appeared in the air, each oozing the power of Demigods at their peak.
Already, Kaizo and the others had emerged as Demigods, so the seven coming out as Demigods wasn’t too shocking.

However, what Kent never expected was that all seven of them would evolve at the same time. He didn’t know why that happened, since it had never happened before. However, he didn’t dwell much on it either.

The most important thing was that all twelve undead under his command had evolved into powerful warriors. Now, aside from his Beast Legion, he had twelve more demigod-level undead he could rely on to handle missions for him.
Varyn was the Voidblade Knight.

His presence and appearance radiated knighthood. Naturally, he had been a knight before becoming the Voidblade Knight. When Sanders stumbled upon the remains of a dead knight, he didn’t put much thought into it.

However, when he cast the Undead Eye spell on the remains, he saw just how powerful the bones were. So he collected them all, and a year later, Varyn returned as a legendary knight capable of wielding both Flame and Void.
His affinity for flames came from a treasure Sanders added during his creation, while the Void affinity was because his bones had been tempered with Void Essence long before he died.
He rode a Void Horse into battle, and every time he arrived on the battlefield, blazing trails of fire were left in his wake. Now, he had returned as that legendary knight.
Selantra, the Lunar Warden, also stood among the seven undead clad in obsidian armor. Golden glyphs were engraved throughout the armor, making it stand out, while a sleek helmet rested on her head.
She had golden, star-like eyes, and a living shadow cloak billowed behind her.
Just like Val, she could also channel the power of the moon.
In fact, both her primary and secondary classes allowed her to harness lunar power. She possessed a class called [Lunar Warden] and a secondary class called [Moon Warlock].
Basically, she had been created from the remains of a being whose understanding of the Moon had reached an all-time high.

Now, she had returned as a Demigod at her peak, who knew when her Crescent Half Moon Strike would appear again. That skill was her favorite and her best. Each arc channels so much moon qi that it decimates armies.

Velithra also stood calmly, oozing the cultivation of a demigod at the peak, her fingers playing with her bow. They called her the Umbral Archer because, according to the stories, she came and went as she pleased, and her arrows carried the power of darkness.
She has the Umbral Archer class and affinity for Shadow and Void, both at the absolute stage.

Basically, she was a Dark Elf with the bloodline of a Shadow Cat. She was one of those creations that came about after mixing a lot of things together. Yet Velithra was a deadly archer, and her affinity for Darkness and Void made her even more dangerous.
Seraphyne also stood among the group, clad in jagged abyss-black armor adorned with thousands of violet runic engravings.

A horned, faceless helmet rested on her head, giving her a demonic, intimidating appearance. However, the truly frightening part came from her glowing purple eyes, which shone through the darkness of the helmet.

She possessed the [Shadow Warlord] class, a powerful class that granted her dominion over shadows. In the past, she was known as a one-woman army because of her ability to summon Shadow Fiends from the Shadow Realm to fight under her command.
It was one of her deadliest abilities and one that had earned her countless victories. Now, as a demigod at the peak, Kent knew even true gods would fear him.
Kent already had plans to take her along when he explored the Shadow Realm for real this time.
Varkhiel, the Shadowflame Reaver, stood with his lean body and hair completely engulfed in flames. In fact, he looked more like Ghost Rider than an undead.
Then again, an undead was simply someone who had died yet continued to live.
A smile rested on his face as he gazed down at everyone.
"This bastard, does he always have to keep the flames burning for no reason?" Zareth cursed, annoyed by the shameless way Varkhiel constantly tried to make himself look cool.
Varkhiel possessed affinities for both Void and Flame. However, his flame was somewhat special.
His flame originated from a bygone race said to have existed before Hell itself came into being.

This race was believed to be the original masters of Hellfire, and the flame Varkhiel wielded ranked among their five greatest flames. In other words, his flame was a Sacred Flame, just like Kent’s Nirvana Flame.

So while he often used it to enhance his appearance, the truth was that it remained one of the most dangerous flames in existence. Furthermore, his affinity with it had already reached the Absolute Stage.
Now that he had become a Demigod, and considering the terrifying nature of his flame, he ranked among the three most dangerous undead under Kent’s command at the moment.
Velmora, the Reaper Empress, remained the most mysterious of all twelve undead.

She stood clad in jet-black Gothic armor, its surface lined with bone-etched engravings. Crimson veins of light coursed across the armor, while a torn black-and-red cloak billowed behind her. Beneath the hood, a faint crimson glow illuminated the darkness.
She was also a Peak Demigod.

All Sanders knew when he acquired her bone at an auction was that she had lived during the Primordial Era and fought in the Great War. When a primordial rift opened eras later, explorers ventured inside and discovered her tomb, stealing one of her bones.
According to the auctioneer, the words engraved upon the tomb wall read:
"Here lie the remains of the Reaper Emperors, the ones whose blades know death."
Those words moved Sanders deeply, and he fought tooth and nail to obtain the bone.
Years later, he fused it with souls and shadows, creating Velmora.
She possessed Absolute Affinities in Death, Souls, and Shadows.
"How many of you have heard of the Reaper Empress?" Kent suddenly asked, turning toward his wives who had lived during the Primordial Era.
Although the universe was vast and the chances of any of them knowing her were slim, he still asked.
To his surprise, Dia raised her hand.
Dia had been Unity’s sister during the Primordial Era. Although she later became Kent’s Heart Demon, she had lived longer than Artemis, Unity’s previous incarnation, so she knew more than Unity.
"The Reaper Empress was a legendary warrior renowned for her scythe arts," Dia began. "She lived on an island called Blood River, and yes, the water there is actually red."

"From what I know, the river’s water was originally blue. However, after it was discovered that a natural Blood Pool existed on the island, two tribes composed of powerful Demigods, Gods, and even Supremes attempted to seize it from her."
"She killed every last one of them."
"Their blood dyed the river red, and from that day onward, nobody dared approach the island again."
"I don’t know what happened afterward, but from everything I heard, she was truly legendary."
Kent smiled.
"Thanks, Dia."
"Why did you ask?" Unity questioned.
"I asked because the bone I used to create Velmora came from the Reaper Empress. That’s why Velmora was also known as the Reaper Empress during the Undead Era."
The ladies nodded.
If this had happened before Kent revealed the truth about his many lives, they would have been shocked to discover yet another secret hidden within him.
However, things were different now.
His monstrous nature had long since become normal to them.
In a sense, they now viewed him as an anomaly, so very little about him could surprise them anymore.
Then again, they still hadn’t met every version of him yet.

However, after it was discovered that a natural Blood Pool existed on the island, two tribes composed of powerful Demigods, Gods, and even Supremes attempted to seize it from her."
"She killed every last one of them."
"Their blood dyed the river red, and from that day onward, nobody dared approach the island again."
"I don’t know what happened afterward, but from everything I heard, she was truly legendary."
Kent smiled.
"Thanks, Dia."
"Why did you ask?" Unity questioned.
"I asked because the bone I used to create Velmora came from the Reaper Empress.
That’s why Velmora was also known as the Reaper Empress during the Undead Era."
The ladies nodded.
If this had happened before Kent revealed the truth about his many lives, they would have been shocked to discover yet another secret hidden within him.
However, things were different now.
His monstrous nature had long since become normal to them.
In a sense, they now viewed him as an anomaly, so very little about him could surprise them anymore.
Then again, they still hadn’t met every version of him yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1697: Undead Quest
paragraphs: Morne stood in the last spot, her body covered in black-laced exoskeletal armor, crimson tendrils woven throughout. This aesthetic gave the armor an alien-like appearance.
Maybe it was because, when she awakened the Cursed Exo-Battle Armor, the bone used to upgrade her came from a beast that looked alien and cursed at the same time.

However, this armor later made her one of the greatest close-combat undead generals. Her armor allowed her to absorb damage and convert it into weapons or imbue it into her attacks. It was a skill called Kinetic, one of her best.

Blood-petal mist surrounded her body, giving her both an elegant and terrifying presence. As she stood there with her arms crossed behind her back, a memory from the past surfaced in Kent’s mind, making him smile.

The memory was from when he returned to the Abyssal Realm to aid the sitting Abyssal Monarch in searching for Sir Madok, the first Abyssal Monarch of the Abyssal Race, who ventured into the Primordial Chaos and hasn’t been heard of again, only to be surrounded by the Abyssal, Resentful, and Undead races in a sudden ambush.
That day, he had 68 of the 69 undead generals with him. Each general had 1,000 undead warriors under them.

However, Morne had only just begun creating her army, so she had just 100 undead warriors. Even so, in that battle, aside from Kaizo, Sylara, and one other undead called Magnus, Morne was the highlight.
She personally proved to Sanders that she deserved to be placed among the top five of his undead generals.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚
That battle pushed her to the top, and since then, even Kaizo became a bit hesitant to challenge her. Her true power remained unknown even to Sanders, her creator.
However, Kent, who could now see more deeply into people, could tell that Morne’s true potential hadn’t even reached the 10% stage yet.
She had the Moonveil Executioner class, allowing her to harness lunar essence.
But aside from that, she could also unleash Death Arts, Curses, and Shadows. Her affinity for Lunar, Death, Curses, and Shadows had reached the Absolute Stage.
But Kent could tell she was drawing closer to the Extreme Stage in the Death affinity. She was a Peak Demigod, making only Sylara a High Demigod.
’You won’t be able to hide anymore, Morne,’ Kent said inwardly and gestured for all his undead to surround him.
They did, and his wives moved closer to Kent as well. They all wanted to hear what Kent had to say.
"The main reason why I chose to upgrade all of you to Tier 12 is that you are going back to the Undead Realm."
"Huh?" Their eyes widened upon hearing what Kent said.
"But Master, that man clearly hates your guts. Won’t going there bring you face to face with him?" Velmora asked.

Kent smiled and answered, "Not really. I am not going with you guys. Kaizo will lead you to reclaim some bones and treasures. The bones are for Lynx, Rhael, Hoody, Asake, and Donomie. Getting them will be simple since they can be found in less dangerous regions.
However, the treasures are in one of the Seven Undead Graves, the one called Banathra Valley. Supremes are in charge of that place, and there may even be a few Celestials."
All of them frowned upon hearing what they would be up against.

Seeing their expressions, Kent smiled and clarified a few things. "Of course, I know you guys aren’t at the stage where you can face Supremes and Celestials. However, you will be doing it with the help of an old ally."

Upon hearing what Kent said, the looks on their faces softened. They had lived with him in the Undead Realm for years, so they knew not all undead hated his guts. Some liked him and later became friends with him.
Kent waved his hand, and a green stone appeared in his palm. He handed it over to Kaizo.
"Channel your energy into it after you arrive in the High Undead Heaven. It contains the bone locations and the precise location of my stash.
But before going after the treasure, find the Green Bone Oracle and tell her these exact words: ’The Undead Monarch is a bitch.’ Say those exact words, and she will know what to do next."
They nodded while his wives facepalmed.
They knew Kent well enough to realize when he hated someone. Clearly, this Undead Monarch had angered him to almost the same degree as the Forsaken Race.
The even sympathized with that poor soul who would soon feel Kent’s wrath.

"While you are down there, if an opportunity arises to obtain treasures that I can later use to upgrade you, go for it. But do that only after you reclaim the treasures. I have some Undead Crystals stashed away that you can use to buy anything.

Also, kindly grab a bottle of Undead Wine for me. Lastly, if possible, gather some information on the Undead Monarch for me. I will leave the details of how you handle that to you guys. Just make sure you don’t die."
They nodded.
"There is no need for preparation beyond this. It will be a few months, perhaps a year, before we meet again."
They scattered to make their preparations.

Time ran ten times faster there, so they would be spending years in the Undead Realm while only a few months passed in the main universe. After a few minutes, the twelve undead returned, ready to be on their way.

Kent nodded and summoned the Undead Staff. He began waving it while muttering some strange words. After five minutes, a black gate appeared inside the Legion Tower, instantly filling the space with death energy.

"I will send you to the Lower Undead Heaven. You can use the Grim Reaper Sea or the Cracked Moon Valley to reach the Medium Undead Heaven, then find a way to get to the High Undead Heaven. From there, you can begin your mission."
"Don’t worry, Master. I will make sure everything goes well," Kaizo said, beating his chest.
"I know you will, buddy. But just in case there is trouble, abandon Kaizo and run. He always finds his way back," Kent said, and they all laughed.

Kaizo didn’t mind. He was just happy he was going to do something useful for his master. Besides, he knew battles were inevitable in the Undead Realm, so there would be plenty of chances to break bones and shatter skulls.
"Anyway, good luck, guys. Once you are ready to return, just shatter the stone, and the gate will open again."
Kent waved the Undead Staff, and the gate swung open, revealing a dark interior.
"Let’s go," Kaizo said and walked into the gate, with Zareth and the others following behind him.
After the last of them entered, the gate closed.
"Kent, are they going to be okay?" Mara asked, a bit worried about the undead, especially Elyndra, her best friend.
Kent held her hand and smiled. "Probably not, but as long as I am alive, they cannot die."

While his answer sounded both negative and positive, Mara chose to focus on the positive. After all, she knew Kent wouldn’t send his Undead Legion to an unknown place without having a backup plan in mind.

"How about you ladies? Are you ready for missions outside the tower?" Kent asked, turning to the rest of his wives. They had all become Immortals, so he had no fears about sending them out to explore.
He thought about the best way to help them experience the Immortal Realm. At first, he wanted them to join sects, but they had made it clear they wouldn’t.
So his next plan was to give them some of his quests. This would allow them to see more of the outside world while also being useful, which was exactly what they wanted.
"The dungeons will be handled by the Beast Legion and the Eternal Wrath Legion, so you can all go get some fresh air."
"What about the Night Riders?" Uncle Drew, who had become a True Immortal, asked with a smile on his face.
Kent looked at them and smiled.
"I have a special mission for you too..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1698: Undead Realm Mission (1)
paragraphs: Hearing there was a mission for them, Uncle Drew and the rest of the Night Riders beamed. Kent’s past incarnation as the Ruthless Bandit had met all 69 Night Riders, but only 6 of them lived with him inside the Tower.

Of course, he is aware that some of them are in Hell while others have returned to the Dark City. Kent planned on going for them one day. However, before going to them, he first needed to handle some missions in the world of the living.

Some of those missions would be given to his wives, but there was one that only the Night Riders could handle. It was a mission that would take them to a place only beings wielding Hell Flames could go.
"There is a planet in the Immortal Realm, located in the Western Region, called Dead World. This planet is only accessible to those who have an affinity for Death and can also wield Hell Flames.
Hidden within that place is a cave located in the Black Star Domain. According to many, that domain is home to a very powerful dragon known as the Black Fire Demon Dragon.

Many years ago, a group of suppressed gods tried to kill it, but they failed to even get close to it. The Black Star Domain is that dangerous. However, there is something I want there; when you see it, you will know.

But, to get to this item, you must first survive the wrath of the Black Fire Demon Dragon. This means you must kill it before you can obtain the item. Of course, if it were only the Black Star Domain, then it wouldn’t be a Hell Mission.

However, hidden somewhere in that place is a branch of the Soul Temple. I think we both know the kind of monsters they are, so you would have to be careful. Most importantly, you must ensure the item doesn’t fall into their hands.

Since you six are the only ones with the qualities to survive that place, I will leave this mission to you. And, of course, Uncle Drew will lead, and the rest of you will follow his command to the last dot."
They nodded.
Just like Kaizo, the Night Riders listened to Uncle Drew since he was the Night Rider Captain. He snapped his fingers, and Nara, Saden, Elyndor, Vargus, and Lene walked forward.
Nara is one of Kent’s wives, but she was also a Night Rider.𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
This meant that when the captain called, she had to answer. Also, she had reached the Immortal King Stage, so Kent had no problem allowing her to join the team on this mission.
She was a swordswoman with absolute affinities for Hell Flame, Darkness, and Lightning. That combination was more than enough to make her one of the deadliest Night Riders despite her rank.
As for Lene, despite also joining the harem, she wouldn’t take no for an answer. Of course, she was a Demigod, so she was needed the most. She and Vargus were both Peak Demigods.
As for Saden, she had recently reached the Peak True Immortal Stage, but her arrows could easily kill gods. As a Hell Archer, her arrows were as deadly as they came.
Her Hell Eye skill allowed her to see the weakness of just about anyone. This enabled her to shoot with pinpoint accuracy.
Elyndor was perhaps the most powerful of them at the moment. He was a Combat Mage with affinities for Hell Flame, Darkness, and Ice.
However, while he was called a mage, his core ability, Hell Summon, allowed him to summon Hell Demons from places like the Damned Hell Sea.
He had summoned five Demigod-level Hell Demons, each powerful enough that even the strongest members of the Beast Legion wondered if they could contend with them.

The reason he was the strongest at the moment was simply that, like the Beast Symbiosis or the Undead Bone that allows Kent to inherit a part of his legion’s power, Eryndor also inherits a portion of the power of his summons.
So, despite being a Peak True Immortal, his combat power had already reached the Demigod Stage.
As for Vargus, he was as deadly as they came.
His hammer would surely show its might against powerful creatures that packed the greatest punch. He was also a Demigod, so with him added to the mix, the Night Riders were anything but simple.
After walking through the Undead Gate, Kaizo and his team appeared in a valley somewhere in the Lower Undead Heaven.
All twelve, being the first twelve undead warriors Sanders had ever created, had finally returned to the place where it all began.

In the Undead Realm, there are several levels of worlds, just like in the main universe. The only difference is that, in the main universe, there are limitations on one’s cultivation base based on the world they are in, while the same is not true in the Undead Realm.
This means that even in the lowest heaven, Celestials can be found. However, it is still a place where mostly mortals live, with their rulers only at the Mortal Stage.
The moment they arrived, Kaizo spread his senses, and so did the others.
They all wanted to ensure they were safe before planning their next move. Kent hadn’t sent them to the Lower Heaven because it was the only place he could send them.
He did so to divert attention away from them. The higher one climbs in this realm, the more likely they are to be noticed, since stronger undead reside in the Medium, High, and subsequent heavens.
After a few seconds of making sure they were alone, Kaizo started to speak.
"We are here now, but we cannot travel together. I hope you all know why."
They nodded.
If twelve Demigods suddenly appeared in the Lower Undead Heaven, it would raise too much alarm.
So they had to split into smaller groups.
"Here is the plan. Since we can’t travel together, we will split into pairs and travel in different directions. Since we are connected, we must check in every few hours to ensure we are all okay.

The objective is to get to the High Undead Heaven, where even if all twelve of us move together, it wouldn’t raise suspicion. As for how you all manage to reach the High Heaven, I will let you come up with your own methods.
Now, I will divide the groups."
Kaizo split the teams into six groups of two members each.
"Zareth, you will travel with Velmora. Sylara will move with Morne. Elyndra, you are with Velithra. Vaelros will travel with Seraphyne. Varyn travels with Varkhiel, while I move with Selantra."

There was no objection to the group division. In the past, while they had all served as generals under the Bone Lich Emperor, Kaizo’s position had been superior to theirs, so they naturally respected his authority.
If Kent was not there, the next person in charge was always Kaizo.

"Be sure to remain in touch. If you need help, feel free to reach out to any of us. The endgame here is to recover the bones of the other undead generals and the Master’s treasure, so treat this mission as a high priority.

The first to arrive in the High Undead Heaven should find a good meeting spot for us. Also, limit the way you use the tower abilities. This realm is strange, so lets not draw the attention of the Undead Monarch"
The first team to depart was Elyndra and Velithra. They flew eastward and soon vanished beyond the horizon. The rest quickly followed, and before long, only Kaizo and Selantra remained.
"So, what next?" Selantra asked, spinning a dagger between her fingers.
"Let’s find the nearest city and make some money first. We must also understand the nature of the Undead Realm since it has been years since we were last here."
Selantra nodded, and the two soon moved westward.
Kaizo had spent a lot of time with Sanders in the past, so he knew that the first rule when finding oneself in an unfamiliar realm was to blend in. That would make gathering information much easier.

"Let’s find the nearest city and make some money first.
We must also understand the nature of the Undead Realm since it has been years since we were last here."
Selantra nodded, and the two soon moved westward.
Kaizo had spent a lot of time with Sanders in the past, so he knew that the first rule when finding oneself in an unfamiliar realm was to blend in.
That would make gathering information much easier.

chapters.title: Chapter 1699: Nine Tribulation Dragon Unleashed
paragraphs: [A/N: I know some of you seem to have lost track of some of the women in the harem. That is my bad; I didn’t give some of them enough screen time or mentions.
However, that ends today. In the subsequent Chapters, I will take my time and explore the harem, putting three ladies in every two Chapters, perhaps more.

This is so that, at least by the end of this volume, you will know most of the harem members and some of the warriors in all the legions. Aside from that, as shameless as I am, kindly check out my Discord and buy me some coffee so I won’t doze off while writing.]
Weeks had passed inside the tower since Kaizo and the undead warriors ventured into the Undead Realm to handle the mission Kent had sent them on.
After they were gone, Uncle Drew also left with his team of Night Riders, comprising Nara, Eryndor, Saden, Vargus, and Lene.
Kent couldn’t open a gate to their destination as he did for the undead warriors, so they would have to travel to the Western Region using teleportation gates and Space Channels.

Of course, they could have allowed just one of them to reach a planet closer to their destination so the rest could teleport to his side. However, to Kent’s surprise, they all wanted to travel together, including Lene and Nara.
They wanted to use the journey as a bonding session since it had been a long time since they had done anything together.
Perhaps with Kent’s other legions coming back to him, Uncle Drew wanted to use the mission to remind his people why they were considered the greatest legion ever to walk the face of the universe.
Kent had no problems with them going on a road trip.
So they left a few days after Kaizo and the undead warriors.
After them, some of Kent’s wives also chose missions they deemed worthy of their expertise.
Unity, Dia, and Lilian formed a team and set out on a mission to Moonfang City on Planet Sonoria. Their mission was to eliminate an Immortal Lord called Vexor.
Kent let the tower project the missions, and they chose that one, so he allowed them to go.
Aside from them, Mara, Indie, and Adina also picked a mission and left a few hours after Unity’s team departed.
Soon, the rest of his wives formed their own teams and ventured out to complete missions and explore the world of immortals.
Some of them would travel to all five regions, but most of the missions were in the Eastern Region.
The tower and the quest pool basically wanted Kent to work and earn rewards, rewards that would aid him in raising his own strength and that of his legions.
So far, he had done a remarkable job awakening the undead and unleashing some of their power. Their awakening meant he, too, had become stronger.
After all, with the Undead Bond skill awakened, he had inherited some of their power.
He might only be a Peak Immortal King, but the current power he could unleash was simply overwhelming.
For now, only his Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline had awakened, but he knew it was only a matter of time before he discovered the true reason why he had undergone thirteen reincarnations.

A few weeks after most of his wives had departed the tower and embarked on their missions, Kent stood in the Harem Tower with Pandora, Vexthra, Yukiko, and Umai, staring at the cocoon housing Elina’s body.
It had been over a year inside the tower since Kent gave her the Nine Tribulation Dragon Blood Essence.
Kent wanted Elina to be happy, so since becoming a dragon was something she had always wanted, he gave her the blood essence.
If he had taken it himself, perhaps he would have become even more monstrous. But Elina’s happiness came first. So he did what he had to do, and now he could only smile and admire the cocoon.
Pandora, Vexthra, Yukiko, and Miryssa were the only ladies remaining inside the tower.
Naturally, Pandora and Yukiko were too overpowered to handle any of the missions, while Umai and Vexthra stayed behind to handle affairs in the Tower City.

Kent had no problem with them staying inside the tower. He knew they chose to because they had more pressing concerns. However, a day would come when even they would have no choice but to venture out into the world.
Umai joined Vexthra in handling affairs inside the Tower City simply because she wanted the dragons to be able to blend in with the other races.

Umai had always been gentle, even as a dragon. Back when she followed the Flame Dragon, Uncle Drake, she wasn’t as arrogant as the others, so she easily blended in with anyone, no matter where she went.
Now, she was doing her best to ensure that the dragons Kent helped bring into the tower would live in peace and make friends with humans and other races.
A few hours into their wait, the cocoon cracked, and nine different colours of lightning started to surround it.
Kent smiled when he saw the lightning. During the Primordial Era, when he faced the Nine Tribulation Dragon, he saw firsthand how monstrous she was.
Back then, she only had access to six Tribulation Lightnings.
However, even with just those six, she managed to force Chaos to go all out.
Now, Elina was inheriting that power, and that alone filled him with joy.

A few minutes later, the cocoon exploded, and Elina’s body was lifted into the air. Lightning danced across her body, shifting from one colour to another. As the lightning slowly died down, her true appearance was revealed.

She had long silver hair with faint crimson streaks running through it. She was already a beauty before taking the blood essence. However, after her transformation, she had become even more beautiful.

Her right eye had become crimson, while her left had turned golden. On her forehead, two elegant crimson-gold dragon horns could be seen. Kent knew she would absolutely love her new appearance, especially her horns.
Her skin had become flawless, and a dragon tail covered in crimson scales manifested behind her. Kent knew her tail and wings could be activated and deactivated at any time.
However, knowing Elina, he knew she would love having them activated, at least until the novelty wore off.
Aside from her appearance, she had reached the Peak Immortal Lord Stage, but the aura around her showed she was far stronger than an ordinary Peak Immortal Lord.
She had also awakened four Tribulation Lightnings, making her the wielder of four lightning elements, each at the Absolute Rank.
She had also awakened the Nine Tribulation Dragon Bloodline at the Supreme Stage and even awakened five innate bloodline skills.

The most alarming thing, however, was the mark of a dragon claw on her forehead. The claw itself was nothing unusual. Kent had seen plenty of such marks before. However, the most alarming part was the star inside the claw.
Kent had seen that star mark before.
During his life as the Ruthless Bandit, he once fought a Qilin that claimed to come from a place called Avalon. During their battle, the Ruthless Bandit had the upper hand.
However, when the star mark activated, he was easily overpowered, and the last words the Qilin said before vanishing from sight were...
"Lord Avalon awaits you in Avalon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1700: Power of the Four Tribulation Lightning
paragraphs: The Ruthless Bandit never forgot the name Avalon, and he most certainly never forgot the star tattoo. Later, he tried to find out who Avalon was, but came up empty-handed.
However, even after countless years had passed, he still remembered it, and today he finally saw the same star mark again, only this time it glowed on his wife’s forehead.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
Kent wanted to know more about it since his [Omniscient Jade Eyes] failed to see through it. However, before that could happen, he was challenged.
"Kent, my love, how about we spar so I can test how much stronger I have become?" Elina demanded, a smile playing on her lips as she gazed at him.
"Aren’t you being shameless right now, Elina? You are an Immortal Lord, while I am merely an Immortal King. This would just be you bullying me," Kent replied with a smirk.

However, as if his wives had planned it, they all rolled their eyes. They knew that even if Elina had emerged as a Demigod, there was no way she could defeat Kent. So he was merely being shameless at this point.

A minute later, he stood opposite Elina, his expression relaxed. While the star tattoo was important, he knew Elina would only talk if he accepted her challenge, so he did, and now they stood facing each other.
Kent remained clad in his robe while Elina summoned a silver armour and a glaive. She pointed it at Kent and warned, "Be careful, Kent. I don’t know how strong I am right now."
The moment she finished speaking, her body moved, and before Kent could blink, she appeared before him, her glaive carving a deadly arc through the air. Kent didn’t expect her to move that fast.
However, just as the glaive arrived before him, his left hand moved in a graceful pattern and deflected it, the impact sending Elina flying back several steps.
She smiled and moved again, appearing before Kent once more, this time with a thrust of her glaive toward his chest. Kent smiled, realising the skill Elina had employed in her movement.
’So she awakened the Void Dragon Step, huh?’
The Void Dragon Step allowed instantaneous movement through space. It was one of the most powerful movement techniques a dragon could dream of possessing.
The reason why it was regarded as one of the best is that it grows alongside the wielder, so if she wanted to, she could rely on this skill alone for as long as she wished.
However, Kent, who had been a dragon before, had long since developed a countermeasure against such a technique.
So the moment her glaive arrived before him, his body shifted, effortlessly evading her attack.
He then reached forward and grabbed the shaft of her glaive, hoping to disarm her.
However, the moment his hand touched the weapon, a smile formed at the corner of Elina’s lips, and the glaive’s shaft turned crimson as lightning snaked around it.
Kent pulled his hand back, but he wasn’t fast enough.
A strand of lightning struck his palm, sending jolts of pain down his spine. His eyes widened, and as if his life were in danger, Kent retreated using a movement technique.
"Is that the Crimson Calamity Lightning?" he asked, his expression turning serious as he watched the crimson lightning slither around Elina’s glaive.
She nodded with a smile on her face.
"Yes. I have awakened four of the Nine Tribulation Lightnings. I don’t know to what extent I can use this lightning yet, so bear with me."
Crimson lightning surged around her body.
Then she moved.
This time, her speed was several times faster.
Kent recognised the challenge, and so he summoned a sword forged from ice and met her attack head-on, the two exchanging hundreds of blows in mere seconds.

While he was nowhere close to his limit, he knew Elina wasn’t as simple as he had expected. For a moment, he seemed to have forgotten just how monstrous the Nine Tribulation Dragon Bloodline truly was.
Elina managed to snap him back to reality, and as they moved, exchanging blows, more memories of Kent’s first incarnation as the Primordial Chaos Dragon began to return to him.
Lost in the chaos of it all, the two lovers grew more serious.
Standing two kilometres away, the ladies watching wore smiles.
"I never knew Elina was this good in close combat," Vexthra muttered, watching Elina weave between attacks, countering and delivering blows of her own.
Since Elina died before she could realise her true potential during the primordial era, they never expected her to possess this much close-combat experience.
"I don’t think this mastery is her own," Pandora suddenly said. "The mastery she is displaying is very deep, something only a seasoned warrior could possess."
"Are you saying she inherited her close-combat mastery from her bloodline?" Umai asked.
"I am not sure, but that could be the case. Perhaps it is something else entirely, but I know for a fact that she isn’t fighting solely from her own experience."
The ladies became intrigued.
Just then, the lightning around Elina changed colour from crimson to azure.
Kent, who met her glaive in a violent collision, felt his soul tremble slightly. He smiled wryly, realising Elina had activated the [Azure Soul Lightning].
This lightning element targets the soul and one’s consciousness. He had learned that the hard way when he fought the Void General, the original owner of the Nine Tribulation Dragon Bloodline.
With the Azure Soul Lightning activated, the battle changed immediately.
Now, Kent had to fight on the physical, mental, and soul planes simultaneously, since every clash of their weapons attacks all three parts of his being.
However, just when the battle entered a more dangerous phase, the lightning changed colour again.
"The Violet Void Lightning," Kent said with a smirk.
His senses spread wide as he prepared for what was coming.
Elina smiled and moved, only for her body to vanish into the void.
When she appeared again, her glaive was mere inches away from Kent’s neck. He ducked and moved back, only to find his body being pulled toward Elina.
Her smile widened as the blade of her glaive brushed past Kent’s neck, scraping against metallic scales.
The third lightning, the Violet Void Lightning, granted her the power of both the Void and Space.
Essentially, with an affinity for this lightning, she could wield the powers of the Void and Space without possessing a direct affinity for either element.
However, as if fate had decided to reward Elina, not only did she possess an Absolute-Rank affinity for four Tribulation Lightnings, but she also possessed affinities for both Void and Space.
This made her Violet Void Lightning even more dangerous.
But when the colour of the lightning changed to gold, Kent knew he had to use the power of his [Omniscient Jade Eyes].
Why?
Because with the Golden Fate Lightning activated, Elina gained access to a skill called [Future Sight].
This skill allowed her to see five seconds into the future.
With that power in play, Kent finally became serious.
Elina noticed the change and smiled.
Then she moved.

Her spear thrust toward Kent, who reached out with his right hand to block it. However, at the very last moment, she shifted her stance and pivoted her attack, redirecting the spear toward Kent’s right thigh instead.
A smile appeared on her face, knowing she had finally managed to use the future to her advantage.
However, just as the spear was about to strike Kent, a dagger was suddenly pressed against her neck.
Kent’s thigh was pierced, but instead of blood spilling out, his entire body dissolved into a shadowy mist.

She has affinities for four deadly elements, namely Crimson Calamity Lightning, Azure Soul Lightning, Violet Void Lightning and Golden Fate Lightning, each at the absolute stage, yet she still failed to defeat Kent.
"The future can be disappointing sometimes, can’t it?" Kent asked with a faint smile.
